jobs.title: Medior Full Stack Developer (.NET)
jobs.description:
Ben jij een Full Stack Developer die niet alleen enthousiast wordt van goede code, maar vooral van software die écht iets oplost voor de business? Vind je het leuk om met collega's uit verschillende onderdelen van de organisatie om tafel te gaan, processen te begrijpen en samen slimme oplossingen te bedenken? Dan zijn wij bij Amega op zoek naar jou!

Wat
ga je doen als Full Stack Developer?

Als Medior Full Stack Developer werk je aan applicaties en oplossingen binnen het Microsoft-domein. Je krijgt veel ruimte om mee te denken over zowel de technische oplossing als de vraag erachter. Je bouwt dus niet alleen wat er gevraagd wordt: je denkt mee, stelt vragen en helpt onze organisatie steeds slimmer en digitaler te werken.

Amega is continu in ontwikkeling. Binnen onze verschillende bedrijven en afdelingen zien we veel mogelijkheden om processen slimmer te maken met software en automatisering. Als Full Stack Developer speel jij daarin een belangrijke rol.

Je werkt nauw samen met collega's vanuit de business. Dat kunnen bijvoorbeeld collega's zijn uit sales, aftersales, finance, marketing of onze ondersteunende afdelingen. Samen breng je een vraagstuk terug tot de kern en vertaal je dit naar een passende softwareoplossing.

Vervolgens ben je ook zelf betrokken bij de realisatie. Van database en back-end tot gebruikersinterface: jij vindt het juist leuk om over de volle breedte van een applicatie mee te denken en te ontwikkelen.

Je houdt je onder andere bezig met:

ontwikkelen en doorontwikkelen van interne applicaties en digitale oplossingen;
vertalen van wensen en processen uit de business naar concrete softwareoplossingen;
ontwikkelen van back-endfunctionaliteit met C# en .NET;
ontwikkelen van gebruiksvriendelijke webinterfaces;
bouwen en onderhouden van API's en integraties tussen verschillende systemen;
werken met databases, bijvoorbeeld Microsoft SQL Server;
meedenken over architectuur, kwaliteit, security en onderhoudbaarheid;
testen, reviewen en verbeteren van bestaande software;
signaleren van mogelijkheden om processen verder te automatiseren.

Je werkt daarbij niet vanaf een eiland. Juist het contact met gebruikers en collega's vinden we belangrijk. Soms begint je werk met een technisch vraagstuk, maar net zo vaak met een gesprek als: “We doen dit nu iedere dag handmatig, kan dat niet slimmer?” Daar krijg jij energie van.

Wat bieden wij jou?

Bij Amega krijg je de kans om mee te bouwen aan de verdere professionalisering van onze softwareontwikkeling. Je werkt in een organisatie waar veel gebeurt en waar digitalisering volop in ontwikkeling is. Daarnaast bieden wij jou:

veel ruimte voor eigen initiatief: Zie jij een betere technische oplossing of een kans om iets slimmer te organiseren? Dan horen we dat graag.
direct contact met de business: Je ziet voor wie je software maakt en ervaart ook daadwerkelijk wat jouw oplossing oplevert.
veel afwisseling: Door de diversiteit binnen Amega kom je in aanraking met uiteenlopende processen, systemen en vraagstukken.
hybride werken: Je combineert werken vanuit onze locatie in Dordrecht met thuiswerken.
ontwikkelmogelijkheden: Ruimte om jezelf technisch én persoonlijk verder te ontwikkelen door opleidingen, trainingen en praktijkervaring.
werken binnen het Microsoft-domein: Je werkt met technologie zoals .NET, C# en Microsoft SQL Server.
korte lijnen: Je werkt in een organisatie waarin je gemakkelijk kunt schakelen met collega's, management en andere afdelingen.
een marktconform salaris en goede arbeidsvoorwaarden passend bij jouw kennis en ervaring.
een informele werksfeer met enthousiaste collega's en een organisatie waarin samenwerken centraal staat.

Wat vragen wij van jou?

We zoeken geen developer die het liefst de hele dag met een koptelefoon op alleen tickets wegwerkt. Natuurlijk vinden we technische kennis belangrijk, maar minstens zo belangrijk vinden we jouw nieuwsgierigheid naar de organisatie achter de software.

Je wilt begrijpen hoe processen werken, waarom gebruikers bepaalde wensen hebben en hoe technologie hen écht verder kan c.

Daarnaast herken je jezelf in het volgende:

HBO werk- en denkniveau, bijvoorbeeld richting Informatica, Software Engineering of vergelijkbaar;
enkele jaren relevante ervaring als softwareontwikkelaar;
goede kennis van C# en .NET;
ervaring met webontwikkeling, zowel back-end als front-end;
ervaring met API's, integraties en databases;
ervaring met Microsoft SQL Server;
ervaring met Git en moderne ontwikkelprocessen;
je schrijft graag duidelijke, onderhoudbare en goed testbare software;
je bent nieuwsgierig, analytisch en denkt graag in oplossingen;
je communiceert gemakkelijk met zowel technische als niet-technische collega's;
je vindt het leuk om verantwoordelijkheid te nemen van vraagstuk tot werkende oplossing.

Je hoeft niet ieder onderdeel van onze technische omgeving al volledig te beheersen. We vinden het belangrijker dat je een goede technische basis hebt, breed geïnteresseerd bent en graag nieuwe technologie en bedrijfsprocessen leert kennen.

Hier kom je te werken

Je komt te werken binnen de ICT-organisatie van Amega in Dordrecht. Amega is een grote en groeiende automotive dealerholding waarin verschillende bedrijven en disciplines samenwerken rondom mobiliteit.

Die diversiteit maakt jouw werk als developer juist interessant. Achter onze organisatie zitten allerlei processen rondom auto's, klanten, werkplaatsen, verkoop, mobiliteit, finance en dienstverlening. En overal liggen mogelijkheden om met slimme software het verschil te maken.

Binnen ICT werken we samen aan het ondersteunen én verder ontwikkelen van de organisatie. Daarbij willen we steeds meer zelf kunnen bouwen, automatiseren en integreren.

Als Full Stack Developer krijg jij de kans om daarin vanaf het begin mee te denken en zichtbaar bij te dragen.

Waarom deze functie bij Amega?

Omdat je hier niet alleen aan software werkt.

Je werkt aan oplossingen waarvan je vaak letterlijk een paar dagen later van een collega kunt horen wat ze hebben opgeleverd. Je krijgt de ruimte om de business in te gaan, vragen te stellen en samen iets nieuws neer te zetten.

Dus ben jij een Full Stack Developer die graag code combineert met nieuwsgierigheid naar mensen, processen en business?

Dan maken we graag kennis met je!

Waarom kiezen voor Amega?

Werken met de gaafste automerken!
Sluit je aan bij een groeiend en succesvol bedrijf
Grootste automotive dealerholding in de regio
Financieel sterkste automotive bedrijf van Nederland
Professionele en positieve familiesfeer waardoor medewerkers gemiddeld 10,5 jaar bij ons blijven werken
8,5 medewerkers tevredenheid

jobs.title: Senior .Net Developer
jobs.description:
Senior .NET Developer

Bij Sogeti werk je als Senior .NET Developer in een omgeving waar technologie, vakmanschap en samenwerking centraal staan. Je maakt deel uit van multidisciplinaire DevOps‑ en platformteams en werkt aan complexe softwareoplossingen voor organisaties waar technologie direct bijdraagt aan groei, modernisering en continuïteit. Onze cultuur is informeel, met korte lijnen, veel ruimte voor initiatief en een sterke focus op kwaliteit.

Als strategische Microsoft‑partner met een sterke engineering‑focus investeren we actief in onze Microsoft Community. Je komt terecht in een community waarin kennisdeling, experimenteren en persoonlijke expertiseontwikkeling vanzelfsprekend zijn. Vanuit ons kantoor in Utrecht – en daarbuiten – organiseren we maandelijkse meet‑ups, deep dives en hands‑on sessies over onder andere .NET, Azure, GitHub, Developer Experience en AI‑gedreven development.

Werken als Senior .NET Developer bij Sogeti

Als Senior .NET Developer zet je je technische expertise in bij uitdagende projecten met zichtbare impact. Je werkt aan moderne .NET‑oplossingen met behulp van cloud‑native architecturen, microservices, API‑first designs en integraties met AI‑ en data‑gedreven componenten. Daarbij maak je bewuste, pragmatische keuzes die passen bij de schaal en ambities van de organisatie.

Je werkt met moderne tooling en platformen zoals Git, CI/CD‑pipelines, cloud‑platformen en containertechnologie (Docker/Kubernetes). Je bent een inhoudelijke sparringpartner voor klanten en collega’s en draagt actief bij aan het verbeteren van ontwikkelstandaarden, best practices en developer experience binnen projecten en teams.

Binnen onze Microsoft Community speel je als senior een zichtbare rol. Je deelt kennis, begeleidt collega’s en helpt richting te geven aan technische keuzes en nieuwe ontwikkelingen, zoals AI‑assisted development en moderne platform‑gedreven software engineering.

Wie ben jij?

Je hebt een afgeronde hbo- of wo-opleiding en minimaal vijf jaar ervaring als .NET Developer.
Je hebt diepgaande kennis van .NET Framework/Core, C#, Azure (App Services, Functions), REST API’s en moderne frontend‑ of integratiepatronen.
Je hebt ervaring met softwarearchitectuur, DevOps, CI/CD en bij voorkeur ook containertechnologie.
Je hebt of wilt één of meerdere relevante Microsoft‑certificeringen behalen, zoals Azure Developer Associate (AZ‑204), DevOps Engineer Expert (AZ‑400) of Azure AI Engineer Associate (AI‑102).
Je beheerst de Nederlandse taal op minimaal C1-niveau.

Dit bieden wij jou

Een dienstverband van 40 uur per week, met flexibele mogelijkheden om parttime te werken.
Een startsalaris tussen de € 55.000 en € 85.000 bruto per jaar (dit is inclusief vakantiegeld en mobiliteitsbudget), plus bonus.
Een flexibel mobiliteitsbudget, met o.a. opties om elektrisch te rijden.
Hybride werken en een goede werk-privébalans.
Uitgebreide opleidings- en certificeringsmogelijkheden.
26 vakantiedagen per jaar, met de optie om extra dagen bij te kopen.
Uitdagende projecten bij toonaangevende organisaties waarin jouw technische expertise het verschil maakt.

Ben jij nieuwsgierig geworden naar de projecten waar wij dagelijks aan werken en wil jij deel uitmaken van onze actieve Microsoft Community?

Solliciteer nu en ontdek hoe jij het verschil kunt maken!

Een PES-screening en assessment maken deel uit van het proces.

Heb je nog vragen over de vacature?

Hier krijg je als engineer écht de ruimte om het verschil te maken bij grote organisaties. Geen eindeloze rapporten, maar direct bouwen, verantwoordelijkheid nemen en samen met een scherp team impact maken.

Je werkt aan het ontwerpen en bouwen van maatwerkapplicaties, slimme AI-tools en integraties met het Power Platform. Jij zorgt dat de wensen van de klant vertaald worden naar heldere technische oplossingen. Je begint met het scherp krijgen van de klantvraag, bedenkt samen met je team de beste technische aanpak en bouwt die uit tot werkende software. Je ontwikkelt cloud-native applicaties, legt integraties tussen systemen en houdt je bezig met het opzetten van een veilige, onderhoudbare architectuur.

Op een gemiddelde dag ben je bezig met het uitdenken en ontwikkelen van nieuwe features, het reviewen van code van collega’s en het begeleiden van minder ervaren engineers. Je overlegt direct met de klant over wensen en eisen, maakt inschattingen voor nieuwe projecten en zorgt dat de software netjes wordt uitgerold via CI/CD. Je werkt met C#, Azure, Power Platform en AI en tilt samen de technische standaard omhoog.

Hier krijg je de vrijheid om zelf keuzes te maken, verantwoordelijkheid te nemen en direct invloed te hebben op het eindresultaat. Is deze rol iets voor jou? Solliciteer direct of kom langs voor een kop koffie.

Wat wij bieden:

Salaris tussen €4500 en €6250 per maand
Leaseauto of mobiliteitsbudget
Hybride werken: thuis, op kantoor of bij de klant

Maandelijkse teamuitjes en sportbudget

Je werkt bij een IT-bureau in de regio Utrecht waar weinig managementlagen zijn en veel ruimte is voor initiatief. De sfeer is informeel, direct en iedereen denkt mee over het eindresultaat. Samen met andere engineers werk je aan softwareprojecten, AI- en Power Platform-oplossingen voor grote organisaties. Er is veel kennisdeling en ruimte om te groeien. Je merkt meteen dat het team energiek en open is en dat iedereen gericht is op het maken van oplossingen die werken.

Vereisten:

Minimaal 4 jaar ervaring als software engineer (medior of senior)
Kennis van C#, Power Platform, Azure en AI
Ervaring met softwareontwikkeling van idee tot implementatie

Software Designer C#/C++/JAVA
jobs.description:
As a Software Designer C#/C++/JAVA, you develop software for high-tech products and machines.

In this role, you support our customers in the semiconductor, analytical instrumentation, and medical equipment industries, within the triangle of Nijmegen, Enschede, and Zwolle, by delivering smart, sustainable, and reliable software solutions. Your software expertise plays an essential role in bringing these high-tech solutions to life.

What excites you as a Software Designer C#/C++/JAVA?

As a Software Designer, you contribute to defining requirements and you are responsible for translating them into robust software designs, ensuring high-quality implementation and seamless integration. You are eager to grow into a role where you bring your own technical contribution, while guiding the development team.

From our office in Apeldoorn or at our clients’ premises, you enjoy working on:

Translating customer and system requirements into innovative, clear, and feasible concepts during the conceptual phase of projects.
Acting as a bridge between architects and engineers from a technical perspective.
Taking responsibility for a module/subsystem throughout the entire software development lifecycle.
Ensuring software quality, scalability and maintainability through sound engineering practices.
Applying strong communication skills to effectively guide and mentor a team of engineers, helping them grow and deliver high-quality results.

Sounds good? We’d love to tell you more…

Your future workplace

This is what you bring to the table

You have a technical Bachelor’s or Master’s degree, preferably in Computer Science, Software Engineering, or Computer Engineering.
You have 7+ years of experience in technical software development, gained in various roles and across diverse product environments and/or projects.
Over the past 4–5 years, you have worked within technical domains such as Semicon, Medical, or Analytical.
You have experience with at least two of the following programming languages: C#, C++, or Java.
You have knowledge of and/or experience with various development methodologies and techniques such as Design Patterns, UML, and Agile, and you keep your technical expertise up to date. You are looking for an environment where you can apply these developments in practice as well.
Based on your experience, you are able to coach junior engineers.
You are a team player and keep the common goal in mind.
You have a good command of both Dutch and English, spoken and written.
You hold a valid European driver’s license and are willing to travel.

This is what you can expect in return from Sioux

Flexible 32-40 hour working week, with room to work from home.
A healthy work-life balance is very important to us. We have 28 holidays with an option to acquire an additional 12 holidays.
You will work with passionate colleagues who share your drive for technology and business success.
By combining our expertise in software, electronics, mechanics, mechatronics, mathematics and assembly, we make the impossible possible for our customers and get to work on challenging high-tech projects.
You get a lot of freedom and responsibility; after all, you know exactly what you are doing.
Personal coaching and a training budget of €6000 per year, so that you can continue to develop yourself.
We also find it important to have fun together. We organize a lot for our employees, from events together with your partner and family, summer barbecues, innovative knowledge sessions to tasty lunches and after work drinks.
You will be working at a prime location in a green, wooded environment, close to the Veluwe National Park. The perfect base within the triangle of Enschede, Zwolle, and Nijmegen.

High Tech & High Fun

We can tell you all about the typical Sioux-culture and the high-tech challenging projects. About how you can develop yourself, like nowhere else. But we’d rather have you hear it from our own employees.

Go to testimonials >

If you want to know more about our challenging projects, please click here.

jobs.title: Edge & IOT Engineer
jobs.description:
Wil jij veilige en schaalbare edge‑oplossingen bouwen die op cruciale locaties als Schiphol en de haven real‑time helpen bepalen welke goederen extra controle nodig hebben? Kom het verschil maken bij de Douane met AI BOX‑technologie die miljoenen analyses per jaar mogelijk maakt, solliciteer dan nu!

Dit doe je bij de Douane

Je maakt onderdeel uit van Team Edge Intelligence, een deskundig, collegiaal en energiek team binnen de afdeling Data & Digitalisering. Samen ontwikkelen we een innovatieve edge‑omgeving waarin sensoren, AI‑modellen, edge‑hardware en veilige connectiviteit samenkomen. Je bouwt applicaties en edge‑componenten die het scanproces van containers en andere goederenstromen automatiseren en verrijken met data uit aangiftesystemen. Je programmeert vooral in C#, werkt in zowel Linux als Windows, en zet virtualisatie en containertechnologie op basis van Kubernetes in om AI‑modellen efficiënt en betrouwbaar op de bron te draaien. Kennis van SQL voor datakoppelingen is belangrijk; ervaring met Python, PowerShell en Bash is mooi meegenomen. Je denkt mee over hardwarekeuzes, ondersteunt bij aanschaf en borgt een veilige, toekomstbestendige implementatie.

Daarnaast speel je een sleutelrol in het uitrollen en beheren van AI BOX‑oplossingen. Je pakt de volledige lifecycle op: installatie, configuratie, updates, integratie van nieuwe AI‑modellen en monitoring van performance en betrouwbaarheid. De eerste AI BOX is live; dit jaar schalen we door naar tientallen operationele installaties op Douanelocaties. Deze oplossingen dragen direct bij aan de ambitie van de Douane om op termijn 100% van alle goederenstromen geautomatiseerd te controleren, van containers en luchtvracht tot reizigersbagage en postpakketten en daarmee de werkdruk van collega’s van Fysiek Toezicht merkbaar te verlagen.

Je werkt in een hecht kernteam met IoT‑engineers, product owner en solution architect/lead developer. Daarnaast heb je veel contact met een businessanalist, servicemanager en netwerkspecialist. We werken hybride: op maandag is het hele team op kantoor in Utrecht; regelmatig ben je op een operationele locatie (bijv. Maasvlakte of Schiphol) om AI BOX‑oplossingen te testen, finetunen of uit te rollen. De overige dagen werk je waar dat het meest effectief is: thuis of op kantoor.

Een bijzondere baan, omdat...

Je bouwt mee aan integere AI‑ en IoT‑technologie met directe maatschappelijke impact.
Je pioniert met edge‑AI dicht bij de bron en ziet je werk snel terug in de operatie.
Je helpt de ambitie versnellen richting 100% geautomatiseerde controles op alle goederenstromen.
Je combineert softwareontwikkeling, infrastructuur en operationeel beheer in één veelzijdige rol.
Je werkt in een compact team met korte lijnen, veel verantwoordelijkheid en ruimte voor ideeën.
Je draagt bij aan miljoenen AI‑analyses per jaar die Nederland veiliger maken.

"We pionieren met robuuste edge‑oplossingen die AI dicht bij de bron laten werken. Jij helpt ons die visie veilig en schaalbaar in de operatie te zetten."

— Acco, Team Edge Intelligence

Wanneer past deze baan bij je?

Je hebt aantoonbare ervaring met C#, Linux en Kubernetes in productieomgevingen. Ook beheers je de Nederlandse taal op minimaal B2 niveau.
Je bent een senior in IoT, edge computing of het integreren van AI‑modellen op edge‑devices.
Je kunt applicaties vanaf nul ontwerpen en realiseren, inclusief SQL‑datakoppelingen.
Je schakelt soepel tussen ontwikkeling en beheer, en borgt veiligheid en compliance.
Je werkt graag samen met collega’s uit operatie, business en security/netwerkdomeinen.
Je ervaring met Python, PowerShell en Bash is een nice to have.
Je floreert in een pionierende omgeving met duidelijke kaders en veel ruimte voor initiatief.

Jouw competenties

analyseren

overtuigingskracht

creativiteit

omgevingsbewustzijn

plannen en organiseren

De afdeling - Douane Directie Informatietechnologie

IT Data & Digitalisering (IT D&D) levert producten en diensten op het gebied van data, sensors en bijbehorende functionaliteit om de Douane processen te ondersteunen. Hiermee maken ze het fundament om datagedreven werken mogelijk te maken, zodat waardevolle beslissingen genomen kunnen worden op basis van volledige, juiste en tijdige informatie. Ze verbeteren daarnaast ook de digitale dienstverlening, zodat bedrijven volledig digitaal zaken kunnen doen met de Douane. Het maakt daarbij niet uit via welk kanaal ze in contact zijn met de douane, de gebruikerservaring is uniform en op elkaar afgestemd.

De Kerntaken Van IT Data & Digitalisering Zijn

Waarde leveren voor de Douane organisatie door IT-applicaties en producten op een snelle, effectieve en breed inzetbare manier te ontwikkelen.
Gegevens uit interne en externe bronnen actueel en in samenhang beschikbaar maken voor rapportages, analyses en informatieverstrekking. Het Douane Dataplatform (DDP) speelt hierin een belangrijke rol.
Het koppelen van data en het ontwikkelen van geavanceerde algoritmes, zodat risico’s via scan-, detectie en camerasystemen kunnen worden gedetecteerd. Door regie op het eigen netwerk uit te voeren wordt de effectiviteit op het toezicht van goederen en de veiligheid vergroot.
Het digitaliseren van de centrale informatievoorziening van de Douane.

De keten Sensoren is verantwoordelijk voor;

Structurele inrichting van een volwaardig team om de aanschaf, gebruik en het beheer van IT-systemen voor de verschillende sensormiddelen te faciliteren of uit te voeren.
Scan- & detectiemiddelen en andere sensoren integreren in het informatielandschap van de Douane.Hierdoor kan data samen met reguliere data gebruikt worden voor geavanceerde algoritmiek.
Zorgen voor een robuust en veilig netwerk rond de verschillende sensoren, zodat de Douane een optimaal veiligheidsniveau kan garanderen.

De organisatie

Douane

De Douane is een handhavingsdienst, stelt de verschuldigde douanerechten en accijnzen vast en heft en int deze. De geïnde bedragen worden afgedragen aan de Nederlandse schatkist en de EU. De Douane zorgt er ook voor dat de samenleving zo goed mogelijk wordt beschermd tegen onveilige en ongewenste goederen. Hieronder valt een breed scala aan taken op het terrein van veiligheid, milieu, flora en fauna, gezondheid en cultuur. Én de Douane draagt bij aan het versterken van de concurrentiepositie van Nederland en de EU door toe te zien op de naleving van Europese maatregelen voor marktordening en te zorgen voor een snelle en goede douaneafhandeling, resulterend in zo min mogelijk oponthoud en lage administratieve lasten.

Het werkterrein van de Douane is opgedeeld in landelijke directies en bureaus, het Douane Dienstencentrum (DDC), het Douane Landelijk Tactisch Centrum (DLTC) en acht regiokantoren. De regiokantoren bevinden zich in Amsterdam, Rotterdam, Breda, Groningen, Arnhem, Eindhoven en op twee locaties op de luchthaven Schiphol. De landelijke directies en bureaus zien toe op de eenheid van beleid en uitvoering op het gebied van handhaving, operaties, financiën en control, informatievoorziening en mens en middelen. Daarnaast bewaken zij de samenhang binnen Douane Nederland. Het DLTC stuurt de handhaving aan op basis van risicobeheersing. De informatietechnologie-keten zorgt voor de veiligheid, stabiliteit en continuïteit van de IT-dienstverlening. Het DDC levert producten en diensten op het gebied van bedrijfsvoering aan de douanekantoren.

Bijzonderheden

We ontvangen je brief en cv graag in een Word- of PDF-bestand. Neem in de bestandsnaam jouw voor- en achternaam op. Als je een beroep doet op een voorrangspositie, stuur dan ook een kopie van die kennisgeving mee.

Onze selectieprocedure voor deze functie ziet er als volgt uit:

Allereerst wordt beoordeeld of een voorrangskandidaat binnen de Rijksoverheid in aanmerking komt voor deze functie.
Daarna wordt beoordeeld of jouw cv en motivatiebrief voldoen aan de gestelde functie-eisen. Wanneer dit het geval is dan nemen we contact met je op om het selectiegesprek in overleg in te plannen.

Onderaan deze vacature vind je meer uitleg over de stappen die je doorloopt in de sollicitatieprocedure.

De voorkeur gaat uit naar kandidaten die het meest aansluiten bij het opgestelde profiel. Dit heeft betrekking op zowel de genoemde kennis en werkervaring als op het opleidingsniveau. Vermeld deze daarom duidelijk in je cv.

De Douane zet zich in voor de banenafspraak: zoveel mogelijk banen realiseren voor mensen met een arbeidsbeperking. Val jij in deze doelgroep? Wij zullen je ondersteunen zodat je optimaal kunt functioneren, en daarmee jouw bijdrage aan Nederland kunt leveren. Of het nu gaat om aanpassingen op je werkplek, bepaalde voorzieningen in het vervoer of bijvoorbeeld vergoedingen van het UWV: samen met jou, je leidinggevende én een jobcoach gaan wij kijken naar jouw kwaliteiten en mogelijkheden om een passend werkpakket uit te voeren. Wil jij weten of je hierbij hoort en wat dit exact betekent voor jou? Lees hier meer.

Een (online) voorselectietest en/of een assessment kan deel uit maken van de sollicitatieprocedure, evenals het maken van een casus, het opvragen van referenties en (online) screening, bijvoorbeeld via databanken, (zoekmachines) en sociale netwerken.

Jouw sollicitatie wordt alleen in behandeling genomen als je met de sollicitatie-button reageert en je cv en motivatiebrief zijn bijgesloten. Na sluitingsdatum is het niet meer mogelijk om je sollicitatie in behandeling te nemen. Houd er rekening mee dat het solliciteren technische problemen met zich mee kan brengen. Wacht hiermee dus niet tot het laatste moment.

Wanneer je solliciteert op een functie maak je eenmalig een account aan. Met je account kan je de status van je sollicitatie inzien.

Join us to put AI to work for people.

ServiceNow’s Applied AI Forward Deployed Engineering (FDE)
team is where bold ideas meet transformative action. We partner with our most strategic customers to shape the future of enterprise AI. Together, we identify high-value opportunities, accelerate business outcomes, and build reusable AI-native solutions that advance the Now AI Platform.

We partner deeply with our customers to build intelligent, scalable AI solutions that solve their most mission-critical challenges. By embedding in real-world complexity, we deliver fast, iterate with purpose, and transform every success into reusable patterns that accelerate transformation across the Now Platform and the broader enterprise.

Why This Role Matters

Enterprises are raising the bar. AI initiatives must deliver business value—not just promise potential. That means taking cutting-edge LLM capabilities and turning them into resilient, secure, and scalable software.

As a Senior Forward Deployed Software Engineer (FDSE)
, you act as the CTO of the build—owning everything from backend services to LLM pipelines and front-end integrations. You partner with customers in the field to design, implement, and deliver solution-ready builds in agile sprints. Your software becomes the reference implementation for scalable GenAI in the enterprise. You codify patterns, shape internal tooling, and accelerate innovation—delivering systems that are battle-tested in production and scalable across industries.

Who You Are

You are a systems-minded, AI-native engineer who ships real software. You own the full stack—and are equally motivated by elegant APIs, intuitive UIs, and scalable orchestration pipelines. You think like a product-minded CTO, balancing creativity with pragmatism to deliver impact.

You embed deeply with customer teams, diagnose root problems, and architect AI-powered workflows that run at scale. You don’t just debug code—you debug systems, context, and customer pain points.

Build solution-ready LLM-enabled applications that span backend logic, data orchestration, and front-end UI
Operate in the field, working side-by-side with customers to adapt, deploy, and iterate in live environments
Codify reusable assets—libraries, prompts, scaffolds—to accelerate future engagements
Shape developer experience by sharing feedback with platform and product teams

Deliver Production - ready solution in agile end-to-end sprints
Engineer with versatility: APIs, orchestration pipelines, vector DBs, LLM frameworks, UI components
Operate with agility: integrate with legacy systems, navigate ambiguity, ship safely at speed
Codify patterns: build scaffolds, SDKs, and documentation to scale success across customers
Influence platform: inform product strategy through field-tested insights and extensible code

What Success Looks Like

Production-grade delivery: Your solution builds consistently convert to scaled deployments in production environments
Reusable impact: You author libraries, prompts, and scaffolds that power multiple deployments and projects
Platform influence: Your work shapes internal tooling and is integrated into platform roadmap and primitives
Velocity and precision: You move fast without breaking things—shaping resilient, secure systems in high-stakes contexts
Engineering leadership: You are trusted by architects, PMs, and customer teams to lead implementation from zero to one

Qualifications

Experience: In leveraging or critically thinking about how to integrate AI into work processes, decision-making, or problem-solving. This may include using AI-powered tools, automating workflows, analyzing AI-driven insights, or exploring AI’s potential impact on the function or industry
Relevant Experience: 10+ years of software engineering, including 2+ years building systems in customer-facing or embedded roles
System architecture: Proven ability to design and implement AI-native software in production environments
Engineering depth: Strength in backend (Python, Node.js, Java), frontend (React, Angular), APIs (REST/GraphQL)
LLM tooling: Familiarity with LangChain, Semantic Kernel, prompt chaining, vector search, and context management
Performance & observability: Skilled in debugging distributed systems, tuning for latency, and implementing monitoring
Platform mindset: Can contribute to shared SDKs and tools, raising engineering velocity for the whole org
Product sensibility: Prioritize for user value, MVP iteration, and long-term scale
DevOps fluency: Experience deploying in AWS, Azure, or GCP with CI/CD, containers, and infra-as-code
Field readiness: Able to travel up to 30% to embed onsite and deliver where it matters

Preferred Qualifications

Experience integrating AI into SaaS platforms like ServiceNow or Salesforce
Track record of production deployments in secure, regulated enterprise environments
Contributions to dev experience tooling, frameworks, or reusable AI scaffolds

Who we are supporting

The NATO Communication and Information Agency (NCIA) is responsible for providing secure and effective communications and information technology (IT) services to NATO's member countries and its partners. The agency was established in 2012 and is headquartered in Brussels, Belgium.
The NCIA provides a wide range of services, including:
Cyber Security: The NCIA provides advanced cybersecurity solutions to protect NATO's communication networks and information systems against cyber threats.
Command and Control Systems: The NCIA develops and maintains the systems used by NATO's military commanders to plan and execute operations.
Satellite Communications: The NCIA provides satellite communications services to enable secure and reliable communications between NATO forces.
Electronic Warfare: The NCIA provides electronic warfare services to support NATO's mission to detect, deny, and defeat threats to its communication networks.

Overall, the NCIA plays a critical role in ensuring the security and effectiveness of NATO's communication and information technology capabilities.

jobs.description:
Job Description

At TOPIC, we work every day on high-tech innovations to make the world smarter, healthier, and better. Are you the driven and ambitious Software Development Engineer in Test (SDET)who enjoys writing production-quality code to automate testing of complex embedded systems that we are looking for?

“TOPIC is unique because it combines cutting-edge technology with a strong culture of collaboration and knowledge sharing. It offers the opportunity to work on impactful, real-world projects in an environment that supports both personal and professional growth."

Bohdan Dovbysh I Test Automation Engineer

What will you do as a Software Development Engineer in Test (SDET)?

As an Software Development Engineer in Test, you operate at the intersection of software development and quality engineering. You design and build high-quality test infrastructure and automation in the same way developers build production systems. With your strong programming skills in C++and/or Python, you ensure software is testable, scalable, and reliable by design. You work closely with software engineers on complex high-tech systems, contributing directly to codebases, test architecture, and continuous integration pipelines. Rather than only validating software, you actively shape how it is built and verified.

Your responsibilities as a Software Development Engineer in Test (SDET):

Design, develop, and maintain test frameworks and automation tooling using C++ and/or Python
Contribute to production code and testability improvements in collaboration with software engineers
Develop automated tests across multiple levels (unit, integration, system) as part of the development process
Build and optimize CI/CD pipelines and test infrastructure to enable fast and reliable feedback
Analyze complex systems and failures, and trace issues to root cause in code
Drive testability, observability, and quality-by-design principles within development teams
Work on high-tech systems (embedded / hardware-software integration / distributed systems) with real-world impact
Take ownership of technical decisions around test architecture and tooling
Continuously improve automation strategy with a strong focus on engineering scalability and maintainability

Job Requirements

What do we offer you?

This will make you smarter:

Challenging and interesting projects in different domains
Benefit from the expertise of your technical buddy and more than 100 smart colleagues
Focus on guiding and coaching on personal development to achieve your ambitions
Annual study budget and customized training program within our TOPIC Academy
Tech events and knowledge sessions

This will make you better:

Permanent contract
An all-in employment package between €57,000 and €76.000 (including net expense allowance, mobility package, 13th-month bonus, and holiday allowance). Final salary is based on relevant work experience and level of expertise
26 vacation days (opportunity to buy extra days), pension scheme and relocation budget (when you relocate to the Netherlands)

This will keep you healthy:

A good work-life balance, flexible working hours and hybrid way of working
An inspiring office environment with daily fresh fruit and a gym
The home office support package will turn your “home office” into an inspiring environment
Lots of fun during events like celebrations, sport activities and the weekly Friday afternoon drinks

What do you bring as a Software Development Engineer in Test (SDET)?

A Bachelor's or Master's degree in Computer Science, Embedded Systems or similar
5 years of work experience in the high‑tech domain
Experience with programming in Python, C++ and/or C# and familiar with applying OO principles.
Hands‑on experience with test automation
Preferably experience with the ROBOT Framework and methodologies such as TDD, BDD, keyword‑driven testing, data‑driven testing, model‑based testing, and property‑based testing
You are a team player, solution-oriented, and proactive
A good command of English, and preferably Dutch language

Our organization

Since 1996 we have been developing (embedded) systems that are essential for products manufactured by renowned high-tech companies around the world. Our projects involve edge to cloud solutions; from PCB design and FPGA to low level embedded software and application software for UI, Web, Mobile and cloud. We are well known for our high level of knowledge and expertise and are proud to be a Premier Adaptive Computing Partner of AMD; technology leader in the field of System-on-Chips and FPGAs.

At TOPIC, we believe that true innovation happens when people with different backgrounds, ideas, and perspectives come together. Every talent counts, and every voice matters. Diversity strengthens our creativity, and inclusion ensures that everyone feels welcome and valued. We build a culture where everyone has the space to contribute and be themselves.

jobs.title: Senior IT Software Quality Engineer – Data & ETL ( M/F/H )
jobs.description:
Everience is an international consulting group delivering AI-augmented digital services and placing people at the heart of the AI revolution.

With a presence in Europe, Africa, Asia and America, Everience offers its 4,000-strong workforce the most demanding and stimulating environment in which to transform and develop their skills, learning about new AI-based roles and building their future employability.

Through its Symbiotic Academy the group offers a unique hub for training, practical application and exchange where everyone can experiment, learn, and progress in the fields of artificial intelligence and data.

In accordance with its core purpose of orchestrating the symbiotic relationship between humans and AI in the workplace, Everience is making the augmented employee the driving force of a “symbiotic age”, where AI enhances talents and opens up new career opportunities.

Job Description

We are looking for an experienced IT Software Quality Engineer Data & ETL who will be responsible for leading and executing quality assurance activities within complex data platforms and cloud-based ecosystems.

In this role, the focus is on ensuring the quality, accuracy, completeness and reliability of data across end-to-end data pipelines. You will work at the intersection of software testing, data engineering, ETL, Big Data and cloud technologies.

You are analytical, technically skilled and able to independently execute testing activities while coordinating effectively with developers, data engineers, business analysts, product owners and other stakeholders.

The Role:

As a Senior IT Software Quality Engineer Data & ETL, you will be responsible for planning, executing and continuously improving QA activities within data-intensive environments.

You will test end-to-end data flows and ETL processes, ensuring that data is correctly extracted, transformed and loaded. You will also validate data across different systems and identify deviations, inconsistencies and data quality issues.

You combine hands-on testing with data analysis and work closely with both technical and business stakeholders.

ETL & Data Validation:

You will be responsible for:

Performing end-to-end testing of ETL and data workflows
Validating extraction, transformation and loading processes
Performing data reconciliation and cross-system validation
Checking data quality, completeness, consistency and accuracy
Identifying and analyzing discrepancies between source and target systems
Validating complex data transformations and business rules

Test Planning & Execution:

You will:

Analyze business and technical requirements
Develop detailed test scenarios and test cases
Create comprehensive test strategies
Perform functional, integration, system and regression testing
Monitor test coverage and quality throughout releases
Ensure a structured end-to-end testing lifecycle
Identify quality risks at an early stage and propose solutions

SQL & Data Analysis:

An important part of the role is performing advanced data analysis.

You will:

Use advanced SQL for data validation
Validate complex joins, aggregations and transformations
Verify business rules within datasets
Analyze source-to-target mappings
Investigate data-related defects and inconsistencies
Use SQL to identify the root cause of data quality issues

Test Automation:

Where possible, you will contribute to further automation of data validation.

You will preferably work with:

Python
PySpark
Pandas

You will develop and maintain reusable automation utilities and frameworks to improve the efficiency, reliability and scalability of the testing process.

Cloud & Data Platform Testing:

You have experience testing modern cloud-based data platforms.

Within this role, you will work with technologies including:

Azure Data Factory (ADF)
Azure Databricks
Azure Data Lake Gen2
Azure DevOps

You will validate data pipelines and data processing solutions and ensure that different Azure services integrate correctly.

API & Integration Testing:

You will also be involved in testing data exchange between different applications and services.

You will:

Perform API and integration testing
Validate data exchange between systems
Use tools such as Postman
Verify the consistency and accuracy of data across different systems

Defect Management:

You will be responsible for the complete defect lifecycle:

Identifying and documenting defects
Analyzing root causes
Prioritizing and following up on issues
Collaborating with development and integration teams
Verifying fixes
Ensuring the correct closure of defects

Reporting & Stakeholder Management:

You will work closely with:

Developers
Data Engineers
Data Architects
Business Analysts
Product Owners
Business Users
Project and Program Management

You will report on:

Test progress
Test results
Quality metrics
Risks
Dependencies
Blockers
Outstanding defects

You are able to clearly translate technical findings into concrete business impact for business stakeholders.

Quality & Risk Management:

You will:

Proactively identify quality risks
Develop and monitor mitigation measures
Ensure QA standards and processes are followed
Contribute to quality governance
Promote continuous improvement in testing and data quality

Qualifications

Must-Have

Several years of experience as a Software Quality Engineer, Data QA Engineer, Data Test Engineer, ETL Test Engineer or in a similar role
Demonstrable experience with ETL Testing / Big Data Testing
Strong experience with manual testing
Experience with BI and reporting validation
Advanced knowledge of SQL
Experience with data validation and data reconciliation
Experience with the complete end-to-end testing lifecycle
Experience with Azure DevOps
Good knowledge of ETL frameworks and processes
Hands-on experience with:
Python
PySpark
Pandas
Azure Data Factory (ADF)
Azure Databricks
Azure Data Lake Gen2
Postman

Experience with these technologies is important for this role.

Education:

You hold a Bachelor's or Master's degree in a field such as:

Computer Science
Information Technology
Data Engineering
Software Engineering

Or another comparable technical discipline.

Competencies:

Analytical and a strong problem solver
Highly accurate and quality-oriented
Independent and proactive
Strong in ownership and accountability
An effective communicator
Skilled in stakeholder management
Able to explain complex technical information in an understandable way
Strong in identifying and mitigating risks
Comfortable working in a complex, data-driven environment

Ideal Profile:

The ideal candidate has a strong background in data-centric testing and experience working within modern, cloud-based data architectures.

You combine:

QA & Testing + ETL + SQL + Data Quality + Azure + Automation

You are also able to independently lead QA activities, coordinate multiple stakeholders and take ownership of the quality of end-to-end data pipelines.

Experience with, or a strong interest in, AI-driven testing and intelligent test automation is considered a strong advantage.

Additional Information

What We Offer

A challenging procurement role within an international and growing organization;
The opportunity to influence sourcing and procurement decisions across the business;
A collaborative and diverse working environment;
Exposure to complex supplier, stakeholder and procurement networks;
The opportunity to contribute to procurement optimization and transformation initiatives;
The possibility to work with a broad range of industries, services and business functions.

All our positions are open to both women and men and are, of course, open to people with disabilities.

jobs.title: Backend Engineer (.NET) (f/m/d)
jobs.description:
Join Apaleo and Shape the Future of Hospitality Tech!

Apaleo is the world's most open, API-first property management platform, powering the next generation of hospitality operations. Our modular, AI-powered infrastructure lets hoteliers customise their tech stack, automate routine work and deliver seamless, personalised guest experiences, backed by best-in-class apps and autonomous AI agents that adapt to every stay.

We're looking for a Mid-Level Backend Engineer
to join our Invoice & Tax team. This is where hospitality meets regulation: every property Apaleo powers needs to invoice correctly and handle tax right, in every country it operates in. If you like the idea of solving real compliance problems with clean, well-tested code, and owning your work end to end, read on.

What You'll Be Up To

Own backend projects end to end: from validating requirements with the product manager, through architecture and technical breakdown, to implementation and release.
Build and extend backend services using .NET 10, running in Docker containers.
Develop features from database design through business logic to RESTful APIs, with a direct line to how tax and invoicing rules across multiple countries shape the implementation.
Write clean, well-tested code, including unit and end-to-end tests. We don't have a dedicated QA function, so you'll take full ownership of making sure what you ship holds up in production.
Monitor your own services in production, and identify and resolve issues early.
Work against dual deadlines on invoicing and tax, driven by regulatory requirements as well as customer commitments, and escalate early when something's at risk.
Collaborate closely with your product manager, frontend engineers and other backend engineers in an agile team where your ideas and feedback are valued.

What You'll Bring to the Team

A degree in Computer Science, a related technical field, or equivalent practical experience.
Solid, independent experience delivering backend features end to end in a cloud environment.
Strong .NET / C# backend development experience.
A genuine tolerance for tax, legal and compliance subject matter. You don't need deep expertise from day one, but multi-country tax and invoicing legislation is core to this role, not a side detail, so it needs to hold your interest.
A meticulous, detail-driven working style. Compliance work leaves little room for loose ends.
A proactive approach to communication: comfortable clarifying requirements, flagging risk and escalating early rather than waiting to be asked.
Hands-on experience with at least some of the following:
Relational databases such as PostgreSQL.
Docker and containerised workflows.
Cloud platforms such as AWS (Azure experience is also welcome) and message-based or asynchronous systems, such as Kafka or Azure Service Bus.
Familiarity with microservices concepts and API-driven architecture.
Comfort breaking down tasks, estimating work and delivering features incrementally.
Experience with, or interest in, AI-assisted coding tools such as Claude Code, GitHub Copilot or similiar.
Fluent English.

Nice to have

First experience with Kafka or other streaming / messaging systems.
Exposure to Kubernetes / ECS or cloud-native DevOps practices.
Basic experience with performance tuning or database optimizations.
Experience working in SaaS or API-first products.

Good to know before you apply

A little more context on the domain and the team, so you know what you're stepping into.

This role sits in a compliance-heavy space. Much of the implementation work is shaped by how different countries legislate tax and invoicing, so this is genuinely interesting problem-solving territory if that kind of depth appeals to you.
Invoice & Tax is also central to how Apaleo grows: as we expand into new markets, this team drives the discovery and requirements work that makes sure our platform is ready to operate there. You'll have a direct hand in shaping how Apaleo enters new countries.
The team is growing and evolving, including a move from Scrum to a Kanban way of working.

What We Offer

Culture & Growth

A Diverse & International Team: Work alongside passionate professionals from over 20 nationalities, bringing unique cultural perspectives, backgrounds, and experiences to shape the future of hospitality tech.
Growth & Development: As we scale, so do your opportunities. You'll benefit from 360° feedback reviews, a dedicated learning budget, and plenty of chances to take on more responsibility. Our evolving career framework ensures you have increasing opportunities to learn new skills, advance your career, and make an impact.
Autonomy & Ownership: Great ideas can come from anywhere. We empower you to take responsibility, make decisions, and contribute directly in an environment built on trust, transparency, and collaboration.
Shape the Future of Hospitality Tech: Be part of a fast-growing scale-up transforming the hospitality industry. From day one, your work drives real impact and you'll have the freedom to bring your ideas to life.
Competitive & Fair Compensation: We believe great work deserves great pay. Our salaries are competitive and guided by benchmarking data to ensure fairness across all roles and teams. We make sure to recognize and reward performance and contribution.

Perks & Lifestyle

Flexible & Remote Work Options: We focus on results, not clocking hours. You can work from home, the office or in a hybrid setup, with flexibility to adapt your schedule as long as it makes sense for your role, your team and our business.
Free Public Transport: Travel across Germany with ease using our fully covered Deutschland Ticket.
Team Connection: Strong connections fuel collaboration. We celebrate and connect through regular team dinners, company meetups, Oktoberfest celebrations, Christmas parties, and other offsite events.
Paid Time Off: Enjoy 30 days of vacation to fully disconnect, recharge, and return inspired.
Health & Wellbeing: Prioritize your health with access to hundreds of gyms, fitness studios, and wellness options through our EGYM Wellpass membership.

How you make an impact joining Apaleo:
Joining Apaleo means more than just taking on a role, it's about driving real change in the hospitality industry. Your contributions will directly shape our innovative platform, influence company-wide decisions, and help redefine the future of hospitality tech. At Apaleo, your voice matters, your ideas are valued, and your impact is tangible. Be part of a team where your work fuels progress, collaboration sparks innovation, and growth is a shared journey.

We are proud to be an Equal Opportunity and Affirmative Action Employer, committed to fostering a diverse, inclusive, and welcoming workplace. We encourage applications from individuals of all backgrounds, regardless of race, color, religion, gender identity or expression, sex, national origin, age, marital status, disability, or any other characteristic protected by applicable law. Your personal data will be handled with the utmost care and in compliance with GDPR and relevant data protection regulations. We celebrate differences and believe that diversity enriches our team and drives innovation.

Company Description

Everyone’s story matters. Come shape your story with us at Riverty.

But where does that take you?

To one of our 30 hybrid workspaces – designed for exchanging ideas, learning from others, and shaping the way we work. An international community of over 4,000 people, representing almost 80 nationalities across 12 countries. United by one mission: Combining empathy, advanced technology and data-driven insights to keep people and businesses in flow. With payments made for them. So that they don’t have to worry about it.

And there’s more.
We are part of the family-owned Bertelsmann group. Established. Corporate. In a fast-paced industry. We enable flexible payments in various industries, simplifying the financial management of known brands and helping people repay debt to build financial confidence. In short: shaping FinTech.

Job Description

We are looking for a

(Senior) Software Engineer (m/f/d)

(unlimited, full-time) to join our team located in Tallinn, Berlin or Stockholm

In this role, you will be a software development expert in an agile product development team, building and maintaining Riverty's Customer Identity Platform.

The Customer Identity Platform enables millions of consumers to securely use Riverty products, while providing seamless technical integration and frictionless user experience. Customer Identity Team is responsible for identifying or authenticating good consumers while recognizing and blocking bad actors to protect our consumers, merchants, partners, and Riverty from fraud.

On a daily basis you will

Design, develop, test, document, and operate robust, maintainable software for the Customer Identity Platform.
Participate in the end-to-end product development process and help the team ensure value, usability, feasibility, and viability.
Collaborate as needed with product managers, designers, architects, and other roles to discover the right solutions.
Monitor system health and application metrics for our live-critical platform. Investigate and resolve incidents as needed.
Identify issues, suggest improvements to new and existing features, and present ideas for solutions. Take initiative to improve quality across accessibility, performance, consistency, maintainability, and robustness.
Seek out, evaluate, and recommend new technologies and concepts, helping bring industry standards and best practices into our codebase and architecture.

Qualifications

You will be a strong fit if you have

At least 5 years of professional experience with .NET/C# development.
Strong expertise in RESTful APIs and backend service design.
Experience with microservices architecture, distributed systems, and asynchronous/event-driven communication.
Solid knowledge of application and information security.
Hands-on experience with Azure Cloud, Docker, CI/CD pipelines (Azure DevOps), and modern deployment practices; familiarity with Kubernetes, MongoDB, and Infrastructure as Code is a plus.
Hands-on experience with front-end technologies including TypeScript (React is a plus), or a strong willingness to work full-stack.
Openness to participating in on-call rotations.
Experience with identity and access management technologies, including OAuth, OpenID Connect, Auth0, and PingOne AIC.

As a person you are

Self-driven, proactive, and solution-oriented.
Confident in communicating with both business and technical stakeholders.
Fluent in English.
Empathetic, collaborative, and receptive to giving and receiving feedback.

WAS WIR UNS VON DIR WÜNSCHEN...

Im Backend verfügst Du über tiefe Praxis mit ASP.NET Core Web APIs und Microsoft SQL Server oder PostgreSQL. REST-basierte Architekturen, saubere API-Schnitte sowie ein solides Verständnis für Datenmodelle und Performance sind für Dich selbstverständlich.

Full-Stack aus Überzeugung:
Du bewegst dich im gesamten Stack sicher und bringst ein tiefes analytisches Denken mit.

AI-Ready:

Mentor & Lerner:

jobs.title: Engineering Manager ERP (f/m/x)
jobs.description:
Our goal is to have a solar system on every roof, a storage unit in every house, and an electric car in every garage. Enpal makes this possible with an integrated total solution for decentralized energy—from solar systems and battery storage to wall boxes, smart meters, and heat pumps. At the heart of it all is our AI-powered platform Enpal.One+, which intelligently connects thousands of systems and efficiently optimizes electricity procurement and feed-in on the energy market.

Are you ready for solutions that are more than just a promise and bring real quality of life to thousands of households every day? What you create at Enpal will deliver clean electricity tomorrow and bring about lasting change in how we use energy.

What you'll do

Enpal is transforming its ERP landscape from a traditional D365 F&O setup into an Agentic Enterprise, a clean D365 core with an AI-native execution layer on top. AI-native product squads, organized by E2E process domain (D2O, O2C, P2P, SCE, R2R, MDG), replace traditional workstream towers. Each squad includes a Business Intent Owner (BIO), a Technology Orchestrator, Context Engineers, and Harness Engineers. This role sits in ERP Engineering and is a core contributor to building the agentic operating model that will power Enpal at scale.

As Engineering Manager ERP, you lead the team responsible for the technical heart of Enpal's agentic enterprise: Microsoft Dynamics 365 F&O and the AI-native execution layer being built on top of it. You are both a technical leader and a people manager. You steer the transition from a heavily customized, fragmented D365 landscape to a clean-core, max-standard platform and you build the engineering capability to deliver agentic extensions, integrations, and agent harnesses at the speed the transformation demands.

TECHNICAL LEADERSHIP & ARCHITECTURE

Define and execute the ERP engineering strategy: transition from a customized D365 landscape to a clean-core, max-standard platform with agentic extensions built within clean-core guardrails
Evaluate the current D365 F&O landscape: architecture, customization debt, integration patterns, performance, data quality, and adjacent system dependencies and define the transformation path forward
Own the technical architecture for the agentic layer: agent harnesses, MCP/A2A integration standards, runtime pipelines, guardrails, and monitoring infrastructure
Ensure all D365 customizations are reduced to the minimum, only where legally required or business-critical, and that every extension decision is tested against clean-core fit, cost efficiency, and platform alignment

DELIVERY & ENGINEERING EXCELLENCE

Oversee end-to-end D365 F&O development and integrations: clean technical design, code quality, documentation standards, and release governance
Implement strong DevOps practices and CI/CD pipelines for smooth, predictable releases and deployments, including agentic build, test, and ship cycles
Design and scale integrations with Enpal's broader tech ecosystem: CRM (Salesforce), IoT, Azure, Snowflake, Aryza, Kyriba, and the Microsoft AI platform (Copilot Studio, Azure AI Foundry, Microsoft Fabric)
Ensure the D365 core is the trusted system of record: deterministic ledger, traceable decisions, full audit trail, the foundation that makes agentic operations trustworthy

PEOPLE LEADERSHIP & TEAM BUILDING

Lead, mentor, and grow a team of ERP developers and engineers, including hiring, onboarding, and developing talent as Enpal scales across 30+ legal entities
Foster a culture of engineering excellence and ownership: AI-native delivery mindset, clean-core discipline, and continuous improvement
Balance innovation, scalability, and operational stability across a fast-growth environment with continuous business unit onboarding

What you'll bring

Proven experience as an Engineering Manager, Senior ERP Architect, or Technical Lead with strong people leadership in a modern engineering environment
In-depth expertise in Microsoft Dynamics 365 F&O or Dynamics AX/AX2012, including customization, integration, and architecture
Proven experience conducting independent ERP technical assessments and translating findings into actionable roadmaps
Deep expertise in D365 F&O architecture, LCS, Azure DevOps, and integration design
Hands-on background in software engineering (C#, X++, .NET, Azure, or similar cloud-based stacks)
Experience with or strong interest in agentic AI engineering: MCP/A2A standards, agent harness design, LLM integration, or AI-native delivery models
Deep understanding of core ERP process domains (Finance, Supply Chain, Procurement) and the ability to translate business complexity into clean technical architecture
Experience building and leading teams that deliver scalable, stable, and high-performing systems in a fast-growth environment
Strong communication and stakeholder management skills across technical and non-technical domains
Fluent in English; German is a plus

Are you interested even if you don't meet all the requirements? Apply anyway! We look forward to discovering your potential—regardless of whether your experience meets every single requirement. ☀️

Why this role matters

Enpal is pioneering the Agentic ERP: a clean D365 core with an AI-native execution layer delivered at pace. The Engineering Manager is the technical owner of that platform. You are not maintaining a legacy system; you are building the engineering foundation for an agent-operated enterprise. The quality, speed, and discipline of your team's delivery directly determines whether the transformation succeeds.

What we offer

Work at Germany's first green unicorn - Play an active role in shaping the solar energy transition.
The sun shines all over the world - At Enpal, you'll work with a highly motivated, diverse team of over 65 nationalities.
The ideal setup for your focus - We are convinced that excellent results are achieved when the conditions are right. That's why we rely on a hybrid working concept that gives you the freedom to always work in the way that best suits your tasks. Do you need new inspiration on an international level? With Workflex, we offer you the opportunity to relocate abroad for up to 30 days a year, depending on your responsibilities.
Grown-up business & startup spirit - In our modern office in Berlin-Friedrichshain, you'll find everything your heart desires, from height-adjustable desks and table tennis to stocked beverage fridges and barista coffee.
Your kick-start at Enpal - Onboarding day with a welcome bag, buddy program, and a team that really supports you.
Stay up to date & help shape the future - Transparent all-hands meetings, short decision-making processes, and an open feedback culture - without mistakes, there is no progress.
The energy transition can only be achieved together - At Enpal, you can expect legendary team spirit and unforgettable team events.
Your extra boost - 29 + 2 vacation days, discounted membership at Wellhub, and corporate benefits. Everything you need to help you achieve a good work-life balance.

At Enpal, we are proud of the diversity of our team. No decisions are made on the basis of skin colour, religion or religious belief, ethnic or national origin, nationality, gender identity, sexual orientation, disability or age, either during recruitment or employment. Enpal stands for a safe workplace and takes action against discrimination and harassment of any kind.

Experience with Git and modern software development practices.

Activities

Develop and maintain Siemens PLC applications, reusable function blocks, and standardized control architectures for NexWafe's production equipment.
Design and implement workflow-driven process automation, recipe management, and orchestration systems using Node-RED or similar platforms.
Integrate instrumentation, machine equipment, industrial networks, and SCADA/MES systems into a reliable and scalable automation environment.
Develop industrial software applications, APIs, HMIs, dashboards, and analytics tools.
Collaborate closely with process engineers and cross-functional stakeholders to translate process requirements into robust and user-oriented automation solutions.

Wir stellen uns eine Welt vor, in der saubere, erschwingliche und hocheffiziente Solarenergie die primäre Energiequelle ist und den globalen Übergang zu erneuerbaren Energien und einer nachhaltigen Zukunft vorantreibt.

Unser Ziel

ist es, die Produktion von Solarmodulen durch innovative Technologien effizienter und nachhaltiger zu gestalten. Wir nutzen ein neuartiges, patentiertes Verfahren, das herkömmlichen Methoden überlegen ist, die Produktion von monokristallinen Siliziumwafern revolutioniert und die Nachhaltigkeitsziele unserer Branche erweitert.

jobs.description:
Als führendes Unternehmen im Bereich Softwarelösungen für das Gesundheitswesen sind wir in 19 Ländern tätig und beschäftigen über 9.000 engagierte Mitarbeitende. Du wirst in einem dynamischen und innovativen Umfeld arbeiten, das voller Möglichkeiten steckt. Mit Deinem Einsatz und Deiner Leidenschaft hast Du die Gelegenheit, einen nachhaltigen Unterschied zu machen.

CGM Leverages AI:
Wir suchen Menschen, die die Kraft von KI im E-Health-Umfeld spüren, den Wandel mitgestalten wollen und mit neugieriger Leidenschaft erkennen, wie Technologie Gesundheit smarter, einfacher und besser machen kann.

Gemeinsam gestalten wir das Gesundheitssystem der Zukunft. Werde Teil unserer Mission und mache den Unterschied – für eine Welt, in der Wissen Leben rettet!

Dein Beitrag:

Du konzipierst, entwickelst und betreibst moderne Webanwendungen über unser SaaS-Portfolio hinweg (Praxis, Agentic AI, ifap, Therafox, Intermedix u. A.) und arbeitest souverän über Frontend, Backend und DevOps-Layer hinweg.
Du integrierst AI-native Features und agentische Experiences in unsere Produkte, nutzt LLMs, Retrieval, Tool-Use und strukturierte Workflows und schaffst so echten Mehrwert für Ärzt:innen, Praxisteams und Patient:innen.
Du designst, entwickelst und betreibst Cloud-native Services mit Fokus auf Zuverlässigkeit, Sicherheit und Developer Productivity und baust gemeinsam mit dem Team Shared Agents, Skills, Pipelines und Harnesses kontinuierlich aus.
Du arbeitest eng mit Product Management, UX, Architektur und Engineering zusammen, hebst die Engineering- und AI-Engineering-Qualität im Team aktiv an und prägst Best Practices für agentische Anwendungen.
Du bleibst nah an den Nutzerinnen und Nutzern, verstehst Healthcare-Workflows und bringst ein unternehmerisches, outcome-getriebenes Mindset in die Feature-Entwicklung ein.

Das bringst Du mit:

Mehrjährige Senior-Erfahrung im Full-Stack-Engineering moderner Webanwendungen mit tiefem Know-how in mindestens einem Frontend-Stack (React oder Angular) und einem Backend-Stack (Java/Spring Boot oder Python), idealerweise mit End-to-End-Verantwortung im Produktkontext.
Abgeschlossenes Hochschulstudium (Master oder Promotion) in Informatik, Software Engineering oder einem vergleichbaren technischen Studiengang mit überdurchschnittlichen Leistungen.
Fundierte Praxis mit unseren Kerntechnologien wie React/Angular, Java Spring Boot, Python, C#, Kafka, Terraform sowie Cloud-/DevOps-Umgebungen (Kubernetes, Helm, ArgoCD); Erfahrung mit LLM-Tools wie Azure OpenAI, Anthropic SDK oder MCP ist ein starkes Plus.
Nachweislich effektiver Einsatz von AI im Software-Engineering, idealerweise inklusive Claude Code oder vergleichbaren agentischen Coding-Tools (Agents, Skills, Workflows) sowie Erfahrung im Design von AI-Pipelines, Harnesses und Context Engineering.
Verhandlungssicheres Deutsch und fließendes Englisch in Wort und Schrift, ausgeprägte Problemlösungsstärke, Innovationsfreude, hohe Proaktivität, sehr gute Zusammenarbeit mit Product Management und ein klares Alignment mit unserem Healthcare-Purpose und einem unternehmerischen Mindset.

Das kannst Du von uns erwarten:

Mobile Work: Arbeite flexibel an zwei Tagen pro Woche mobil und an 3 Tagen vor Ort.
Attraktive Standorte: An unseren Standorten erwarten Dich neben voll ausgestatteten Arbeitsplätzen auch regelmäßige Events wie Sommerfeste und Weihnachtsfeiern.
Entwicklung: Unsere Inhouse-Academy und unser Portfolio aus externen Kooperationspartnern unterstützen Dich in Deiner Weiterentwicklung.
Gesundheit: Gesundheit ist für uns ein hohes Gut. In der hauseigenen Kantine gibt es jeden Tag eine Auswahl an leckeren und gesunden Gerichten und in unserem voll ausgestatteten Fitnessstudio heißen wir Dich in wöchentlichen Kursen gerne willkommen.
Mehr geht immer: Der Kindergarten auf unserem CGM-Campus in Koblenz unterstützt unsere Mitarbeitenden dabei, ihren Arbeitsalltag noch flexibler zu gestalten. Wir halten außerdem Corporate Benefits, die Möglichkeit eines Jobrads, BAV u. V. M. Für Dich bereit.

Vielfalt ist Teil von CGM!
Wir freuen uns unabhängig von Behinderung, Geschlecht, Nationalität, ethnischer und sozialer Herkunft, Religion, Alter sowie sexueller Orientierung und Identität auf Deine Bewerbung.

Überzeugt?
Bewirb Dich jetzt online mit Deinen aussagekräftigen Bewerbungsunterlagen (inkl. Deiner Zeugnisse, Gehaltsvorstellung und nächstmöglichem Eintrittstermin).

Build and modernise digital services that support thousands of people and businesses across the UK.

The Insolvency Service, in partnership with Inspire People, is looking for a Senior .NET Developer to join its Digital Services team and help modernise and improve a portfolio of digital services used by colleagues, businesses and the public. Permanent role, salary £48,429 - £57,722 (based on assessment at interview), 29% employer pension contribution plus full Civil Service benefits. Flexible, hybrid working from 9 UK locations.

About the Senior Developer role

This role will join the Digital Services team, part of Change and Technology Services within the Insolvency Service, supporting enterprise applications used by internal teams, external organisations and the general public.

The team is consolidating its technology stack and moving away from legacy services, with a growing focus on Microsoft .NET 10 and Azure. This is a strong opportunity to help modernise digital services, influence technical approaches and contribute to a more sustainable, user-centred technology environment.

The role will also contribute to the ongoing improvement of a portfolio of live digital services, helping reduce technical debt, improve consistency across the technology estate and support faster, more effective delivery of future change.

Responsibilities of a Senior Developer

Design, develop and maintain secure, accessible and maintainable applications across enterprise digital services.
Deliver functionality against agreed user stories, acceptance criteria and Agile delivery objectives.
Take ownership of code quality through automated testing, peer reviews, defect prevention and addressing technical debt.
Contribute to architectural discussions, engineering standards, reusable components and common development approaches.
Support live services through incident resolution, releases, deployments, documentation and ongoing continuous improvement.

Essential criteria for a Senior Developer

C# and .NET development experience within modern web applications.
Experience of modern engineering practices including TDD/BDD, automated testing, CI/CD and DevOps.
Good understanding of integration approaches including APIs, real-time, scheduled, batch and messaging services.
Experience working with cloud-based IaaS and PaaS solutions, alongside strong knowledge of secure and maintainable software development.
Strong analytical, problem-solving and communication skills, with the ability to contribute to technical discussions, share knowledge and support colleagues.

Desirable criteria for a Senior Developer

Experience working with Microsoft Azure services such as Azure SQL, Cosmos DB, App Services, Function Apps and AI Search.
Knowledge of clean architecture, OOP, SOLID, RESTful APIs and GitHub-based development workflows.
Experience of GOV.UK standards, including the Service Manual and Technology Code of Practice.

Benefits

Alongside your salary of up to £57,722, Insolvency Service contributes £14,029 towards you being a member of the Civil Service Defined Benefit Pension scheme. We want you to have a good work-life balance and want to support you in all that you do, so they offer a great benefits package including:

Flexible working arrangements and flexi-time
25 days annual leave, increasing to 30 days after 5 years’ service
8 public/bank holidays plus 1 additional privilege day
Competitive maternity, paternity and parental leave
5 days paid learning and development leave
5 days paid volunteering leave
Cycle to Work scheme
Access to Workplace Wellness, the employee assistance programme offering confidential and independent support and advice

Office locations

The role is open across 9 of Insolvency Service locations:
Birmingham, Cardiff, Edinburgh, Exeter, Ipswich, Leeds, Manchester, Newcastle and Nottingham

Additional Requirements

Expectation is to spend 60% of your working time in one of the offices.
This role operates under the flexible working hours agreement, supporting a positive work-life balance
The post is subject to SC level clearance, a requirement for which you must have resided in the UK for a minimum of 5 years.

The Insolvency Service does not
currently hold this licence and therefore cannot legally sponsor Skilled Worker visa applicants.

Why join

This is an opportunity to join the Insolvency Service at an important point in its technology journey.

You will be working on a wider programme to maintain, improve and modernise more than 10 digital services, helping the team move away from older applications and inconsistent technologies towards a more focused and maintainable Microsoft-based environment.
You will have the opportunity to improve live services, influence engineering standards, contribute to technical decisions and work with modern development practices across a collaborative Digital Services team.

Apply now to contact Inspire People in complete confidence.

Up to £45,000 | Hybrid / Remote Flexible

We're working exclusively with a growing, mission-driven SaaS technology business to find two Mid-Level Software Engineers to join their engineering team.
This is a genuine opportunity to join a collaborative, people-first engineering culture at an exciting stage of growth, where your mindset, communication and craft matter just as much as your technical skills.

The Opportunity

You'll join a flat, well-structured engineering department of 40–50 people where mid and senior engineers sit as equals, and progression routes exist for both technical individual contributors and future team leads.

The business is actively shaping its engineering department, with senior leadership coming in to help define direction, meaning you'll have real influence on how things are built and how the team works.

One role sits within a team building customer-facing reporting dashboards, helping end users make data-driven decisions and meaningful interventions. The other contributes to external API development for customers.

Both roles sit within a broader cloud-based Azure environment using .NET, Angular and SQL Server.

What You'll Be Doing

Designing, building and maintaining features across the full stack (Azure, .NET APIs, TypeScript/JavaScript front end, SQL databases)
Contributing to architectural and technical decisions within your domain
Writing clean, well-tested, maintainable code
Participating in and improving engineering practices, including code reviews, testing strategies and CI/CD
Experimenting with AI tooling and helping shape an emerging agentic SDLC workflow
Working closely with Product, Design and QA to deliver outcomes that genuinely matter

What We're Looking For

Technically, you'll bring around 3+ years of professional software development experience and solid exposure to .NET/C# as a minimum.
Full stack experience is ideal, but strong back-end engineers with some front-end exposure will absolutely be considered.

You'll be comfortable with JavaScript-based front-end frameworks. Angular is the stack here, but we'll support you if you're coming from React or a similar framework. You'll also have a solid grasp of REST APIs, system design, SQL databases and cloud platforms.

22 days annual leave, with the option to buy more, plus:

A genuine flat structure with clear progression routes, whether you want to grow as a technical individual contributor or move towards team leadership

As a senior software developer, you will be part of a team responsible for developing and supporting scalable, secure, and high-quality user-centric digital services. Working with senior colleagues, you will lead team members on the design and build of digital services and will work closely with colleagues within multidisciplinary agile teams, that focus on delivering work iteratively and at pace. You will innovate to radically transform how public services are delivered and improved.

If you are successful, you will be working in The Data Capture and Ingestion Team within Data Directorate. Subject to your availability, we will aim to conduct the capability assessment and confirm the allowance offer to you within a week of the provisional offer being made.

This is a discretionary non-consolidated, non-pensionable allowance which, if awarded, is attached to the post. The value of the allowance is based on the outcome of a capability assessment and is reviewed annually. Allowance values range up to £19,400, with the highest values reserved for candidates whose capability is above the expected level for all of the skills.

age
