jobs.description:
Senior Director, Engineering – Corporates, Financial Institutions & Sovereigns

Fitch Ratings

The Opportunity

Fitch Ratings is looking for a builder, a challenger, and a boundary-pusher to lead the engineering organization responsible for all applications and services powering our Corporates, Financial Institutions, and Sovereigns lines of business. This is not a role for someone who optimizes within the status quo — it's a role for someone who questions it, reimagines it, and has the courage and capability to do something about it.

As Senior Director, you will have executive ownership of four engineering teams comprising a couple of dozen engineers. You'll lead a talented, multidisciplinary group tackling some of the most consequential technology challenges in global financial intelligence — maintaining and evolving the systems that analysts and clients depend on today, while simultaneously building the next generation of platforms from a position of real creative freedom and organizational backing.

This is a role for someone who moves fast, experiments boldly, and doesn't wait for permission to try something new. Someone who has broken things in the pursuit of building something better, who sees constraints as invitations to be clever, and who brings an infectious sense of possibility that raises the ambition of everyone around them. If you've spent time deep in machine learning or AI systems — not just using them, but building them — that's not just a bonus, it's the kind of background that makes this opportunity even more compelling. But this role goes far beyond any single discipline: it's about leading a culture of relentless innovation across every dimension of how software gets built and delivered.

We'll Count on You To

Challenge the conventional and set a bolder technical vision
Own the strategic direction, execution, and engineering culture of four high-performing full-stack engineering teams. But more than managing what exists — interrogate it. Ask the uncomfortable questions about why things are built the way they are, and lead your teams toward answers that are smarter, faster, and more powerful. Set a technical vision that doesn't just improve the current state but genuinely reimagines what's possible for the platforms powering Fitch's most critical analytical work.

Build, develop, and inspire exceptional people
Lead, mentor, and empower a team of team leads and engineers across a range of technical backgrounds and experience levels. Foster a culture where intellectual curiosity is celebrated, where experimentation is encouraged, and where people feel safe enough to take risks and learn loudly from what doesn't work. Attract and retain engineers who are hungry, inventive, and proud of both the quality of what they ship today and the audacity of what they're building toward.

Reimagine and modernize critical platforms
Oversee the full lifecycle of the applications and services central to Fitch's Corporates, Financial Institutions, and Sovereigns analytical workflows. Balance the discipline of maintaining production-grade systems with the creative ambition to tear down and rebuild what no longer serves the business well. Be the person in the room who asks "what if we started over?" — and who knows when that's exactly the right call.

Drive greenfield innovation without apology
Identify and actively pursue opportunities to design and build net-new applications and platforms that replace or leapfrog legacy approaches. Embrace the blank canvas — and bring the rigor of world-class software delivery with you. This is an organization that wants to see bets placed, experiments run, and lessons learned fast. Be the kind of leader who creates that energy and channels it into things that last.

Push the frontier of AI, ML, and intelligent systems
Go beyond adopting AI tools — define how intelligent systems become structural, load-bearing parts of the platforms your teams own. Whether that's LLM-powered workflows, ML models embedded in analytical processes, agentic automation, or AI-augmented developer tooling, bring the depth to evaluate, architect, and champion these capabilities with real technical conviction. If you've built ML systems from the ground up, that experience will resonate deeply here — and you'll have the platform to apply it in genuinely high-stakes, high-visibility ways.

Influence across a complex and interconnected stakeholder landscape
Act as a strategic partner to a broad and diverse set of stakeholders — including senior leadership, analytical teams, operations, and business relationship management — whose workflows and outcomes depend directly on the platforms your teams own. Navigate a rich ecosystem of technical interdependencies, partnering with peer engineering teams whose systems integrate with, depend on, or are shaped by what your teams build. Build organizational credibility through consistent delivery, clear technical vision, and the ability to bring bold ideas to life in ways that earn trust across the business.

What You Need To Have

18+ years of hands-on software engineering experience , with substantial time in senior technical leadership roles overseeing multiple teams and disciplines
Proven multi-team leadership — demonstrated experience leading team leads and engineers across full-stack disciplines; a track record of building high-performing, inventive engineering cultures at meaningful scale
Deep technical credibility and hands-on instinct — strong command of modern software architecture, cloud-native platforms, and production-grade application delivery; you know when to go deep, and your teams and peers will know it too
Full-stack engineering expertise — proven background with modern enterprise technology stacks, including React, Java, and/or Python in production environments, deployed across AWS and/or Azure
A bias for experimentation and innovation — a demonstrable history of pushing technical boundaries, challenging inherited assumptions, and driving teams toward approaches that are meaningfully better — not just incrementally improved
Modernization and greenfield experience — proven ability to evolve existing platforms while simultaneously designing and delivering new systems; comfort making bold architectural decisions in both constrained legacy and open greenfield environments
People leadership and talent development — demonstrated ability to attract, grow, and retain exceptional engineers and engineering leaders; a builder of teams as much as systems, with a genuine investment in the growth of the people around you
Cross-functional stakeholder management — proven ability to partner effectively across analytical, operational, and business-facing teams as well as peer technical organizations; skilled at managing competing priorities and driving alignment across a complex interdependency landscape
Executive communication — the ability to translate bold technical vision for non-technical audiences, build trust through delivery, and make complex ideas land clearly at every level of the organization
Education: Bachelor's, Master's, or PhD in Computer Science, Software Engineering, Machine Learning, or a related technical field — or equivalent expertise demonstrated through impact

What Would Make You Stand Out

An ML or AI engineering background — if you've spent meaningful time building machine learning systems, training models, designing intelligent pipelines, or architecting AI-native applications, that depth is genuinely exciting for this role and will shape how you lead, what you build, and the kind of talent you attract
Deep cloud-native expertise — hands-on mastery of AWS and/or Azure, Docker, Kubernetes/EKS, microservices architecture, and sophisticated CI/CD and deployment pipelines for large-scale application delivery
Generative AI and intelligent systems experience — hands-on experience with LLMs, RAG architectures, agentic workflows, or production ML systems; the ability to move between engineering credibility and strategic vision without losing altitude
AI-native delivery leadership — direct experience implementing AI-augmented development lifecycles, intelligent testing pipelines, or AI-assisted tooling that materially raises the quality and velocity of engineering teams
Transformation and platform modernization leadership — a history of successfully reimagining complex, production-critical platforms while maintaining delivery continuity and rallying teams around a compelling future state
A maverick streak with enterprise judgment — the rare combination of someone who genuinely challenges conventions and moves with urgency, but knows how to do it within a complex organization without losing stakeholders along the way
Financial services domain knowledge — familiarity with analytical workflows, credit ratings processes, or how technology creates leverage in financial decision-making
Technical thought leadership — contributing to open source, speaking at industry events, publishing engineering content, or establishing technical direction that influences well beyond your immediate team

What We Offer

A genuine mandate to innovate — not a talking point, but real organizational backing to question, challenge, and rebuild the platforms powering some of Fitch's most critical business lines
Executive visibility and strategic influence — direct access to senior leadership, the platform to shape engineering direction across consequential lines of business, and the opportunity to leave a lasting mark on how global financial intelligence is delivered
The intersection of depth and breadth — lead a capable, experienced engineering organization while simultaneously running a bold innovation agenda; this role sits at a genuinely rare intersection of operational accountability and creative freedom
A place where ML and AI expertise becomes architecture — if you've built intelligent systems, this is an environment where that knowledge doesn't sit on the shelf; it shapes product direction, platform design, and how the organization thinks about what's next
Cutting-edge technology and continuous learning — access to the latest AI tools, frameworks, platforms; training and conference budgets; and the expectation that you'll stay at the leading edge and pull your teams forward with you
Career acceleration at scale — high visibility to the most senior leaders at Fitch, a clear path to principal and executive roles, and the opportunity to define what AI-driven financial technology looks like in practice
A culture that rewards curiosity — an environment where bold ideas are welcomed, where experimentation is celebrated, and where the best thinking wins regardless of where it comes from

Why Fitch?

At Fitch Group, the combined power of our global perspectives is what differentiates us. Our global network of colleagues comes together to accomplish things greater than they ever could alone.

Every team member is essential to our business, and each perspective is critical to our success. We embrace a diverse culture that encourages a free exchange of ideas, guaranteeing your voice will be heard and your work will have an impact, regardless of seniority.

We are building incredible things at Fitch and we invite you to join us on our journey.

We are looking for a talented and adaptable Application Engineer to join our Business Systems team. This is a T-shaped role: you will bring deep technical expertise in at least one discipline that is of direct value to the team (AIS and REST APIs, SQL, Power Platform or Fabric), and combine it with the breadth and curiosity to act as a technical product owner across a defined portfolio of business-critical applications.

This will require strong troubleshooting skills and a solid understanding of system integrations, data structures and flows, and application architecture, as well as practical experience of managing the operational health of applications, including application configuration, patching and upgrade management. This is an excellent opportunity to help shape and improve our technology landscape, enhance operational efficiency, and drive digital and cloud transformation.

We are a close-knit and supportive team of 15 people, dedicated to sharing knowledge and cross-skilling to support and improve the diverse set of business-critical applications we look after. We are more interested in the quality of your technical thinking and your track record as a developer and product owner than in the specific languages you have coded in or the products you have previously managed. Above all, we are looking for someone with the flexibility and appetite to pick up new technologies and take ownership of whatever tools and platforms the role requires, which will include:

Application Portfolios

It is likely that the successful candidate will initially take joint ownership of one of the following application portfolios, dependent on their background and the team's priorities at the time of joining.

Document Management

Products in the portfolio include: iManage products (Work, SPM, IRM and RAVN), SharePoint and HighQ

Finance

Key responsibilities

The key responsibilities of this role are set out below and there may be others which are not listed. You may be required on occasion to work outside our normal working hours of 9:30am to 5:30pm.

Technical Product Ownership

Serve as the technical product owner for assigned business applications, managing their technical direction and ensuring alignment with the Technology department’s roadmap, business strategy and user needs.
Stay informed of product updates, upgrades and roadmap developments and manage their implementation.
Maintain and prioritise the product backlog, including new features, upgrades, maintenance tasks, defect resolution and security updates.
Serve as a subject matter expert (SME) for your portfolio, promoting optimal use of the applications and proactively identifying opportunities for business improvement.
Engage regularly with application stakeholders and users to ensure they are informed of progress and change, and to monitor and improve user experience.

Design and Development

Collaborate with stakeholders to gather requirements and translate them into practical application changes or enhancements.
Work with internal and external teams to securely design, develop, test and optimise enhancements to your assigned applications.
Participate in or lead agile ceremonies such as sprint planning, backlog refinement and retrospectives.

Application Management and Support

Manage the configuration, deployment and ongoing support of your portfolio of applications.
Troubleshoot and resolve complex technical issues, escalating to vendors where necessary.
Act as the primary liaison between internal users, procurement, support teams and vendors for your portfolio.
Manage vendor relationships, including coordinating support cases, overseeing service levels, and negotiating enhancements or customisations.
Monitor usage and performance, proactively addressing issues and identifying opportunities for improvement.
Maintain thorough documentation relating to change control, configuration, processes and procedures.

Cybersecurity and Risk

Maintain best practice security policies and procedures for the applications, any data they handle or store and their integrations, complying with internal and external security standards.
Identify and manage risks and vulnerabilities in your portfolio and in its roadmap, and proactively support their mitigation.
Participate in audits, risk assessments and business continuity planning as it relates to your application portfolio.

Candidate profile

Candidates for this position must have:

Essential:

Proven experience of managing and supporting business-critical applications in a complex professional services, or similarly demanding, environment.
Deep technical expertise in at least one discipline directly applicable to the team: Azure Integration Services and REST APIs, SQL, Power Platform or Fabric.
Strong troubleshooting skills and a solid understanding of system integrations, data structures and flows, and application architecture.
Experience with application configuration, patching and upgrade management.
Excellent stakeholder engagement, communication and documentation skills, with the ability to convey technical concepts clearly to non-technical audiences.
A collaborative approach and a genuine enjoyment of working as part of a close-knit team.
Adaptability and a willingness to learn new skills and ways of working and to take on additional responsibilities as the team's needs evolve.

Desirable:

Experience in the legal sector or a similarly regulated professional services environment.
Familiarity with legal sector compliance and IT security standards, such as GDPR, ISO 27001 and Cyber Essentials Plus.
Experience with agile or iterative delivery methodologies and tools.

jobs.description:
Company Description

It all started when engineer Fred Luddy wrote code that automated a tedious task for his coworker, Phyllis. She cried tears of joy. That moment inspired Fred to build a company that could do that for everyone—freeing people from busywork so they could focus on meaningful work. Today, ServiceNow is the AI control tower for business reinvention. Our ServiceNow AI platform brings together any AI, any data, and any workflow— helping 85% of the Fortune 500® work smarter, faster, and better. We're building an AI-native culture where technology and talent are unstoppable together. And we're just getting started.

Join us to put AI to work for people.

Job Description

Team Bio:

ServiceNow’s Applied AI Forward Deployed Engineering (FDE)
team is where bold ideas meet transformative action. We partner with our most strategic customers to shape the future of enterprise AI. Together, we identify high-value opportunities, accelerate business outcomes, and build reusable AI-native solutions that advance the Now AI Platform.

Our mission:
We partner deeply with our customers to build intelligent, scalable AI solutions that solve their most mission-critical challenges. By embedding in real-world complexity, we deliver fast, iterate with purpose, and transform every success into reusable patterns that accelerate transformation across the Now Platform and the broader enterprise.

Why This Role Matters

Enterprises are raising the bar. AI initiatives must deliver business value—not just promise potential. That means taking cutting-edge LLM capabilities and turning them into resilient, secure, and scalable software.

As a Senior Forward Deployed Software Engineer (FDSE)
, you act as the CTO of the build—owning everything from backend services to LLM pipelines and front-end integrations. You partner with customers in the field to design, implement, and deliver solution-ready builds in agile sprints. Your software becomes the reference implementation for scalable GenAI in the enterprise. You codify patterns, shape internal tooling, and accelerate innovation—delivering systems that are battle-tested in production and scalable across industries.

Who You Are

You are a systems-minded, AI-native engineer who ships real software. You own the full stack—and are equally motivated by elegant APIs, intuitive UIs, and scalable orchestration pipelines. You think like a product-minded CTO, balancing creativity with pragmatism to deliver impact.

You embed deeply with customer teams, diagnose root problems, and architect AI-powered workflows that run at scale. You don’t just debug code—you debug systems, context, and customer pain points.

You Will

Build solution-ready LLM-enabled applications that span backend logic, data orchestration, and front-end UI
Operate in the field, working side-by-side with customers to adapt, deploy, and iterate in live environments
Codify reusable assets—libraries, prompts, scaffolds—to accelerate future engagements
Shape developer experience by sharing feedback with platform and product teams

What You’ll Do

Deliver Production - ready solution in agile end-to-end sprints
Engineer with versatility: APIs, orchestration pipelines, vector DBs, LLM frameworks, UI components
Operate with agility: integrate with legacy systems, navigate ambiguity, ship safely at speed
Codify patterns: build scaffolds, SDKs, and documentation to scale success across customers
Influence platform: inform product strategy through field-tested insights and extensible code

What Success Looks Like

Production-grade delivery: Your solution builds consistently convert to scaled deployments in production environments
Reusable impact: You author libraries, prompts, and scaffolds that power multiple deployments and projects
Platform influence: Your work shapes internal tooling and is integrated into platform roadmap and primitives
Velocity and precision: You move fast without breaking things—shaping resilient, secure systems in high-stakes contexts
Engineering leadership: You are trusted by architects, PMs, and customer teams to lead implementation from zero to one

Qualifications

What You Bring:

Experience: In leveraging or critically thinking about how to integrate AI into work processes, decision-making, or problem-solving. This may include using AI-powered tools, automating workflows, analyzing AI-driven insights, or exploring AI’s potential impact on the function or industry
Relevant Experience: 10+ years of software engineering, including 2+ years building systems in customer-facing or embedded roles
System architecture: Proven ability to design and implement AI-native software in production environments
Engineering depth: Strength in backend (Python, Node.js, Java), frontend (React, Angular), APIs (REST/GraphQL)
LLM tooling: Familiarity with LangChain, Semantic Kernel, prompt chaining, vector search, and context management
Performance & observability: Skilled in debugging distributed systems, tuning for latency, and implementing monitoring
Platform mindset: Can contribute to shared SDKs and tools, raising engineering velocity for the whole org
Product sensibility: Prioritize for user value, MVP iteration, and long-term scale
DevOps fluency: Experience deploying in AWS, Azure, or GCP with CI/CD, containers, and infra-as-code
Field readiness: Able to travel up to 30% to embed onsite and deliver where it matters

Preferred Qualifications

Experience integrating AI into SaaS platforms like ServiceNow or Salesforce
Track record of production deployments in secure, regulated enterprise environments
Contributions to dev experience tooling, frameworks, or reusable AI scaffolds

At Kainos, we’re problem solvers, innovators, and collaborators - driven by a shared mission to create real impact. Whether we’re transforming digital services for millions, delivering cutting-edge Workday solutions, or pushing the boundaries of technology, we do it together.

: Artificial Intelligence

Job Profile Description

As an AI Solution Architect in Actonomy, you’ll be the technical lead on our customer-facing Frontier AI projects, responsible for the successful delivery of high quality AI solutions built on Actonomy’s products. You’ll lead a team of Forward Deployed Engineers working hands-on inside customer environments to turn ambitious AI ideas into production reality. It’s a role that combines engineering, consulting and product thinking, so you’ll be as comfortable in front of a customer as you are in the code.

As a technical leader, you’ll work with senior stakeholders to agree architectural principles and strategic direction, develop customer relationships and account management, and feed what you learn on the ground back into our product direction. You’ll manage, coach and develop a small number of staff, with a focus on performance and career development, whilst advising on new technologies and approaches to AI and helping the people around you learn, develop and grow.

Your Key Responsibilities Will Include

Leading Frontier AI projects – You’ll be the technical lead on customer engagements, owning the solution end to end and guiding a team of Forward Deployed Engineers to deliver it.
Working directly with customers – You’ll work with customers and senior stakeholders to understand their business problems and desired outcomes, and agree architectural principles and strategic direction.
Deploying and integrating – You’ll oversee the deployment, configuration and integration of Actonomy’s products within customer environments, and resolve the technical challenges that arise during rollout.
Leading your team – You’ll provide technical direction, support and line management to a team of Forward Deployed Engineers, helping them make the right decisions and grow.
Closing the product loop – You’ll gather user feedback and translate customer needs into product improvements, working closely with our Product and Engineering teams.
Building reusable assets – You’ll create reusable deployment patterns and implementation assets that make each engagement faster and better than the last.
Driving adoption and value – You’ll support customer adoption and value-realisation activities so customers get real, lasting value from AI in their day-to-day work.
Staying at the frontier – You’ll stay current with developments in AI, Microsoft technologies and the Actonomy platform, and share that knowledge with your team and customers.

Minimum (essential) Requirements

Proven experience leading the delivery of production AI solutions across different sizes and shapes of challenge (e.g. an AI service, a multi-team programme, a customer platform deployment or a complex integration).
Experience acting as the technical lead on customer-facing projects, ideally deploying software products or platforms within customer environments.
Significant hands-on experience with Python and public cloud platforms, particularly Azure, including SaaS and PaaS offerings.
Hands-on experience building and deploying with modern AI, including large language models and agentic AI (prompt engineering, RAG, tool and function calling, orchestration), on the Microsoft AI stack such as Azure OpenAI, Azure AI Foundry and Azure AI services.
Proven experience of technical ownership for an AI product or software project, including architecture, estimation, product planning and user story/requirement creation.
Able to understand whole-solution architecture and to communicate and negotiate it with senior and C-level stakeholders, including the commercial implications of design decisions.
Able to simplify and clearly communicate AI design in conversation, documentation and presentations to non-engineers. Comfortable working directly with customers and users, developing relationships and supporting account management.
Experience integrating products or solutions with customer systems and data sources and resolving technical issues during implementation and rollout.
Able to prioritise across multiple major projects, particularly when working to deadlines.
A demonstrated ability in managing, mentoring, coaching and developing members of your team and the wider community, including managing a small number of staff.

DESIRABLE

Experience with React or similar technologies.
Familiarity with the Microsoft agent ecosystem.
Experience creating reusable deployment patterns and implementation assets.
Experience working in consulting, customer-facing or delivery roles.
Awareness of responsible AI and AI evaluation practices.
Active participation in technology communities and knowledge sharing, internally and externally.

Who You Are

Our vision is to enable outstanding people to create digital solutions that have a positive impact on people’s lives. Our values aren’t abstract; they are the behaviours we expect from each other every day and underpin everything that we do. We expect everyone to display our values by being determined
in how obstacles are overcome; honest
when dealing with others; respectful
of how you treat others; creative
to find solutions to complex problems and cooperative
by sharing information, knowledge and experience.

These values, applied collectively, help to produce an outstanding Kainos person, team and culture.

About Us

Actonomy is a Kainos team focused on developing innovative AI products that solve real problems and create meaningful impact. We bring together deep technical expertise and a passion for AI to build intelligent, agentic solutions on the Azure stack.

We work at the frontier of what’s possible with AI – exploring new architectures, pushing platform boundaries and building products that make people’s working lives better.

As part of Kainos, we benefit from a culture built on collaboration, continuous learning and doing the right thing. For more information, see kainos.com

Embracing our differences  

At Kainos, we believe in the power of diversity, equity and inclusion. We are committed to building a team that is as diverse as the world we live in, where everyone is valued, respected, and given an equal chance to thrive.   We actively seek out talented people from all backgrounds, regardless of age, race, ethnicity, gender, sexual orientation, religion, disability, or any other characteristic that makes them who they are.   We also believe every candidate deserves a level playing field.

Our friendly talent acquisition team is here to support you every step of the way, so if you require any accommodations or adjustments, we encourage you to reach out.

By combining powerful analytics with AI that knows your business, Mixpanel helps teams see what’s working, diagnose what’s not, and decide what to build next. Learn more at mixpanel.com.

As a member of the Delivery Engineer team, you will own the post-sales onboarding and data health for customers. You will work and consult with GTM team members and a diverse array of customers to successfully roll out product analytics to their organization and execute on technical projects and services that delight our customers.

Shape and embed The AA’s critical data governance operating model across a large, complex organisation

Which has been recognised by Sunday Times “Best Places to Work” for the last two years.

Job Description

This is the Job

As a Solution Architect
, you’ll play a senior role within major transformation programmes, owning solution direction from early discovery through to delivery. You’ll turn complex business requirements and outcomes into coherent, scalable and secure architectures, with a particular focus on solutions involving Microsoft Dynamics 365 and its integration across our wider technology landscape.

Working across Business, Architecture, Product, Engineering, Delivery and Operations, you’ll provide the architectural direction needed to turn ambition into deliverable solutions. You’ll evaluate options and trade-offs, own High Level Designs and take solutions through architecture governance, providing engineering teams with clear decisions, principles and guardrails for detailed design and implementation.

This is a highly visible role where you’ll bring structure to complex transformation challenges and influence decisions at senior level. You’ll work closely with Programme Directors, Business Owners and technology leadership, communicating architectural options, risks and recommendations in clear business language while remaining engaged throughout Agile delivery.

Key Responsibilities

Own the end-to-end solution architecture for large, complex transformation initiatives, from early discovery and requirements through governance, engineering handover and delivery
Architect solutions involving Microsoft Dynamics 365, ensuring effective integration with enterprise applications, data platforms, digital channels and legacy technologies
Translate business capabilities and outcomes into coherent architectures spanning applications, integration, data, security, resilience, nonfunctional requirements and operational considerations
Produce Solution Options Papers and High-Level Designs, assessing technology, business, commercial, delivery and operational trade-offs and setting clear architectural direction and guardrails
Lead solutions through formal architecture governance, including design reviews, Architecture Decision Records and governance boards, responding to challenge and ensuring decisions and actions are progressed
Partner with Product, Engineering and Delivery teams throughout Agile transformation delivery, providing effective handover into detailed design while remaining engaged to resolve architectural issues, risks and dependencies

What Do I Need?

You’ll Bring

Proven experience operating as a Solution Architect within large, complex transformation programmes, owning solution direction from discovery through to delivery
Strong Microsoft Dynamics 365 architecture experience, including designing its integration with wider enterprise platforms, data, digital channels and legacy systems
Strong end to end solution design capability across applications, integration, data, security, resilience, operational requirements and nonfunctional requirements
Demonstrable experience producing Solution Options Papers and High-Level Designs, evaluating complex trade-offs and providing clear recommendations and architectural guardrails for engineering teams
Experience navigating formal architecture governance and working within Agile or product led delivery environments, evolving architecture iteratively alongside Product, Engineering and Delivery
Strong senior stakeholder leadership and influencing skills, with the ability to operate autonomously, navigate ambiguity and communicate complex architecture, options and risks clearly to stakeholders up to SteerCo and executive level

jobs.title: Senior Quality Engineer
jobs.description:
About The Job You're Considering

Capgemini are recruiting for experienced Quality Engineers at a Senior and Lead level.

We have vacancies for Senior and Lead Quality Engineers to join our dynamic team building solutions for our public sector client. Working with us will mean delivering critical digital services from cradle to grave working on a variety of projects featuring high-performance cloud platforms using Java based languages and technologies, and on-premises traditional infrastructure.

As a member of our self-empowered, multi-disciplined teams, you’ll have the freedom to shape the way you work using the latest industry practices, tools and technologies, while collaborating in our mature Agile environment alongside specialists from other disciplines.

Additionally, we expect Lead Quality Engineers to possess advanced technical expertise, strong problem-solving abilities, and a proven track record of leading complex engineering projects. This role requires a deep understanding of engineering principles, quality assurance, excellent communication skills, and the ability to work collaboratively in a dynamic environment.

Hybrid working:
Your working location will vary depending on your role, personal needs, and business requirements. This will typically include a mix of company offices, client sites, and remote work from home. If your location is Telford or Hove you will be expected to work from the office between 40% and 70% of the time. For all other locations you need to be prepared to come into the Telford or Hove office once to twice a month (Lead Engineers more frequently). As we align closely with customer requirements—which may change over time—you will need to remain flexible. Please note that fully remote working (100% from home) is not permitted.

Your role

As a Quality Engineer, you'll play a key role in assuring the quality of complex software solutions, working across both system-to-system and user interface-based projects. You'll collaborate closely with delivery teams to drive quality throughout the development lifecycle, applying modern engineering practices and helping teams build reliable, scalable, and high-performing solutions.

As a Senior Quality Engineer, you will:

Lead by example as a hands-on quality engineering practitioner, contributing to all aspects of software testing.
Design and execute test scenarios, scripts, and test data requirements, including working with external and third-party systems.
Shape and implement effective test automation strategies using industry best practices.
Develop automated tests using technologies such as Java, Scala, .NET, or JavaScript, and advocate for approaches including TDD and BDD.
Collaborate with stakeholders, architects, developers, and product teams to influence solution design and delivery planning.
Mentor and support junior engineers, promoting technical excellence, wellbeing, and professional development.

As a Lead Quality Engineer, you will additionally:

Provide technical leadership across quality engineering activities, ensuring successful delivery of high-quality solutions.
Define and drive quality engineering strategy, standards, and best practices across projects and programmes.
Champion innovation by identifying and implementing modern testing approaches, tools, and engineering solutions.
Lead collaboration across multiple teams and disciplines to enable seamless integration and delivery.
Act as a senior mentor and role model, developing engineering capability and fostering a culture of continuous learning.
Support the technical and career development of engineers through coaching, performance management, and leadership.

Our culture

We’re looking for people who are learning focused, challenge the status quo and are constantly looking to shape their working environment to make it an exciting, fun and interesting place to work.

Keeping things fresh is something we encourage in our working practices, but the culture of continuous improvement is equally as important in our technical approach to building and delivering modern digital services. Your knowledge and experience will be used to change the way we build solutions including utilising new tools and technologies to solve new problems or improve existing services.

Working on our services means you’ll be part of a team, but you’ll also be a part of communities of interest. This means you’ll always have people on hand to share and discuss ideas and get help when needed. The engineering organisation is engineering led, supporting each other through coaching and mentoring, so if you want to change something it’s within your power to do so.

Your Skills And Experience

We are looking for someone with a strong understanding of the QA process, knowledge in defining, implementing test designs and broad experience across test levels.

Hands-on experience using and maintaining automated test frameworks (e.g, Cucumber, JUnit)
Knowledge of stubbing / mocking frameworks such as Wiremock
Understanding of Non-Functional testing such as Performance, Security or Accessibility testing
Experience / Understanding of Git or other version control systems
Strong experience of iterative / incremental software delivery
Hands on experience of all levels of the test automation pyramid
Experienced in API testing and tools
Experienced in Functional or System Testing
Experience using project management tooling (e.g. JIRA)
Good knowledge of Agile methodologies
Excellent written and oral communication skills, strong problem-solving & collaborative skills
Proactive, looks for areas of improvement

Additional competencies for Lead Engineer:

Advanced Technical Skills: Strong understanding of the QA process, knowledge in defining, implementing test designs and broad experience across test levels, with a deep understanding of engineering principles and best practice. Flexibility and adaptability are expected to acquire new skills to match industry demands and customer expectations.
Problem-Solving: Strong analytical and problem-solving skills, with the ability to troubleshoot complex issues.
Communication: Excellent verbal and written communication skills, with the ability to convey technical information clearly and effectively. High levels of emotional intelligence to connect with and develop our engineering talent pool.
Project Management: Proven experience in managing and leading engineering projects from conception to completion. Strong business skills to drive value for our clients while maintaining sustainable profitability.
Team Collaboration: Ability to work effectively in a team environment, with strong interpersonal skills.
Influence: To assess and apply change across our organisation, shaping and maintaining a healthy culture. Define and promote best practice across our technical community.

We are a Disability Confident Employer

Capgemini is proud to be a Disability Confident Employer (Level 2) under the UK Government’s Disability Confident scheme.

As part of our commitment to inclusive recruitment, we will offer an interview to all candidates who:

Declare they have a disability, and

Meet the minimum essential criteria for the role.

Please opt in during the application process.

Your security clearance

To be successfully appointed to this role, it is a requirement to obtain Security Check (SC) clearance.

To obtain SC clearance, the successful applicant must have resided continuously within the United Kingdom for the last 5 years, along with other criteria and requirements.

Throughout the recruitment process, you will be asked questions about your security clearance eligibility such as, but not limited to, country of residence and nationality.

Some posts are restricted to sole UK Nationals for security reasons; therefore, you may be asked about your citizenship in the application process.

Make it real – what does it mean for you?

You will be empowered to explore, innovate, and progress. You will benefit from Capgemini’s ‘learning for life’ mindset, meaning you will have countless training and development opportunities from thinktanks to hackathons, and access to 250,000 courses with numerous external certifications from AWS, Microsoft, Harvard ManageMentor, Cybersecurity qualifications and much more.

You’ll be bringing your unique skills and perspectives to the team, inspiring and taking inspiration from your teammates as you unlock value in everything you do. You’ll be joining a professional community of experts, who have got your back and will support you, every step of the way.

Why you should consider Capgemini

Growing clients’ businesses while building a more sustainable, more inclusive future is a tough ask. When you join Capgemini, you’ll join a thriving company and become part of a collective of freethinkers, entrepreneurs and industry experts. We find new ways technology can help us reimagine what’s possible. It’s why, together, we seek out opportunities that will transform the world’s leading businesses, and it’s how you’ll gain the experiences and connections you need to shape your future. By learning from each other every day, sharing knowledge, and always pushing yourself to do better, you’ll build the skills you want. You’ll use your skills to help our clients leverage technology to innovate and grow their business. So, it might not always be easy, but making the world a better place rarely is.

About Capgemini

Capgemini is the business transformation partner for enterprises in the age of AI. We help organisations imagine and build an intelligent, sustainable future, combining AI, technology and human ingenuity to transform how they operate, innovate and grow. With unique end-to-end capabilities spanning strategy, technology, engineering and intelligent operations, we bring together deep industry expertise and market-leading capabilities in AI, cloud and data to turn ambition into measurable business outcomes at scale. Supported by a robust ecosystem of partners and nearly 60 years of expertise, Capgemini is a responsible and diverse global organization of over 410,000 team members in more than 50 countries. The Group reported 2025 revenues of €22.5 billion.

Make it real | www.capgemini.com

Build and modernise digital services that support thousands of people and businesses across the UK.

The Insolvency Service, in partnership with Inspire People, is looking for a Senior .NET Developer to join its Digital Services team and help modernise and improve a portfolio of digital services used by colleagues, businesses and the public. Permanent role, salary £48,429 - £57,722 (based on assessment at interview), 29% employer pension contribution plus full Civil Service benefits. Flexible, hybrid working from 9 UK locations.

About the Senior Developer role

This role will join the Digital Services team, part of Change and Technology Services within the Insolvency Service, supporting enterprise applications used by internal teams, external organisations and the general public.

The team is consolidating its technology stack and moving away from legacy services, with a growing focus on Microsoft .NET 10 and Azure. This is a strong opportunity to help modernise digital services, influence technical approaches and contribute to a more sustainable, user-centred technology environment.

The role will also contribute to the ongoing improvement of a portfolio of live digital services, helping reduce technical debt, improve consistency across the technology estate and support faster, more effective delivery of future change.

Responsibilities of a Senior Developer

Design, develop and maintain secure, accessible and maintainable applications across enterprise digital services.
Deliver functionality against agreed user stories, acceptance criteria and Agile delivery objectives.
Take ownership of code quality through automated testing, peer reviews, defect prevention and addressing technical debt.
Contribute to architectural discussions, engineering standards, reusable components and common development approaches.
Support live services through incident resolution, releases, deployments, documentation and ongoing continuous improvement.

Essential criteria for a Senior Developer

C# and .NET development experience within modern web applications.
Experience of modern engineering practices including TDD/BDD, automated testing, CI/CD and DevOps.
Good understanding of integration approaches including APIs, real-time, scheduled, batch and messaging services.
Experience working with cloud-based IaaS and PaaS solutions, alongside strong knowledge of secure and maintainable software development.
Strong analytical, problem-solving and communication skills, with the ability to contribute to technical discussions, share knowledge and support colleagues.

Desirable criteria for a Senior Developer

Experience working with Microsoft Azure services such as Azure SQL, Cosmos DB, App Services, Function Apps and AI Search.
Knowledge of clean architecture, OOP, SOLID, RESTful APIs and GitHub-based development workflows.
Experience of GOV.UK standards, including the Service Manual and Technology Code of Practice.

Benefits

Alongside your salary of up to £57,722, Insolvency Service contributes £14,029 towards you being a member of the Civil Service Defined Benefit Pension scheme. We want you to have a good work-life balance and want to support you in all that you do, so they offer a great benefits package including:

Flexible working arrangements and flexi-time
25 days annual leave, increasing to 30 days after 5 years’ service
8 public/bank holidays plus 1 additional privilege day
Competitive maternity, paternity and parental leave
5 days paid learning and development leave
5 days paid volunteering leave
Cycle to Work scheme
Access to Workplace Wellness, the employee assistance programme offering confidential and independent support and advice

Office locations

The role is open across 9 of Insolvency Service locations:
Birmingham, Cardiff, Edinburgh, Exeter, Ipswich, Leeds, Manchester, Newcastle and Nottingham

Additional Requirements

Expectation is to spend 60% of your working time in one of the offices.
This role operates under the flexible working hours agreement, supporting a positive work-life balance
The post is subject to SC level clearance, a requirement for which you must have resided in the UK for a minimum of 5 years.

The Insolvency Service does not
currently hold this licence and therefore cannot legally sponsor Skilled Worker visa applicants.

Why join

This is an opportunity to join the Insolvency Service at an important point in its technology journey.

You will be working on a wider programme to maintain, improve and modernise more than 10 digital services, helping the team move away from older applications and inconsistent technologies towards a more focused and maintainable Microsoft-based environment.
You will have the opportunity to improve live services, influence engineering standards, contribute to technical decisions and work with modern development practices across a collaborative Digital Services team.

Apply now to contact Inspire People in complete confidence.

jobs.description:
Birmingham, Cardiff, Edinburgh, Exeter, Ipswich, Leeds, Manchester, Newcastle and Nottingham. (Croydon and Stratford will only be available to existing employees of the Insolvency Service).

Job Summary

The Insolvency Service is a leading government agency which plays a crucial role in providing essential services to the public and to business. The work we do is important to the proper functioning of markets, the economy in general and support for thousands of people each year who are in financial difficulty.

We have an exciting opportunity for a talented, enthusiastic Senior .net Developer within the Insolvency Service Digital Services team working on a programme of work to maintain, improve and modernise our line-of-business applications.

Inclusive and diverse teams are important to us. We welcome and encourage applications from everyone, including groups underrepresented in our workforce. The Insolvency Service strives to ensure that the agency is a safe, inclusive, and welcoming place for everybody to bring their true self to work and to help the agency to achieve its diversity objectives. We have 9 active employee network groups available to join or become an ally, these include, Carers Network, Disability network group, Employee Assistance, Representatives, FACES Network Group, LGBT+, Mind Matters, Part Time Workers, The Shed - Men’s Network Group and Women’s Network Group.

We value capability, technical skills and experience and we place great emphasis on lifetime development to support our people. We encourage our employees to become more involved in areas they feel strongly about, whether it be for the benefit of the agency, through our Engagement network or in their own local communities via volunteering opportunities.

The Insolvency Service is a great place to work, learn and grow your career!

If you would like to find out more about the role, the team and what it's like to work at the Insolvency Service, we are holding a Hiring Manager Q&A session for this role where you can virtually meet the team on 5th October at 16.00-17.00. Please click here to reserve your place.

Job Description

The successful candidate will be working on the Digital Service team (part of the Change Technology Services within the Insolvency Service) responsible for enterprise line-of-business applications used by both internal and external organisations as well as the general public.

We are consolidating our technology stack and moving away from legacy services to focus on the use Microsoft's .net 10 framework and Azure services, so this is a fantastic opportunity to help shape our technology and the way we work for a sustainable, user-centric future. We would love to for you to be part of that new team.

Responsibilities

Software Development:

design, develop and maintain application code
implement functionality that satisfies agreed user stories and acceptance criteria
ensure solutions are secure, accessible, performant and maintainable
participate in architectural and technical discussions
contribute to the continuous improvement of products and services

Quality Engineering:

create and maintain automated unit and integration tests
take ownership of code quality and defect prevention
participate in peer reviews and provide constructive feedback
follow agreed coding standards and development practices
address technical debt and quality concerns where identified
support defect investigation and resolution

Agile Delivery:

participate fully in Agile ceremonies
contribute to estimation, planning and forecasting activities
keep work items up to date and communicate progress clearly
escalate blockers and risks through appropriate channels
support the team in achieving sprint and delivery objectives

Standards, Patterns And Practices:

contribute to the development and evolution of engineering standards
promote reuse of shared components, libraries and services
support the adoption of common patterns and development approaches
share knowledge and lessons learned with colleagues
contribute to Communities of Practice and technical discussions

Operational Support:

assist in the investigation and resolution of production incidents
provide third-line support where required
monitor application health and identify improvement opportunities
support releases, deployments and post-release activities
ensure application documentation remains accurate and up to date

jobs.title: Software Developer (Cloud & Data)
jobs.description:
Job Description

What if you could do the kind of work the world needs?

At WSP, you can access our global scale, contribute to landmark projects and connect with the brightest minds in your field to do the best work of your life. You can embrace your curiosity in a culture that celebrates new ideas and diverse perspectives. You can experience a world of opportunity and the chance to shape a career as unique as you.

WSP is looking for an experienced Software Developer (Cloud & Data) to join our industry-leading Intelligent Infrastructure team. We provide technical professional services to transport clients throughout the UK and overseas to deliver tangible value through technology enabled change.

Join us and make a real-world difference by helping to deliver crucial projects for public sector clients, such as using big data to help the DfT provide better rail services, helping road safety officers visualise accident data geospatially, or gathering vital transport planning data using AI-enabled traffic cameras that distinguish and count the different modes of transport.

As a WSP Software Developer (Cloud & Data), you will play a key role in technical delivery while also leading tasks within a team to provide quality assurance, consultancy, and advisory services on client-facing projects. In addition to challenging and stimulating projects, you will be able to access a range of benefits, including targeted professional development and training to help you grow and develop at WSP.

A Little More About Your Role…

Design, build and maintain secure, scalable software, cloud and data solutions using industry best practices, ensuring security and compliance.
Scope, estimate, and take ownership of delivery for assigned tasks and projects, managing workload and dependencies to deliver within agreed timeframes.
Engage with clients and stakeholders to understand their needs, capture requirements, and ensure a shared understanding of project objectives
Lead technical tasks and work packages, coordinating activities, managing dependencies and providing technical direction to ensure successful delivery of outcomes.
Perform quality assurance reviews of project documentation or consultancy deliverables, ensuring accuracy, clarity, and alignment with best practices and client requirements
Support and maintain new and legacy applications, cloud services and data platforms, ensuring timely and effective resolution of issues while maintaining clear communication with stakeholders.
Provide consultancy and advisory services, guiding clients on software engineering, cloud adoption, data architecture and technical best practices.
Input to the continuous improvement of practice and standards within the team
Maintain and develop your own expertise by staying current with emerging technologies, pursuing relevant certifications, and through continuous learning
Coach and mentor junior colleagues, providing guidance, support, and constructive feedback to help them develop their skills and confidence

Your Team…

This role sits within the Intelligent Infrastructure business and will form a key part of the growing Data, Architecture and Solutions Capability, which is our centre of excellence for digital skills. The Capability team provides a community of colleagues working in and around technology to help you deliver effectively and support your professional development through training, mentoring and opportunities to really stretch your capabilities.
You'll work as part of an Agile team of developers, testers, analysts and transport specialists to design, build, deploy and maintain cloud-based applications, data solutions and digital services. Using technologies such as Python, .NET, Azure, DevOps and AI capabilities enabled through our Microsoft partnership, you'll deliver innovative solutions that help make journeys greener, safer, cheaper and faster.
We operate a hybrid working policy and expect colleagues to spend time on client sites and collaborating with colleagues face-to-face, as well as working from a local office. We have offices across the UK.

What We Will Be Looking For You To Demonstrate…

Experience designing, building and supporting enterprise-scale applications and services using ASP.NET and Microsoft Azure, supported by relevant certifications and qualifications. Experience with Python would be highly beneficial.
Experience designing and implementing cloud-native solutions and data-driven applications, including integration, transformation and management of data within cloud environments
Experience working across the Azure platform, with the ability to independently deliver cloud-based solutions whether involving applications, data pipelines, DevOps tooling, automation, integration or other Azure services
Experience of semantic modelling, metadata management and enterprise data architecture, applying these practices to support scalable, governed and reusable data solutions.
Experience applying secure software development practices, including OWASP guidelines, identity and access management, secrets management and basic threat modelling.
Strong analytical and problem-solving skills, with the ability to think creatively and develop practical solutions to complex technical challenges.
Experience working within Agile delivery teams and deploying applications and services through DevOps practices and CI/CD pipelines in production environments.
Demonstrable experience of testing throughout the software delivery lifecycle, including unit, integration, ETL, regression and end-to-end testing.
Excellent communication and stakeholder engagement skills, with experience working directly with clients and customers to provide credible technical advice and guidance.
Experience conducting quality assurance activities and technical reviews to ensure the reliability, maintainability and compliance of software, cloud and data solutions.
Experience providing guidance and applying best practices in cloud architecture, data architecture and software engineering.
A degree in an analytical discipline such as Engineering, Mathematics, Computer Science, Economics, Data Science, Social Sciences, or equivalent industry experience.

Imagine a better future for you and a better future for us all.

Join our close-knit community of talented individuals who share your passion for making a positive impact. Our global team includes more than 69,000 employees, working together to make a difference in communities both close to home and around the world.

With us, you can. Apply today.

About Us

We are one of the world’s leading engineering and professional services firms. Our passionate people are united by the common purpose of creating positive, long-lasting impacts on the communities we serve through a culture of innovation, integrity, and inclusion. With over 11,000 professionals across the UK and Ireland, we are dedicated to our local communities and propelled by international brainpower.

WHAT’S IN IT FOR YOU?

Work-life balance

At WSP, we understand that work is just one aspect of your life. It’s important to make time for you, your family, friends, interests and your community.

Our hybrid working policy offers the flexibility to work from home two days a week, while also providing opportunities to collaborate in our modern offices across the UK.

Inclusivity & Belonging

We welcome applicants with varied backgrounds and experiences. We enable rewarding careers by encouraging people to bring their whole and authentic selves to work so that our work represents the fullest spectrum of society. We celebrate integrity and treat people with respect, supporting each other and embracing a culture of inclusion and belonging at WSP. We have our employee resource groups bring together employees and allies with different backgrounds to promote a culture of inclusivity.

Health & Wellbeing

We are committed to supporting our people, giving you the tools to make improvements to your health and wellbeing through our Thrive programme.

Our Virtual GP service gives you access to an NHS or Irish Medical Council GP at a time and place that suits you – giving you peace of mind and quick access to medical advice when you need it most. We also provide reasonable workplace adjustments for those in need. Additionally, you can benefit from the Gymflex scheme, which offers up to 40% off annual gym memberships through our WSP flexible benefits program, as well as a comprehensive menopause support package.

Flex your time

To enhance work-life balance, WSP offers the “WSP My Hour,” allowing you to take one hour each day for personal activities, with the flexibility to make up the time earlier or later that day.

We also provide part-time and flexible working arrangements, the option to purchase additional leave, and the ability to use your bank holiday entitlement to suit you.

Your development

We understand the importance of development and training to you. That’s why we foster a supportive environment that invests in your growth, whether through training, mentoring, or Chartership.

#WeAreWSP

Here at WSP we positively encourage applications from suitably qualified and eligible candidates regardless of sex, race, disability, age, sexual orientation, gender reassignment, religion or belief, marital status, pregnancy or maternity/paternity. As a Disability Confident leader, we will interview all disabled applicants who meet the essential criteria, please let us know if you require any workplace adjustments in support of your application.

Show more

Show less

Seniority level

Not Applicable

Employment type

Full-time

Job function

Engineering and Information Technology

Industries

Professional Services

jobs.title: Client Technology - Engineering - Architecture
jobs.description:
At EY, we’re all in to shape your future with confidence.

We’ll help you succeed in a globally connected powerhouse of diverse teams and take your career wherever you want it to go. Join EY and help to build a better working world.

The opportunity

We are looking for a candidate who will be part of the Architecture team within the EY Client Technology’s Technology Strategy and Architecture (TS&A) function. The candidate will be responsible for defining and delivering architectures and designs for business-critical global products and platforms, hosted in a variety of infrastructure/environments considering reusability, scalability and reliability in alignment with EY’s mission and strategy!

Your Key Responsibilities

Build relationships across the business to understand their requirements, strategy and help them build product/platform roadmaps, demonstrate architecture leadership to translate business requirements into architecture blueprints, as well as innovative and practical design (both high and low level).
Own the overall technology, architecture and design landscape of the product/platform from solutioning to delivery to adoption and sale phases.
Potentially lead a team of architects in a portfolio or large product, set the overall technology and architecture direction and own its end-to-end delivery in a lead architect’s capacity, along with providing constant architecture governance and guidance.
Solve complex problems in realms where solutions may not currently exist, necessitating the ideation and incubation of the new solutions/ways of working/technologies, technical feasibility and buy/build analysis, vendor product evaluations, proof of concepts (with hands-on) and presenting various options to the business with appropriate recommendations.
Work very closely with multi-disciplinary teams (e.g. engineering, platform, infosec) to deliver the envisioned architectures and design using optimized delivery approaches, in compliance to enterprise standards, practices, policies and guidelines.
Provide leadership in product delivery to build and consume reusable functional and technical assets. Identify, define and implement the reusable assets and standards.
Provide support to product and project managers in building the plans, forecast, estimations and costs for new as well as existing products/platforms, to build the appropriate balance between costs, risks and quality.
Provides coaching, mentoring and support to development teams during the delivery phase across the eco-system, frameworks and platforms. Ensure that the developed artifacts comply to envisioned architecture and design, expected quality, recommended standards/practices with code reviews and various levels of architecture, design and quality reviews.
Contribute to architecture and development standards/guidelines to promote optimization and consistency.
Have the ability to work across multiple projects with varied stakeholders. An architect sets architectural direction, builds consensus, mediates conflicts providing technical leadership and advisory services to the business. He/she anticipates needs and potential objections and helps to create an environment which solicits positive contributions from all participants.
Demonstrate good interpersonal communication and organizational skills that are required to operate as a leading member of global, distributed teams that deliver quality services and solutions.
Cultivate lasting relationships across business, IT and vendors / industry analysts to maintain insight into the broader enterprise as well as industry trends. Understand new trends and emerging technologies, and how they apply to EY. Evangelize and encourage the importance of technical quality, emerging technologies, sharing & experimentation across the org through mentoring, hackathons, communities etc

Skills And Attributes For Success

Led and governed a global team of solution architects and technical architects, driving the technology and architecture landscape of large and complex portfolio of products/solutions/projects, achieving success in its implementation and adoption.
Architecture leadership skills, advanced understanding and practical experience of architecture role with proven track record in a complex, large-scale (team size in hundreds), global product/platform (user base in hundreds, thousands and more) ecosystem across the entire lifecycle from planning to delivery to support/operations and adoption. Proven ability to work with business as well as perform hands-on technology delivery work in architect’s capacity using various architecture and design tools.
Hands-on deep experience of one or more specialization of solution and technical architecture role e.g. application, infrastructure/cloud, integration, data and security architectures and successful delivery of functional as well as non-functional aspects of a product/platform, using native cloud, full-stack application, data, security, AI technologies, following Agile, DevSecOps and automation practices.
Expert-level skills in defining, designing and developing distributed and scalable products and platforms, using reusable domain-specific composable (micro) services running on containers on multi-platform/hybrid clouds (Microsoft Azure preferred) using the respective cloud IaaS/PaaS/SaaS services.
Expert-level skills in multiple application programming and scripting languages (JavaScript, .NET, Java, Python, C++, etc), SQL and noSQL databases, Bigdata and its processing, Data analytics and Machine Learning, Industry’s recommended authentication/authorization technologies. Microsoft and Azure based technology skills are preferred.
Ability to adopt and relate new technologies to the set of problems we face at EY while adhering to security and other EY standards.
Understanding of business and organizational strategy and ability to communicate solutions, ideas, suggestions to business partners effectively and comprehensibly.
In-depth knowledge of various design patterns, and architectural styles (e.g., traditional application based as well as microservices and containers, event-driven, data streaming, data transformations and analytics)
Strong collaboration, analytical, interpersonal and communication abilities.

Ideally, you’ll also

Bachelor’s Degree or equivalent in Engineering, Computer Science, IT, Mathematics, Economics.
15+ years overall IT industry experience, with 5+ years in a solution or technical architect role using service and hosting solutions such as private/public cloud IaaS, PaaS and SaaS platforms.
Achieved one or more of the typical solution and technical architecture certifications e.g. Microsoft, MS Azure Certification, TOGAF, AWS Cloud Certified, Pivotal, CISSIP, Zachman, ITIL, Cisco, (ISC)2, CEH, SAFe, PMI, and SAP etc
Thought leadership - presenting ideas, products, concept papers to varied audiences, building point of views and presenting them in industry forums/event.
Experience in designing and implementation of business use-cases using low-code/no-code, Generative AI, data reporting, data management and governance technologies, mobile applications, deep cloud security concepts.

What We Look For

We want people who are self-starters, who can take initiative and get things done. If you can think critically and creatively to solve problems, you will excel. You should be comfortable working with culturally diverse outsourced on/offshore team members which means you may need to work outside of the normal working hours in your time zone to partner with other Client Technology staff globally. Some travel may also be required, both domestic and international.

This job posting relates to an existing vacancy within our organization.

What We Offer You (Canada)

We offer a competitive compensation package where you’ll be rewarded based on your performance and recognized for the value you bring to our business. In addition, our Total Rewards package allows you to decide which benefits are right for you and which ones help you create a solid foundation for your future. Our Total Rewards package includes a discretionary bonus program, a comprehensive medical, prescription drug and dental coverage plan, a defined contribution pension plan, a great vacation policy plus firm paid days that allow you to enjoy longer long weekends throughout the year, statutory holidays and paid personal days (based on province of residence), and a range of exciting programs and benefits designed to support your physical, financial and social well-being. Plus, we offer:

Support and coaching from some of the most engaging colleagues in the industry
Learning opportunities to develop new skills and progress your career
The freedom and flexibility to handle your role in a way that’s right for you

Are you ready to shape your future with confidence? Apply today.

To help create the best experience during the recruitment process, please describe any accommodation you may need.

Inclusiveness at EY

Inclusiveness is at the heart of who we are and how we work. We’re committed to fostering an environment where differences are valued, policies and practices are equitable, and our people feel a sense of belonging. We embrace diversity and are committed to combating systemic racism, advancing gender equity and women in leadership, advocating for the 2SLGBTQIA+ community, promoting our neuroinclusion and accessibility initiatives, and are dedicated to amplifying the voices of Indigenous peoples (First Nations, Inuit, and Métis) nationally as we strive towards reconciliation. Our diverse experiences, abilities, backgrounds, and perspectives make our people unique and help guide us. Because when people feel free to be their authentic selves at work, they bring their best and are empowered to build a better working world.

Learn about our commitment to Inclusiveness at https://www.ey.com/en_ca/about-us/corporate-responsibility/equity

What We Offer You

The compensation ranges below are provided in order to comply with United States pay transparency laws. Other geographies will follow their local salary guidelines, which may not be a direct conversion of published US salary ranges. At EY, we’ll develop you with future-focused skills and equip you with world-class experiences. We’ll empower you in a flexible environment, and fuel you and your extraordinary talents in a diverse and inclusive culture of globally connected teams. Learn more.

We offer a comprehensive compensation and benefits package where you’ll be rewarded based on your performance and recognized for the value you bring to the business. The base salary range for this job in all geographic locations in the US is $138,200 to $266,000. The base salary range for New York City Metro Area, Washington State and California (excluding Sacramento) is $165,800 to $302,300. Individual salaries within those ranges are determined through a wide variety of factors including but not limited to education, experience, knowledge, skills and geography. In addition, our Total Rewards package includes medical and dental coverage, pension and 401(k) plans, and a wide range of paid time off options.
Join us in our team-led and leader-enabled hybrid model. Our expectation is for most people in external, client serving roles to work together in person 40-60% of the time over the course of an engagement, project or year.
Under our flexible vacation policy, you’ll decide how much vacation time you need based on your own personal circumstances. You’ll also be granted time off for designated EY Paid Holidays, Winter/Summer breaks, Personal/Family Care, and other leaves of absence when needed to support your physical, financial, and emotional well-being.
