jobs.title: Senior Engineering Manager - 9-10 month FTC
jobs.description:
We’re the Moonpig Group – home to Moonpig, Greetz, Red Letter Days and Buyagift – and we’re on a mission to make people feel loved, celebrated and remembered. Whether it’s a card that gets them laughing out loud or a gift that makes their day, we help people stay close, no matter the miles.

We’re proud to be leading the online gifting revolution, with brilliant products, clever tech and a whole lot of heart. Our platform makes it easy to create moments that matter – packed with personal touches and delivered with care.

We’re not just about selling cards or gifts – we’re here to spread joy, spark smiles and make every celebration feel extra special. And with values that guide how we work and support one another, we’ve built a place where people (and ideas) can truly thrive.

If you’re looking to make an impact, bring your spark and be part of something meaningful – we’d love to have you on the team. 🌙🐷

Senior Engineering Manager – Maternity Cover | 📍Manchester or London – Hybrid (1–2 days per week) | 💰Competitive Salary + Benefits
About the Role
We’re looking for a Senior Engineering Manager
to join Moonpig on a fixed-term maternity cover contract of around 9–10 months
, with availability to start in November 2026
.

You’ll provide people and technical leadership across teams within our Top of Funnel area, helping millions of customers navigate, discover and explore Moonpig’s product catalogue. It’s a role for someone who enjoys building strong engineering teams while staying connected to the technology, product direction and decisions that shape what we build.

People leadership will be a big part of your role. You’ll coach and support engineers, foster an inclusive and collaborative environment, and help people grow their skills, confidence and ownership. Alongside this, you’ll partner closely with Product, Design and Engineering Leads to shape roadmaps, explore opportunities and make thoughtful decisions about our technical direction.

You’ll stay close enough to the technology to contribute meaningfully to conversations around architecture, engineering quality and delivery, while empowering engineers to make decisions at the right level.

Our expectations of our Engineering Managers:

Building culture:
“Culture eats process for breakfast” and we wholeheartedly believe this. As an Engineering Manager you are responsible for fostering a growth culture and contributing to our management best practices. You help us become an exceptional place to work for the ambitious, highly motivated people we hire. Your team of engineers are responsible for various services and you advocate the mantra “You build it, you run it”. At the end of the day, you have a massive influence on our overall engineering quality and culture and you actively work to continuously improve this

People progression:
As an Engineering Manager you are also expected to focus on the progression of people. Fifty percent of your time will be focussed on coaching, 121’s, mentoring and driving a high performance engineering culture. You need to be empathetic towards an individual’s needs and ensure we support and grow our engineers. You’ll identify which skill sets are required for the successful delivery of projects, coaching or recruiting engineers to cover any skill shortages

Driving good Engineering:
As an Engineering Manager you’ll lead by example, demonstrating best practices, working with your engineers through regular pairing sessions or providing technical leadership to help deliver new features, ensuring that the design and development of our systems adhere to good engineering principles

Key Responsibilities:

Lead and support engineers through regular 1:1s, coaching, timely feedback, career development and performance conversations

Foster an inclusive, collaborative and learning-focused engineering culture where people feel comfortable sharing ideas, challenging decisions and learning from each other

Partner with Product and Design to shape roadmaps and product direction, bringing an engineering perspective to discovery, prioritisation and trade-offs

Help engineers get involved early in discovery and problem shaping rather than Engineering operating solely as a downstream delivery function

Stay close to system design, architecture and technical direction, helping teams make high-quality decisions without becoming the default decision-maker

Encourage pragmatic technical choices that favour simplicity and make effective use of existing software and shared capabilities

Support Engineering Leads and teams with planning, estimation, sequencing, dependencies, risks and transparent communication around delivery

Balance customer and business outcomes with appropriate investment in reliability, maintainability and longer-term engineering quality

Champion strong engineering practices, including test-driven development and automated testing, helping teams build quality into the development process

Support strong operational ownership through CI/CD, observability, production support and the principle that teams own the systems they build and run

Help teams identify and address technical debt sustainably while maintaining appropriate technical and operational documentation

Build technical leadership throughout the teams, using the experience and strengths of engineers at different levels rather than concentrating technical authority in one role

Collaborate across Product, Design, Data/Data Science, CRM, Commercial and specialist functions where relevant, creating clarity around priorities, risks, dependencies and trade-offs

Support team capability planning, identifying opportunities to develop skills and strengthen engineering capability

About You:

Experience leading software engineering teams as an Engineering Manager, Senior Engineering Manager or in a comparable people-leadership role

Strong people leadership experience, including coaching, career development, feedback and performance management

Engineering expertise with enough technical depth to contribute credibly to full-stack and cloud system design, architecture, engineering quality and operational conversations

A collaborative leadership style that enables engineers and Engineering Leads to own decisions rather than relying on the manager for every answer

Experience building strong Product and Engineering partnerships and involving engineers in discovery, problem shaping and roadmap decisions

Experience sharing accountability for customer or business outcomes and translating these into clear engineering priorities

Strong understanding of modern software engineering practices, including automated testing and TDD principles, CI/CD, observability and production ownership

Experience facilitating technical decisions, bringing the right people and evidence together and constructively challenging thinking when needed

Comfortable balancing feature delivery and experimentation with reliability, technical quality and sustainable engineering investment

Ability to collaborate and influence across disciplines while communicating technical decisions, risks and trade-offs clearly

Commitment to creating an inclusive environment where engineers can grow, challenge ideas, give and receive feedback and take meaningful ownership

Available to start in  November 2026
for the fixed-term maternity cover period

Our Tech Environment:

Our Top of Funnel teams work across full-stack customer experiences and highly scalable cloud and distributed systems. The environment includes:

C# / .NET and Node.js / TypeScript
across modern backend and full-stack development

React and GraphQL
within our web and API ecosystem

AWS
, including cloud and serverless architecture

OpenSearch
, alongside integrations with our content management, search and recommendations capabilities

Terraform
for infrastructure as code

GitHub/GitLab
and CI/CD practices supporting frequent, reliable delivery

Grafana and AWS CloudWatch
for monitoring and observability

Automated testing and engineering practices focused on building quality into the development lifecycle

Production health, incident management and strong operational ownership

Experimentation and data-informed product development, including A/B testing and hypothesis-led approaches

Sustainable technical debt management and technical documentation, including architecture and operational guidance

Hiring Manager Call 30mins

System design interview 60mins

Culture/team fit interview with Key Stakeholder 30mins

Offer! 🎉

Please note:
Our interview process may vary depending on the specific role, hiring team availability, or other business needs. We aim to keep candidates informed of any changes throughout the process.

What's in it for you?

We believe in empowering our team to do their best work. Enjoy:

💰 Competitive Pay & Bonuses: Plus, generous pension plans & staff discounts.

💆🏽 Wellbeing First: Private healthcare (UK) and mental health support 

🏖️ Flexible Working & Time Off: Generous holidays, hybrid working (1-3 days in office, depending on role/team) & up to 20 days of international working.

📈 Career Growth: Learning allowances, coaching & development programs.

Want to know more?

Explore our full benefits package: here

Check out our podcast , tech blog and product blog to hear more about how we work and what we're building!

Our Ways of Working:

We trust our colleagues to do what’s right and offer flexibility to support a balance between work and life. At the same time, face-to-face office time is an important and expected part of working at Moonpig Group. We believe regular in-person working supports collaboration, alignment, and effective decision-making. Candidates will have regular and ongoing time working from the office as part of their role, which will be discussed during the recruitment process.

Moonpig Group's Commitment to Equality, Diversity, and Inclusivity:

At Moonpig Group, we’re all about creating a workplace where everyone feels they truly belong. We celebrate what makes each of us unique, whether that’s our background, how we work best, or what matters most to us.

From working parents who need flexible hours to neurodiverse colleagues with specific working styles, we’re here to support our people in ways that work for them. Because when you feel valued and included, you can thrive, and so can we.

jobs.description:
Birmingham, Cardiff, Edinburgh, Exeter, Ipswich, Leeds, Manchester, Newcastle and Nottingham. (Croydon and Stratford will only be available to existing employees of the Insolvency Service).

Job Summary

The Insolvency Service is a leading government agency which plays a crucial role in providing essential services to the public and to business. The work we do is important to the proper functioning of markets, the economy in general and support for thousands of people each year who are in financial difficulty.

We have an exciting opportunity for a talented, enthusiastic Senior DevOps Engineer within our Digital Services team. We are responsible for developing, maintaining and supporting the agency’s line of business applications.

Inclusive and diverse teams are important to us. We welcome and encourage applications from everyone, including groups underrepresented in our workforce. The Insolvency Service strives to ensure that the agency is a safe, inclusive, and welcoming place for everybody to bring their true self to work and to help the agency to achieve its diversity objectives. We have 9 active employee network groups available to join or become an ally, these include, Carers Network, Disability network group, Employee Assistance, Representatives, FACES Network Group, LGBT+, Mind Matters, Part Time Workers, The Shed - Men’s Network Group and Women’s Network Group.

We value capability, technical skills and experience and we place great emphasis on lifetime development to support our people. We encourage our employees to become more involved in areas they feel strongly about, whether it be for the benefit of the agency, through our Engagement network or in their own local communities via volunteering opportunities.

The Insolvency Service is a great place to work, learn and grow your career!

If you would like to find out more about the role, the team and what it's like to work at the Insolvency Service, we are holding a Hiring Manager Q&A session for this role where you can virtually meet the team on 6th October at 10.00-11.00. Please click here to reserve your place.

Job Description

Digital Services has recently transitioned from a third-party DevOps model to a fully in house capability. We are standardising and consolidating our technology stack as we move away from legacy services, creating a fantastic opportunity for you to help shape our future digital landscape.

Digital Services is part of Change and Technology Services (CTS) who support and improve applications and systems across the agency’s IT landscape. CTS provide key services including digital services, cyber security, information governance, service architecture and technical governance.

Our DevOps team looks after the deployment and maintenance of our Digital Services in line with the Government’s Digital Service Standard and Technology Code of Practice. They work closely with delivery teams to ensure the products are secure and meet the demands of its users.

Responsibilities

As a Senior DevOps Engineer, you will:

provide subject matter expertise and guidance on Microsoft Azure
build and maintain Infrastructure as Code and CI/CD tooling
improve deployment pipelines, monitoring and observability across our digital products
ensure the stability, security and performance of production and non‑production environments
lead on incident investigation, root cause analysis, and service improvement
define and maintain DevOps standards, including IaC, observability, deployment patterns, and runbooks
support delivery teams with DevOps best practice and provide mentoring to junior engineers
produce clear, accurate documentation aligned to Digital Services standards
contribute to technical estimates and roadmap planning
provide coaching and mentoring to more junior colleagues

ideally have experience in software development

build strong relationships across Digital Services to support secure, stable delivery

possess extensive experience in a similar role using Microsoft Azure
possess significant CI/CD experience using Azure DevOps(ADO)/Team Foundation Server (TFS)

have demonstrable experience of running multiple applications in multiple environments in a large enterprise

have an active Security Clearance or be committed to gaining clearance within the first 6 months of joining

Alongside your salary of £48,429, Insolvency Service contributes £14,029 towards you being a member of the Civil Service Defined Benefit Pension scheme. Find out what benefits a Civil Service Pension provides (opens in a new window).

Benefits

We want you to have a good work-life balance and want to support you in all that you do, so we offer a great benefits package including:

flexible working arrangements and flexi-time
full time new entrants to the Civil Service and those Civil Servants on modernised terms and conditions will be entitled to 25 days leave increasing on a sliding scale to 30 days after 5 years’ service
in addition to this you are entitled to 8 public/bank holidays plus an additional day of privilege leave
competitive maternity, paternity and parental leave

This means, if you pay tax, your take-home pay will not be reduced by the full amount of your contribution; and your pension will continue to provide valuable benefits for you and your family if you are too ill to continue to work or die before you retire. For more information, visit www.civilservicepensionscheme.org.uk

Candidates who are longlisted will be invited to complete a short, pre-recorded video screening interview. Alternatively, written responses may be provided in place of the video interview. jobs.title: Full-Stack Engineer with .NET and Angular
jobs.description:
Technology is our how. And people are our why. For over two decades, we have been harnessing technology to drive meaningful change.

By combining world-class engineering, industry expertise and a people-centric mindset, we consult and partner with leading brands from various industries to create dynamic platforms and intelligent digital experiences that drive innovation and transform businesses.

From prototype to real-world impact - be part of a global shift by doing work that matters.

Job Description

As part of Endava's strategic partnership with WTW, who provide data-driven, insight-led solutions in the areas of people, risk and capital, we're building dedicated software engineering teams to support WTW's Insurance Consulting and Technology Division.

WTW's Insurance Consulting and Technology business is a global leader in P&C, Life and Health insurance software and advisory services, with over 1,700 colleagues across 35 markets. More than 1,000 insurers worldwide trust our combination of advisory insight and advanced software to help them navigate complexity and drive sustainable growth.

Joining Endava, you'll work exclusively with WTW to help embed AI-enabled engineering practices, modern ways of working and deep insurance technology expertise, contributing to the next generation of products and services for insurers worldwide. Working as part of a dedicated team established through a Build-Operate-Transfer (BOT) model, you'll collaborate closely with WTW while building your career as an Endava employee, supporting the long-term success of this strategic partnership.

About the Role

In this role, you will work within a cross-functional product team responsible for modernising the user experience, backend services and cloud platform capabilities of one of WTW’s strategic cloud platforms.

You will contribute to a business-critical distributed compute platform that executes large-scale insurance modelling workloads across the organisation. The platform dynamically provisions Azure compute resources, runs computationally intensive jobs submitted by multiple business applications and provides a shared cloud foundation for analytical services.

The role combines frontend and backend development, cloud-native engineering and modern software engineering practices. You’ll help replace legacy technologies, rebuild AngularJS portals, modernise backend services, introduce Infrastructure as Code, migrate workloads to Azure Container Apps and improve deployment automation and operational resilience.

Working alongside experienced platform engineers, architects, product owners, DevOps engineers and QA specialists, you’ll help transform the current platform into a modern Azure-native platform while gaining deep knowledge of cloud platform engineering and distributed systems.

What Success Looks Like

In this role you will:

Contribute to meaningful modernisation outcomes across the platform and related services.
Deliver high-quality frontend and backend changes that are secure, maintainable and easy to operate.
Improve platform reliability, scalability and performance through well-tested engineering changes.
Apply agreed engineering standards, coding practices and review feedback consistently.
Support faster, more predictable delivery by contributing to automation, CI/CD and DevOps improvements.
Collaborate effectively with architects, product owners, QA, DevOps and other engineers to solve delivery challenges.
Actively learn, share knowledge and contribute to a positive engineering culture.

Key Responsibilities

Application Development

Develop modern Angular applications replacing legacy AngularJS user and administration portals.
Design, develop and maintain .NET backend services supporting distributed compute workloads.
Build and enhance REST APIs consumed by multiple business applications.
Modernise legacy platform functionality while preserving business continuity.
Implement scalable, maintainable and secure software following modern engineering practices.

Platform Modernization

Participate in migration towards Azure Container Apps and containerised workloads.
Support Infrastructure as Code implementation using OpenTofu/Terraform.
Contribute to cloud-native platform modernization initiatives.
Participate in modernisation of deployment pipelines and release automation.
Help improve platform scalability, maintainability and operational resilience.

Engineering Excellence

Write unit, integration and automated tests ensuring software quality and reliability.

We are an organization that has been fulfilling the travel dreams of Poles for 25 years. Since 2015, we have been part of Wirtualna Polska Holding – the largest Polish group of media and e-commerce companies. At Wakacje.pl, we offer thousands of domestic and international trips, as well as travel insurance, airport parking, and holiday vouchers. We constantly expand our offer to best meet our customers' needs. If you approach life with #ENERGY
, value #HONESTY AND OPENNESS
, focus on #CUSTOMER UNDERSTANDING
and #COLLABORATION
at work, carry out your tasks with high #EFFICIENCY
and #RESPONSIBILITY
, and want to play a key role in making us #INNOVATIVE
– join us!

About us:

We are a growing team of over 100 IT specialists, including Developers, DevOps Engineers, Testers, Project Managers, Architects, and Analysts. We're driven by passion and engagement and prioritize a culture of open communication. A commitment to high code quality, robust test automation, and efficient processes is at the core of what we do. We work in Scaled Agile Framework (SAFe).

Who we are looking for?

Solutions Architects form a guild that provides end-to-end architectural coverage across our systems and customer journey steps. Each Architect owns a defined slice — a system (e.g., search, booking, payments) or a journey step (e.g., checkout, post-booking) — and is the named technical authority for that area. Together, the guild ensures every critical part of our estate is owned, coherent, and moving toward a clear target state.
This is a hands-on technical leadership role. You will set architectural direction, make and document decisions, and ensure those decisions are understood and adopted in practice — not just written down.

Key responsibilities:

Own the end-to-end architecture of an assigned system or customer journey step — maintain a current-state assessment, a target architecture, and a sequenced, costed roadmap between them.
Produce and keep current all architectural documentation for the slice: C4 models (L1/L2), Architecture Decision Records (ADRs), ERDs, and sequence diagrams. Every material decision has a written rationale; undocumented architecture does not count.
Sit on the Architecture Board as the named decision authority for the slice — assess incoming proposals, drive decisions proactively, surface cross-slice conflicts, and escalate choices with material cost or strategic impact.
Lead vendor and technology evaluations; validate team proposals against the target architecture; recommend or block technology choices within the slice with documented rationale. Escalate major changes (new language, cloud provider, database engine, or TCO > €50k over 3 years) to the CTO.
Treat AI as a default design ingredient — evaluate where AI patterns (copilots, agentic workflows, RAG, model-backed features) create leverage, drive their adoption, and maintain a clear inventory of AI components and their risk profiles. Ensure AI usage converges on sanctioned patterns and guardrails.
Engage directly with product, commercial, and operations stakeholders to discover business intent before design begins. Translate business problems into technical requirements and trade-off frames — design for outcomes, not for tickets.
Own and enforce engineering standards within the slice (API design, observability, security baselines, data handling, AI usage); serve as named DRI for at least one standard across the guild. Contribute reusable patterns and golden paths back to the wider engineering organisation.
Define SLIs and SLOs for the slice, review breach trends, and partner with Engineering Managers on quarterly reliability improvement goals.
Coordinate with adjacent Architects to eliminate seams, duplication, and integration debt across slices. Pair on cross-slice initiatives by default.
Actively teach architectural patterns, engineering standards, and AI guidelines across the organisation — and measure adoption, not just publication.
Provide technology and design input to Engineering Managers and teams on architecture decisions, integration patterns, and major refactors. Does not own delivery timelines, headcount, sprint planning, or on-call rotations — those remain with Engineering Management.

Requirements:

8+ years of hands-on software engineering experience, with at least 3 years in an architecture or principal engineering role spanning multiple teams or systems.
Proven track record of owning end-to-end architecture for cross-cutting or platform domains — infrastructure, observability, developer platforms, shared services, or similar.
Deep experience designing and evolving distributed systems at scale: service boundaries, integration patterns, event-driven architectures, and API design.
Ability to produce and maintain living architectural documentation — C4 models, ADRs, ERDs, sequence diagrams — and hold others to the same standard.
Experience defining and enforcing engineering standards across multiple teams, with measurable adoption outcomes rather than just published guidelines.
Demonstrable ability to engage non-technical stakeholders — product, commercial, operations — and translate business intent into concrete technical requirements and trade-offs.
Strong communication and influencing skills: able to drive architectural decisions through persuasion and documented rationale, without direct line authority over engineers.
Comfort operating in a governed, multi-team environment — experienced with Architecture Boards, decision escalation paths, and structured ADR practices.
Familiarity with modern frontend architecture patterns, including React, SSR, Next.js, and Backend for Frontend (BFF), sufficient to assess design decisions and engage credibly with frontend teams.

Nice to have:

Experience working within or adapting scaled agile frameworks (SAFe, LeSS, or similar) in a principal engineering or architect capacity.
Hands-on experience designing or productionising AI/ML systems — LLM integrations, RAG pipelines, agentic workflows, or model evaluation frameworks.
Familiarity with travel, e-commerce, or marketplace platform architectures — particularly search, booking, or payments domains.
Experience building or operating internal developer platforms, golden paths, or shared engineering toolchains adopted across a large engineering organisation.
Background contributing to or maintaining a technology radar, vendor evaluation frameworks, or organisation-wide engineering standards programmes.
Experience defining and operationalising SLOs at the platform level, including instrumentation, alerting, and reliability review cadences.

What do we offer:

Workplace safety and comfort:

Employment based on an employment contract or B2B,
Full support during the onboarding period under the supervision of an engaging leader/buddy.

Business agency and agility:

Real influence on business decisions, the ability to take initiatives and implement your ideas.

Participation in training courses and conferences to enhance professional competencies.

Our Applied AI Engineering team designs and builds solutions that create real, measurable value for our clients across data engineering, AI and ML workflows, and agentic AI. We often work in complex, regulated environments such as financial services. We are looking for a Forward-Deployed Architect to shape the technical direction of our solutions from day one, in the field.

As a Forward-Deployed Architect within EY's Applied AI Engineering team, you will work closely with clients and forward-deployed engineering teams, making architecture decisions that shape solutions from the first prototype across data engineering, AI and ML workflows, and agentic AI systems.

EY.AI: in this role, you will work in an environment where AI agents are part of the team and everyday project delivery. You will use solutions tailored to specific business areas to analyse data, generate recommendations and design solutions, helping teams move faster from analysis to action and create value for clients.

Your scope of duties

Embed with client and forward-deployed teams to shape the architecture of data and AI solutions from discovery through the first working prototype, across data processing, AI and ML workflows, and agentic systems.
Make fast, pragmatic technology and design decisions under ambiguity, choosing patterns that balance speed now with scalability later.
Define the target architecture and a credible path to production so validated prototypes can move seamlessly into the production build phase.
Ensure prototypes and solutions are built responsibly and securely from the start, with data handling, lineage, guardrails and compliance considerations identified early, including the EU AI Act, GDPR, DORA and model risk.
Rapidly evaluate and select tools, services and frameworks across data platforms, AI and ML, and agentic AI that fit the problem at hand.
Act as the technical translator between business intent and forward-deployed engineering teams.
Manage and grow the pool of project blueprints and accelerators.
Identify and communicate technical risk, cost and feasibility early to inform build, pivot or stop decisions.
Partner with client enterprise and solution architects to align delivery decisions with enterprise standards and reference architectures.
Present and defend the technical direction to senior client stakeholders.

Our requirements

A master's degree in Computer Science, Engineering or a related field, and approximately 10+ years of software, data or AI engineering and architecture experience.
A track record of designing solutions across data, AI and ML, or agentic systems and taking them from concept towards production.
Strong architecture skills and working experience in at least one of the following stacks: Microsoft Azure, including Azure OpenAI, Azure AI Foundry or Azure Machine Learning, Azure Functions, Azure Data Factory, Microsoft Fabric or Synapse; AWS, including Bedrock, SageMaker, Lambda or Glue; or Google Cloud, including Vertex AI, BigQuery or Dataflow, together with hands-on coding ability.
A strong grasp of data architecture, including pipelines, lakes, warehouses and governance, and of AI, GenAI and agentic patterns, including RAG, orchestration, evaluation and guardrails.
Experience making architecture decisions under time pressure and ambiguity, ideally in a consulting, product or forward-deployed setting.
Excellent communication skills with both technical and senior business audiences.

Ideally, you'll also have

Financial services or other regulated-industry experience, and familiarity with the governance landscape, including AML and KYC, model risk or SR 11-7, the EU AI Act, DORA and GDPR.
Breadth across data engineering, AI workflows and agentic AI, and experience bridging prototype and production by defining handoffs and target architectures.
A consulting or startup background.
A history of creating reusable patterns and accelerators.

What we offer

Innovate EY, unique programmes where you can create your own start-up using our know-how and funding.
A convenient hybrid working model.
Professional and financial support in obtaining recognised qualifications and certificates.
EY Badges, global certification of your competencies and the opportunity to earn an MBA title from the prestigious Hult International School of Business.
Career Counselor, professional, one-to-one guidance on career building and development.
Psycho-educational platform, a package of free consultations with specialists in the broad field of mental health and personal development and access to educational activities.
Benefit programme offering private healthcare with additional preventive examinations, life insurance, tickets, team sports, language learning platform, sports cards and much more, available online and offline.

Recruitment stages

Apply. If this is your first time applying, create your profile and add your CV.
Let's talk. You will meet with Talent Acquisition specialists and representatives of your future team.

We are a global consulting firm, helping businesses, organisations and communities make the most of their potential. Our audit, consulting, legal, strategy, tax and transaction teams ask the nonobvious questions to find new answers to the complex challenges facing the world today.

We employ more than 390,000 exceptional people in over 150 countries around the world. In Poland there are over 7,000 of us, working in Warsaw, Gdansk, Katowice, Krakow, Lodz, Poznan, Rzeszow and Wroclaw.

jobs.title: Senior Full-Stack Software Engineer with OAuth
jobs.description:
Technology is our how. And people are our why.

At Endava, we harness technology to drive meaningful change. By combining AI-native engineering, deep industry expertise and a people-centric mindset, we partner with leading organisations to solve complex business challenges and create digital products and platforms that make a lasting impact.

From strategy and design to engineering and operations, we help our customers accelerate innovation and transform their businesses. Join us and be part of a global team delivering work that matters.

Job Description

As part of Endava's strategic partnership with WTW, who provide data-driven, insight-led solutions in the areas of people, risk and capital, we're building dedicated software engineering teams to support WTW's Insurance Consulting and Technology Division.

WTW's Insurance Consulting and Technology business is a global leader in P&C, Life and Health insurance software and advisory services, with over 1,700 colleagues across 35 markets. More than 1,000 insurers worldwide trust our combination of advisory insight and advanced software to help them navigate complexity and drive sustainable growth.

Joining Endava, you'll work exclusively with WTW to help embed AI-enabled engineering practices, modern ways of working and deep insurance technology expertise, contributing to the next generation of products and services for insurers worldwide. Working as part of a dedicated team established through a Build-Operate-Transfer (BOT) model, you'll collaborate closely with WTW while building your career as an Endava employee, supporting the long-term success of this strategic partnership.

About the Role

As a Senior Full Stack Software Engineer, you will join an experienced cross-functional engineering team responsible for designing, developing and evolving the Authentication and Authorization capability used across multiple products and engineering teams.

Utveckla, förbättra och underhålla våra system och appar
Bidra i tekniska och arkitekturella frågor samt ta fram lösningar för tekniska och affärsmässiga behov
Delta i kravhantering och tekniska tester.
Bidra till kunskapsdelning och gott samarbete i teamet

Du är en erfaren och lösningsorienterad utvecklare med god kunskap inom backend och gärna även frontend. Du trivs i komplexa systemlandskap, arbetar självständigt med felsökning och problemlösning och samarbetar väl i agila team. Arkitektur och arbete i större IT-projekt

På Nobina är vi engagerade i att skapa en inkluderande arbetsmiljö där varje medarbetare gör skillnad. Våra ledare tar ansvar, fattar modiga beslut och strävar alltid efter att möta våra resenärers och samhällets behov. jobs.title: Software Architect
jobs.description:
Vill du arbeta med avancerad mjukvaruarkitektur i en tekniskt ledande organisation? Hos oss får du en nyckelroll i att utveckla framtidens serviceverktyg och mjukvaruplattformar i nära samarbete med både interna team och internationella partners. Vi söker nu en Software Architect som vill kombinera teknisk spets med helhetsperspektiv.

Som Software Architect kommer du att arbeta med:

Ta fram kravbilder och design av mjukvaruarkitekturer på system-, nod- och modulnivå
Driva tekniska vägval, komponentval och bidra till roadmap för plattformar
Stötta utvecklingsteam genom vägledning, utbildning och tekniskt ledarskap
Delta i test, verifiering och releaseplanering av mjukvarulösningar
Utföra avancerad felsökning samt ha dialog med intressenter

Som Software Architect inom vår mjukvarugrupp med fokus på serviceverktyg har du en central roll i att utveckla, vidareutveckla och säkra kvaliteten på våra mjukvarulösningar och plattformar. Du arbetar genom hela utvecklingskedjan, från att skriva/analysera krav och omsätta dem till hållbara arkitekturlösningar, till att säkerställa implementation, verifiering och vidareutveckling.

Rollen innebär ett nära samarbete med utvecklare, designers och systemingenjörer, där du fungerar som en teknisk ledare och kunskapsbärare. Du bidrar till att skapa struktur och riktning i utvecklingsarbetet genom att definiera arkitekturprinciper, etablera standarder och driva kontinuerliga förbättringar.

Du har även en viktig roll i kontakten med andra delar av organisationen, såsom produktion, marknad, samt med övriga R&D. Genom denna samverkan säkerställer du att lösningarna möter både tekniska krav och verksamhetens behov.

Tjänsten passar dig som trivs med att arbeta både strategiskt och operativt, har en stark analytisk förmåga och vill ta ett stort ansvar i att forma framtidens mjukvarulösningar. Här får du möjlighet att påverka teknikval, driva innovation och bidra till att skapa effektiva och robusta system med höga krav på kvalitet, säkerhet och funktionalitet

Till tjänsten som Software Architect söker vi dig som har/är:

Civilingenjörsutbildning inom mjukvara eller motsvarande
Minst 5 års erfarenhet av fullstack med Windows-applikationer i C#, .NET och typescript/React
God kunskap i engelska tal och skrift, meriterande om du även har goda svenskkunskaper

För att lyckas i rollen har du god kommunikativ förmåga, både skriftligt och verbalt och trivs med att samarbeta med andra för att nå gemensamma mål. Samtidigt arbetar du självständigt och har förmågan att driva aktiviteter framåt hela vägen till måluppfyllelse.

Vilka är R&D Toyota Material Handling Europe?

Toyota Material Handling Europe är världsledande inom materialhantering och vi gör stora investeringar för att möta framtidens behov. På vår R&D-avdelning i Mjölby arbetar 300 medarbetare med utveckling av våra produkter och tjänster samt nya innovativa lösningar. På Toyota arbetar vi med ett helhetsperspektiv där medarbetarna har ansvar från koncept till färdig produkt.

På Toyota förenar vi klassisk konstruktion med modern teknik inom automation, IoT och AI. Vårt produktutbud sträcker sig från manuella handtruckar till förarlösa fordon med avancerad teknik. På R&D avdelningen arbetar vi med korta utvecklingscykler för att möta efterfrågan på en snabbt växande marknad.

Medarbetarna inom R&D beskriver våra chefer och ledare som inkluderande, närvarande och prestigelösa. Vi på Toyota är måna om att skapa ett familjärt arbetsklimat med möjlighet till personlig utveckling och goda karriärmöjligheter.

Din Framtid på Toyota Material Handling Europe

På Toyota Material Handling Europe strävar vi efter att vara en vänskaplig, trygg och framåtsträvande arbetsplats. Vår kultur bygger på Toyotas värdegrund, där respekt och omsorg är centrala i det dagliga arbetet. Vi arbetar aktivt för att öka mångfalden och ta vara på olikheter, vilket stärker vår konkurrenskraft.

För att skapa förutsättningar till en hållbar vardag erbjuder vi våra medarbetare flextid och möjlighet till distansarbete på deltid.

jobs.description:
Job Description

We are seeking a high-impact Principal Architect
to serve as our central subject matter expert in global e-invoicing, regulatory compliance, and platform architecture. This is a senior individual contributor role with organization-wide reach, operating beyond traditional single-project allocation to influence delivery, pre-sales, and customer strategy. In this role, you will be the definitive go-to authority across all delivery projects, pre-sales engagements, and customer-facing interactions. You will leverage your deep mastery of the Pagero platform, hands-on integration expertise, and understanding of national e-invoicing authorities to solve complex technical challenges, shape strategic solutions, and translate intricate regulatory frameworks into clear, actionable guidance for our teams and clients.

Key Responsibilities

Cross-Project Advisory & Escalation

Serve as the senior technical and functional escalation authority across all active delivery projects, resolving complex platform, integration, and compliance roadblocks.
Diagnose and solve the most challenging edge cases across the delivery portfolio, including non-standard ERP configurations, complex data transformation requirements, and multi-country mandate flows.
Design and establish reusable reference architectures, standard configuration templates, playbooks, and best-practice frameworks to scale delivery quality and consistency across the organization.

Pre-Sales & Commercial Enablement

Act as the dedicated Pagero platform and compliance expert for sales and pre-sales teams, providing deep functional and technical insight without holding direct ownership of SOW creation or pricing.
Advise solution architects and pre-sales consultants on platform capabilities, limitations, architectural fit, and feasibility.
Participate in high-stakes, customer-facing technical discussions for strategic enterprise opportunities.
Review proposed solution designs from pre-sales and delivery teams to ensure technical accuracy, platform feasibility, and regulatory alignment.

Customer Mandate & Regulatory Guidance

Act as the trusted advisor for enterprise clients navigating complex global e-invoicing mandates, clearance flows, format specifications (e.g., Peppol, UBL, XML), and government platform integrations.
Engage directly with customer stakeholders and liaise with national e-invoicing and tax authorities when necessary to secure formal regulatory clarifications.
Author and review customer-facing compliance roadmaps, mandate checklists, and country-specific onboarding documentation.

Team Onboarding, Training & Knowledge Management

Own the technical onboarding journey for new team members, developing and executing structured onboarding programs that build Pagero platform and compliance proficiency from day one.
Foster continuous skill development across delivery teams through tailored training sessions, hands-on coaching, certification guidance, and internal knowledge-sharing forums.
Build, maintain, and expand an internal Pagero Knowledge Base and learning curriculum covering country-specific mandates, integration patterns, and platform updates.
Partner with delivery leadership to identify capability gaps across teams and deploy targeted technical enablement initiatives.

Required Qualifications

Deep Pagero Expertise: Proven, hands-on experience and expert-level functional and technical mastery of the Pagero platform ecosystem.
Domain Knowledge: Extensive knowledge of global e-invoicing regulations, continuous transaction controls (CTC), clearance models, Peppol networks, and digital tax reporting requirements across multiple jurisdictions.
Integration & ERP Proficiency: Strong technical background in enterprise application integration (EAI), API frameworks, and ERP systems (e.g., SAP, Oracle, NetSuite, Microsoft Dynamics), alongside deep familiarity with standard data formats (XML, JSON, EDI, UBL, CSV).
Architecture & Advisory Experience: Substantial experience operating in a Lead Architect, Principal Consultant, or Senior Subject Matter Expert capacity across complex enterprise deployments.
Pre-Sales Acumen: Demonstrated track record supporting pre-sales teams with technical solution reviews, discovery calls, and RFP responses.
Communication & Stakeholder Management: Exceptional communication skills with the ability to articulate complex technical and regulatory nuances to both executive business leaders and technical engineering teams.

Preferred Qualifications

Prior experience directly interfacing or collaborating with national tax authorities, e-invoicing standard bodies, or working groups.
Demonstrated experience establishing a Center of Excellence (CoE) or structured technical training and onboarding curriculum within an enterprise technology or consulting environment.
Relevant industry or architecture certifications (e.g., TOGAF, Cloud Certifications, or ERP-specific accreditations).
Multilingual proficiency, particularly in languages relevant to major emerging e-invoicing mandate regions (e.g., Spanish, French, German, Arabic).

What’s in it For You?

Hybrid Work Model: We’ve adopted a flexible hybrid working environment (2-3 days a week in the office depending on the role) for our office-based roles while delivering a seamless experience that is digitally and physically connected.
Flexibility & Work-Life Balance: Flex My Way is a set of supportive workplace policies designed to help manage personal and professional responsibilities, whether caring for family, giving back to the community, or finding time to refresh and reset. This builds upon our flexible work arrangements, including work from anywhere for up to 8 weeks per year, empowering employees to achieve a better work-life balance.
Career Development and Growth: By fostering a culture of continuous learning and skill development, we prepare our talent to tackle tomorrow’s challenges and deliver real-world solutions. Our Grow My Way programming and skills-first approach ensures you have the tools and knowledge to grow, lead, and thrive in an AI-enabled future.
Industry Competitive Benefits: We offer comprehensive benefit plans to include flexible vacation, two company-wide Mental Health Days off, access to the Headspace app, retirement savings, tuition reimbursement, employee incentive programs, and resources for mental, physical, and financial wellbeing.
Culture: Globally recognized, award-winning reputation for inclusion and belonging, flexibility, work-life balance, and more. We live by our values: Obsess over our Customers, Compete to Win, Challenge (Y)our Thinking, Act Fast / Learn Fast, and Stronger Together.
Social Impact: Make an impact in your community with our Social Impact Institute. We offer employees two paid volunteer days off annually and opportunities to get involved with pro-bono consulting projects and Environmental, Social, and Governance (ESG) initiatives.
Making a Real-World Impact: We are one of the few companies globally that helps its customers pursue justice, truth, and transparency. Together, with the professionals and institutions we serve, we help uphold the rule of law, turn the wheels of commerce, catch bad actors, report the facts, and provide trusted, unbiased information to people all over the world.

About Us

Thomson Reuters informs the way forward by bringing together the trusted content and technology that people and organizations need to make the right decisions. We serve professionals across legal, tax, accounting, compliance, government, and media. Our products combine highly specialized software and insights to empower professionals with the data, intelligence, and solutions needed to make informed decisions, and to help institutions in their pursuit of justice, truth, and transparency. Reuters, part of Thomson Reuters, is a world leading provider of trusted journalism and news.

We are powered by the talents of 26,000 employees across more than 70 countries, where everyone has a chance to contribute and grow professionally in flexible work environments. At a time when objectivity, accuracy, fairness, and transparency are under attack, we consider it our duty to pursue them. Sound exciting? Join us and help shape the industries that move society forward.

jobs.title: IT Architect
jobs.description:
Vi söker fler arkitekter som vill kombinera teknik, affär och säkerhet i uppdrag där du får tid, förtroende och utrymme att göra ett riktigt bra jobb. Hos oss arbetar du i en trygg miljö där långsiktighet, kvalitet och samarbete är viktigare än kortsiktiga hopp mellan projekt.

Omegapoint är inte ett traditionellt konsultbolag. Vi arbetar nära våra kunder, i roller där teknik möter verksamhet - och där din erfarenhet verkligen betyder något.

Är du den vi söker?

Som arkitekt hos oss är du både tekniskt stark och nyfiken på människorna, affären och sammanhangen bakom systemen. Du trivs i uppdrag där du får:
förstå kundens behov på djupet
visualisera målbild och vägval
guida team i moderna arbetssätt
bygga säkra och hållbara lösningar
skapa affärsvärde genom teknik

Du behöver inte vara expert på allt - vi söker dig som är bred och trygg
, och som gillar att ta ansvar för helheten.

Vad du kan arbeta med hos oss

Rollen kan se olika ut beroende på uppdrag och din profil. Exempel:
Mjukvaruarkitekt – från kodnära beslut till domändesign
Cloud & Security – Azure, AWS, Kubernetes eller GCP, identitet, zero trust
Integration & Data – API:er, eventdrivet, plattformar
Enterprise & målbildsarbete – struktur, roadmap, förmågekartor
Lead‑ och rådgivarroll – först in hos kund tillsammans med sälj, öppna dörrar och skapa förtroende
DevSecOps – CI/CD, IaC, monitorering och skanning
AI & agentic programming – experimentera, utvärdera, och integrera nya arbetssätt i lösningar

Du väljer själv hur mycket kod du vill skriva - många av våra arkitekter rör sig obehindrat mellan
teknik och strategi.

Vilka vi tror att du är

Du är en person som:
gillar att samarbeta, kommunicera och skapa förtroende
är trygg i förändring och nyfiken på nya arbetssätt
värderar kvalitet och hållbarhet över quick fixes
är inkluderande, prestigelös och ser teamets styrka före individens
vill dela med dig av din kunskap, precis som vi gör med vår

Hos oss behöver du inte passa in i en mall. Vi tror på olika bakgrunder, erfarenheter och perspektiv - och vi vill att du ska kunna växa på det sätt som passar dig.

Trygga uppdrag där du får utvecklas

Hos oss hamnar du i uppdrag som är:
långsiktiga - med tid att göra ett bra jobb
affärskritiska - där din kompetens behövs på riktigt
moderna - med teknik och miljöer som utmanar och utvecklar
stabila - med team som står stadigt och kunder som litar på oss

Vi matchar inte konsulter slumpmässigt - vi matchar rätt personer med rätt uppdrag.

🚀 Vi satsar på dig

Omegapoint är byggt för lärande. Här får du:
kontinuerlig kompetensutveckling
gemenskap och kunskapsdelning genom våra interna dagar
möjlighet att föreläsa, certifiera dig och leda initiativ
en kultur där vi är både vassa och snälla
kollegor som gärna delar med sig, stöttar och inspirerar

Tillsammans bygger vi säkra digitala lösningar som skapar värde - för kunden, samhället och framtiden.

Utveckla med AI i praktiken

På Omegapoint ser vi AI som en naturlig del av modern systemutveckling. Vi tror att framtidens digitala lösningar skapas när mänsklig kompetens, erfarenhet och omdöme möter artificiell intelligens.

Hos oss får du tillgång till moderna AI-verktyg som hjälper dig att skapa smartare, säkrare och mer värdeskapande lösningar. Vi uppmuntrar nyfikenhet, lärande och kunskapsdelning och värdesätter alltid säkerhet och kvalitet. I uppdrag med särskilda säkerhetskrav arbetar vi med lösningar och miljöer som ger den kontroll och trygghet som krävs.

Tillsammans med vassa och snälla kollegor formar du framtidens säkra digitala lösningar och bidrar till en framtid där människor kan lita på tekniken.

💚 Om oss

Omegapoint är norra Europas ledande konsultbolag inom säker digital innovation. Vi är över 800 medarbetare i Stockholm, Göteborg, Malmö, Örebro, Västerås, Enköping, Uppsala och Umeå.

jobs.title: Senior Backend Java Engineer
jobs.description:
The Pangolins squad is the data protection engineering team within Data Infrastructure organization. We build and operate the systems that enable us to meet its privacy and compliance obligations at scale — covering GDPR rights like Right to be Forgotten and Subject Access Requests, data retention enforcement, and access governance.

You'll join a team of 6 engineers. Every team that stores personal data depends on the infrastructure we build. We sit at the intersection of infrastructure engineering, privacy/compliance, and product enablement — and right now, we're expanding to support our most critical regulatory initiative.

The Digital Services Act (DSA) places new obligations on very large online platforms, and our ability to meet them runs directly through our team. We're building the data governance and compliance infrastructure underpinning our VLOP obligations — with hard regulatory deadlines and real legal exposure. The work spans data cataloging, researcher data access, cross-border law enforcement data access, and ML-based tooling for personal data annotation. If you're energized by infrastructure that has real-world privacy impact and want to work at the intersection of engineering, compliance, and product — we'd love to have you on the team.

What You'll Do

Build the programmatic classification pipeline and governance data catalog behind our DSA obligations — classifying data fields across tens of thousands of endpoints and provisioning them to EU-credentialed researchers through secure environments.
Develop the governance taxonomy and data model for sensitive data categories (starting with Precise Location Data), establishing foundational infrastructure that will outlast the VLOP mandate.
Contribute to the EU e-Evidence system — cross-border law enforcement data access infrastructure — as new data categories and product features come online.
Partner with Data Governance, Content Platform, Legal, and product teams to deliver cross-org solutions that are reliable, auditable, and scalable.
Champion engineering best practices, strong architectural design, and a culture of shared ownership and continuous improvement.

Who You Are

You have solid backend engineering experience in Java on Google Cloud Platform, and you're comfortable working across large-scale distributed systems.
You have hands-on experience with large-scale data infrastructure — ideally BigQuery, GCS, and Kubernetes — and can navigate complex data pipelines with confidence.
You think critically about system design and build solutions that are reliable, maintainable, and auditable at scale — especially in compliance-critical contexts.
You work well across team boundaries — with Legal, Data Governance, Product, and engineering partners — and bring clarity when requirements are evolving.
You're comfortable with ambiguity. Regulatory work moves fast; you know how to make progress even when the ground is shifting.
You care about code quality, testing, and documentation, and you build systems that are easy for others to understand and operate.
You're self-motivated and genuinely excited about infrastructure that has real-world privacy and compliance impact.

Engagement Details

Start: asap-untill end of feb with possibility to extend
Location: Stockholm/Sweden (Remote within Sweden)

It all started when engineer Fred Luddy wrote code that automated a tedious task for his coworker, Phyllis. She cried tears of joy. Today, ServiceNow is the AI control tower for business reinvention. Our ServiceNow AI platform brings together any AI, any data, and any workflow— helping 85% of the Fortune 500® work smarter, faster, and better. We're building an AI-native culture where technology and talent are unstoppable together. And we're just getting started.

Join us to put AI to work for people.

Job Description

Team Bio:

ServiceNow’s Applied AI Forward Deployed Engineering (FDE)
team is where bold ideas meet transformative action. We partner with our most strategic customers to shape the future of enterprise AI. Together, we identify high-value opportunities, accelerate business outcomes, and build reusable AI-native solutions that advance the Now AI Platform.

Our mission:
We partner deeply with our customers to build intelligent, scalable AI solutions that solve their most mission-critical challenges. By embedding in real-world complexity, we deliver fast, iterate with purpose, and transform every success into reusable patterns that accelerate transformation across the Now Platform and the broader enterprise.

Why This Role Matters

Enterprises are raising the bar. AI initiatives must deliver business value—not just promise potential. That means taking cutting-edge LLM capabilities and turning them into resilient, secure, and scalable software.

As a Senior Forward Deployed Software Engineer (FDSE)
, you act as the CTO of the build—owning everything from backend services to LLM pipelines and front-end integrations. You partner with customers in the field to design, implement, and deliver solution-ready builds in agile sprints. Your software becomes the reference implementation for scalable GenAI in the enterprise. You codify patterns, shape internal tooling, and accelerate innovation—delivering systems that are battle-tested in production and scalable across industries.

Who You Are

You are a systems-minded, AI-native engineer who ships real software. You own the full stack—and are equally motivated by elegant APIs, intuitive UIs, and scalable orchestration pipelines. You think like a product-minded CTO, balancing creativity with pragmatism to deliver impact.

You embed deeply with customer teams, diagnose root problems, and architect AI-powered workflows that run at scale. You don’t just debug code—you debug systems, context, and customer pain points.

You Will

Build solution-ready LLM-enabled applications that span backend logic, data orchestration, and front-end UI
Operate in the field, working side-by-side with customers to adapt, deploy, and iterate in live environments
Codify reusable assets—libraries, prompts, scaffolds—to accelerate future engagements
Shape developer experience by sharing feedback with platform and product teams

What You’ll Do

Deliver Production - ready solution in agile end-to-end sprints
Engineer with versatility: APIs, orchestration pipelines, vector DBs, LLM frameworks, UI components
Operate with agility: integrate with legacy systems, navigate ambiguity, ship safely at speed
Codify patterns: build scaffolds, SDKs, and documentation to scale success across customers
Influence platform: inform product strategy through field-tested insights and extensible code

What Success Looks Like

Production-grade delivery: Your solution builds consistently convert to scaled deployments in production environments
Reusable impact: You author libraries, prompts, and scaffolds that power multiple deployments and projects
Platform influence: Your work shapes internal tooling and is integrated into platform roadmap and primitives
Velocity and precision: You move fast without breaking things—shaping resilient, secure systems in high-stakes contexts
Engineering leadership: You are trusted by architects, PMs, and customer teams to lead implementation from zero to one

Qualifications

What You Bring:

Experience: In leveraging or critically thinking about how to integrate AI into work processes, decision-making, or problem-solving. This may include using AI-powered tools, automating workflows, analyzing AI-driven insights, or exploring AI’s potential impact on the function or industry
Relevant Experience: 10+ years of software engineering, including 2+ years building systems in customer-facing or embedded roles
System architecture: Proven ability to design and implement AI-native software in production environments
Engineering depth: Strength in backend (Python, Node.js, Java), frontend (React, Angular), APIs (REST/GraphQL)
LLM tooling: Familiarity with LangChain, Semantic Kernel, prompt chaining, vector search, and context management
Performance & observability: Skilled in debugging distributed systems, tuning for latency, and implementing monitoring
Platform mindset: Can contribute to shared SDKs and tools, raising engineering velocity for the whole org
Product sensibility: Prioritize for user value, MVP iteration, and long-term scale
DevOps fluency: Experience deploying in AWS, Azure, or GCP with CI/CD, containers, and infra-as-code
Field readiness: Able to travel up to 30% to embed onsite and deliver where it matters

Experience integrating AI into SaaS platforms like ServiceNow or Salesforce
Track record of production deployments in secure, regulated enterprise environments
Contributions to dev experience tooling, frameworks, or reusable AI scaffolds

jobs.title: Software Engineer in Test
jobs.description:
Our Why At Dotmatics

At Dotmatics, a Siemens company, we believe science, data, and decision-making must be deeply intertwined for innovation to thrive. Our Portfolio includes Luma, LumaLab Connect, ELN Platform, Graphpad Prism, Geneious, SnapGene, Protein Metrics, OMIQ, FCS Express, LabArchives, NQuery, EasyPanel, SoftGenetics and Virscidian.

We have a vision for a new Lab of the Future that will change the future of scientific research.

We have created the world’s most comprehensive digital science platform – best-of-breed software applications already used by more than 2 million scientists, together in a single ecosystem united by a powerful, flexible enterprise data platform. This is not flat data buried away in digital graveyards. This is dynamic, multi-dimensional decision-making.
Scientific enterprises need a new level of effectiveness to achieve tomorrow’s breakthroughs. Illness will not wait. The biosphere will not wait. We are tireless in our vision, because the time for innovation is now.

Shaping the Future of Science At Dotmatics

Our global team of more than 800 colleagues are dedicated to supporting our customers in over 180 countries. Together, with our scientific community of users, we accelerate scientific innovation in order to make the world a healthier, cleaner, and safer place to live.
You’ll join a collaborative, global team pushing the boundaries of scientific innovation. Your ideas and efforts will have a tangible impact, accelerating scientific progress and discovery. We offer a dynamic, remote-friendly environment that fosters high integrity and collaboration, empowering you to excel. Dotmatics is a company built by scientists, for scientists. Combined, we are now the world’s largest cloud-based scientific research R&D platform. We need your help to keep growing and pioneering the future.

**We are Science Driven. We are Customer Centric. We are Better Together**

What do we need:

We are seeking an SDET to join one of our agile engineering teams and help us build quality into LUMA, our scientific software platform. You'll take ownership of testing for a specific module of the application, writing and maintaining automated tests, exploring new features, and working alongside developers, application scientists and DevOps engineers to make sure what we ship is reliable.

This is a hands-on automation role with room to grow. You'll be contributing to established test frameworks rather than building them from scratch, with support from senior SDETs who will help you develop your technical depth and your understanding of the science behind the product. While the primary focus is automation, the role also involves manual exploratory testing.

In this role you will get to:

Write, maintain and extend automated test suites for your module using Cucumber, TypeScript and Cypress (and Playwright where we use it).
Own day-to-day quality for your area: contributing test scenarios during planning, testing stories as they're built, and giving the team a clear picture of release readiness.
Design and document test cases that cover functional, regression and integration scenarios, and keep them useful as the product evolves.
Investigate and reproduce defects, raise well-evidenced bug reports in JIRA, and verify fixes with developers and scientists.
Keep your tests green and trustworthy in our CI pipelines, and help improve how tests run and report.
Learn to read and interpret API documentation and turn it into meaningful automated coverage.
Work with leading experts in software development, scientific product management and test automation, and be mentored by them.

Who we're looking for:

You'll have 2–5 years' experience in QA/testing, including at least a year of hands-on test automation
.

You're comfortable working in a code-first way, you enjoy digging into how things work, and you're happy asking questions when a domain is unfamiliar. You work carefully and pay attention to detail, and you can take a story or module, understand it and devise a concrete approach to testing going above and beyond the standard acceptance criteria.

Just as importantly, you want to get better. We're looking for someone who takes feedback well, is curious about the scientific problems our users are solving and wants to grow into a senior automation engineer over time.

The Key Skills we are looking for:

Practical experience with Cypress
— writing tests, using selectors and custom commands, debugging failures, and working within an existing Page Object Model. Experience testing React applications is a plus.
Working knowledge of TypeScript or JavaScript
, including asynchronous code (promises, async/await). You don't need to be an expert in generics and interfaces, but you should be able to read and write clean, maintainable test code.
Experience with BDD / Cucumber
, or a willingness to pick it up quickly — we write most of our specs in Gherkin.
Test case design and documentation
— the ability to break a feature down into clear, repeatable scenarios and write them up so others can follow them.
Comfort with Git and GitHub
, including branching, pull requests and code review, plus experience working in JIRA or a similar tracking system.

You may also have:

Experience with Playwright, or interest in learning it — we use it for a subset of our tests.
Exposure to API testing tools (Postman, REST clients) or writing API-level automated tests.
Any experience with performance or load testing (K6 or similar).
Familiarity with validating data integrity across release upgrades, migrations or schema changes.
A background or interest in science, engineering or research software.

jobs.title: Senior Technical Architect
jobs.description:
Vi ser etter arkitekter som har jobbet med .NET og Azure i mange år, og som fortsatt vil skrive kode. Du går inn i kundeteam som arkitekt, med ansvar for løsningsarkitekturen i systemer som allerede er i drift.

Arbeidet

Kundene våre er mange og varierte, men ofte innenfor bransjene industri, B2B og helse. Noen er store organisasjoner med lange systemhistorier, andre er mindre virksomheter som bygger opp teknologisiden sin. Som arkitekt sitter du som regel hos kunden til daglig, men det er også plass til deg inne på vårt hovedkontor, og vi har generelt gode hjemmekontorløsninger.

Du går inn i et kundeteam som arkitekt, som regel som én av få fra Forte. Systemene har vanligvis vært i drift i mange år før du kommer, og du overtar et landskap andre har bygget. Ansvaret ditt er løsningsarkitekturen: integrasjoner, dataflyt, sikkerhet og skyplattform.

Tittelen på oppdraget varierer med kundens behov. I noen perioder jobber du mest med kode, i andre mest med arkitektur.

En stor del av oppdragene våre handler om modernisering. Eldre integrasjonsplattformer, løsninger som fortsatt kjører on-prem, .NET Framework, standardprodukter som er tilpasset så mye over så lang tid at de ikke lenger lar seg oppgradere. Oppgaven er å finne veien fra dagens situasjon til noe som holder i mange år fremover, og å gjennomføre den uten at driften stopper opp underveis.

Konkret betyr det at du

setter teknisk retning i teamet, og forklarer konsekvensene av veivalgene både til utviklerne og til dem som betaler for dem
designer og bygger integrasjoner, API-er og dataflyt i Azure, med Functions, Service Bus, API Management, AKS eller det som passer problemet
skriver kode og gjør kodegjennomganger
etablerer plattform, IaC og pipelines slik at resten av teamet kommer raskere frem
bidrar til at utviklerne rundt deg blir bedre, gjennom parprogrammering og gjennomganger mer enn gjennom presentasjoner
dokumenterer beslutninger slik at de holder også når du ikke er tilgjengelig
tar stilling til hvordan kodeassistenter og agenter brukes i teamet, og hva det betyr for arkitektur, kodekvalitet og gjennomganger

Hva rollen ikke er

Dette er ikke en virksomhetsarkitektrolle, og heller ikke en rådgiverrolle på siden av utviklingsarbeidet. Rollen innebærer ikke personalansvar. Har du beveget deg bort fra koden og trives med det, er dette sannsynligvis feil stilling, men vi har andre roller og hører gjerne fra deg om dem.

Du må ha

.NET og C# som primærplattform gjennom mange år, med nok tyngde til at du har sett hvordan valgene dine har stått seg over tid
Azure-erfaring fra produksjonsløsninger du selv har vært med på å bygge og drifte
erfaring som arkitekt eller tech lead i team der du fortsatt skrev kode
gode norskegenskaper både skriftlig og muntlig

Det teller positivt om du har

ledet et moderniseringsløp fra legacy til målbilde
bygget dataplattform eller datahub
jobbet praktisk med sikkerhet i design og implementasjon
erfaring med IaC (Bicep, Terraform) og CI/CD i Azure DevOps eller GitHub
brukt kodeassistenter i eget arbeid og gjort deg opp en mening om hvor de faktisk hjelper
dokumentert arkitektur med C4 eller tilsvarende
sertifiseringer som AZ-305, AZ-204 eller AZ-400

Du trenger ikke kjenne deg igjen i alt på denne listen for å søke.

Fagmiljøet

Arkitektene i Forte driver en guild og faste fagmøter. Innholdet lages av arkitektene selv, og temaene bestemmes av dem som ønsker å være en del av miljøet.

Vi forventer at du bidrar med sparring, mentoring og en presentasjon i blant, og vi setter av arbeidstid til det.

Hva kan vi tilby?

🌴 6 uker ferie

Du får 6 uker ferie, fra det andre året du er ansatt i Forte.

🧠 Sterkt fagmiljø

Hos oss finner du gode sparringspartnere i alt fra junior utviklere til erfarne arkitekter. Du får bidra til å påvirke faglig retning, og vi har både et eget arkitektakademi og fagmøter.

🩺 Gode forsikringsvilkår

Dekket privat helse- og reiseforsikring og gode pensjonsordninger.

🎉 Godt sosialt miljø

Vi finner alltid en unnskyldning til å samles - alt fra aktivitetesgrupper, turer og månedlige arrangementer.

👶 Full lønn i foreldrepermisjon

Du får selvfølgelig utbetalt full lønn i foreldrepermisjon.

📚 Faglig utvikling i arbeidstiden

Vi brenner for fag, og hos oss får du bruke arbeidstiden til å utvikle deg innenfor det du ønsker.

🤸 Dekket treningsavgift

Vi vet at trening kan bidra til å fremme bedre helse. Forte dekker treningsavgift for opp til 800,- per måned.

Vi er Forte og vi er et europeisk konsulentselskap. Navnet vårt betyr styrke, og det er akkurat det vi gir våre kunder. Styrken til å tilpasse seg. Til å handle. Til å vokse.

Vi hjelper våre kunder med å forbli relevante og realisere sitt fulle potensial - uansett hva fremtiden bringer. Vi kombinerer teknologi, strategi og brukeropplevelse for å gi deg det du trenger for å lede – ikke bare følge etter.

Vi drives av det som virkelig teller: Målbare resultater, verdi og varig relevans. Vi heier på kundene våre og strekker oss litt lenger for å skape resultater sammen. Med raushet og engasjement møter vi deg der du er, tilpasser oss dine behov og gir tydelig retning. Vi tar initiativ, handler raskt og er alltid et steg foran – fordi vi gir alt for at du skal lykkes.

Global innovation team

As our new Robotics Software Engineer, you will join a local, cross-functional Innovation & Development team consisting of highly skilled professionals in computer vision, robotics, user experience design, software architecture, and software development. The team operates in a global setup and collaborates closely with colleagues across locations and disciplines. The team's mission is to develop innovative products and systems for the logistics industry.

In Your Role As Robotics Software Engineer, You Will

Develop, maintain, and debug software on industrial PCs and robotic platforms, including communication and computer vision applications.
Configure, program, and integrate industrial robots and motion control systems.
Work with geometric and spatial calculations related to robot motion, object positioning, and vision-guided applications.
Participate in the development of new products, from early prototypes to market-ready solutions.
Collaborate with colleagues and stakeholders across disciplines and locations in a global organization.

Driving business value

You have a strong background in designing and implementing automation solutions across a range of software platforms. You are innovative, proactive, and capable of developing automation systems and software that enhance efficiency and create business value.

You Bring The Following Qualifications To The Role

A degree in computer science, engineering, physics, or a related field.
Experience with robotics and automation technologies, preferably from a similar or related industry.
Experience developing near real-time software and solid knowledge of C#. Experience with Python, Docker, and microservice architecture is an advantage.
Interest in robotics software and technologies, particularly in combination with computer vision applications.

jobs.title: DevOps-medarbejder til .NET løsninger
jobs.description:
Har du lyst til at arbejde med IT i en styrelse, der arbejder med hele fødevarekæden fra jord til bord under politisk og mediemæssig bevågenhed? Vil du være med til at udvikle og vedligeholde styrelsens It- og forretningssystemer og bidrage til at sikre brugervenlige og sammenhængende digitale løsninger samt effektive arbejdsgange? Vil du være en del af vores digitale transformation og arbejde efter agile metoder? Så er du måske vores nye kollega i IT-systemvedligehold og drift i Fødevarestyrelsen.

Fødevarestyrelsen søger en DevOps-medarbejder med erfaring og kompetencer inden for Azure-miljøet til IT-enheden, hvor man kommer til at stå midt i en spændende udvikling hen imod en moderne IT-platform i tæt samarbejde mellem udvikling og drift.

Vores digitale transformation er i gang

Fødevarestyrelsen skal med brugernes behov i centrum videreudvikle og forny IT-understøttelsen af en stor del af vores kerneforretning. Derfor står vi midt i et spændende og udfordrende forløb, som du vil blive en del af.

Som et led i dette, har vi et stigende behov for at forbedre vores arbejdsgange omkring løbende udvikling og idriftsættelse. Vi har både nyere og ældre applikationer, og har både behov for at få løftet driften af de ældre løsninger, men også behov for løbende at idriftsætte og udvikle nye løsninger.

Du kommer til at være et teknisk bindeled imellem IT-enhedens drifts- og udviklingsteams. Sammen med andre kollegaer vil du sørge for, at applikationer løbende udvikles, deployeres og patches.

Om jobbet

Som DevOps-medarbejder bliver du en vigtig del af arbejdet med at sikre stabile driftsløsninger og understøtte den fortsatte udvikling af styrelsens IT-landskab. Du bliver det tekniske bindeled mellem drift og udvikling og får en central rolle i vores Azure-miljø.

Du vil således både indgå i den daglige drift men også i de agile arbejdsgange omkring nye it-leverancer.

Dine primære opgaver vil være at: Drift, overvågning og vedligeholdelse af styrelsens IT-systemer
Automatisere drifts- og deployeringsprocesser
Samarbejde tæt med udviklere og leverandører om idriftsættelse og vedligeholdelse af løsninger
Fejlsøge, dokumentere og indgå i beredskabsopgaver efter behov
Bidrage til IT-sikkerhed, compliance og stabile driftsprocesser
Være IT-driftens ankerperson på Azure-miljøet

Om dig – vores nye kollega

Vi søger en ny kollega med solid teknologiforståelse og som har erfaring med: Azure DevOps og Azure Pipelines
Har erfaring med it-drift, særligt i relation til DevOps
CI/CD og automatisering af deployments
Drift og administration af Azure-miljøer

Vi lægger derudover vægt på, at du: Er nysgerrig på ny teknologi og gerne vil dele viden – både når du skal modtage og give videre
Har erfaring med systemadministration af større enterprice løsninger.
Trives med bredt ansvar og varierende opgaver
Har godt kendskab til forskellige deployværktøjer
Arbejder struktureret, og har forståelse for drift i en offentlig/statslig kontekst
har erfaring med SCRUM, agile og SAFe.
Har en uddannelse som f.eks. datamatatiker, itteknolog, datalog eller ingeniør – men vi er åbne over for en anden faglig baggrund

Kendskab til disse teknologier er en fordel:
Microsoft .NET Core, Microsoft IIS, Microsoft SQL, Microsoft Server, Microsoft EntraID og tenant administration.
Grafana

Om Fødevarestyrelsens IT

IT-enheden består af tre sektioner, der arbejder tæt sammen. Samlet set er vi ca. 45 medarbejdere. Stillingen er placeret i IT-systemvedligehold og -drift, som består af 17 medarbejdere. Vi samarbejder tæt med Statens IT, hvilket giver mulighed for at udvikle kompetencer inden for leverandørstyring. Vi stræber efter at opretholde en høj faglig standard, som gør det muligt for os at udfordre vores leverandører gennem en solid IT-faglig dialog.

Fordele og goder

Vi tilbyder fleksible arbejdstider, mulighed for hjemmearbejde, efteruddannelse og deltagelse i sociale arrangementer. Vi har et stærkt fokus på medarbejdertrivsel og arbejder i et innovativt og samarbejdsorienteret miljø.

Udviklingsmuligheder

Der er rig mulighed for karriereudvikling og efteruddannelse inden for organisationen. Vi støtter dine professionelle mål og tilbyder et miljø, hvor du kan vokse og udvikle dig.

Løn og ansættelsesvilkår

Ansættelsen sker efter relevant statslig overenskomst.

Har du en akademisk uddannelse, vil du blive ansat efter den til enhver tid gældende overenskomst mellem Skatteministeriet og en række AC-organisationer, og du vil som udgangspunkt blive ansat som fuldmægtig.

Afhængig af din erfaring og dine kvalifikationer, kan der ske ansættelse som specialkonsulent.

Har du en ikke-akademisk uddannelse, vil du blive ansat efter den relevante gældende overenskomst.

Ansættelsesområdet er Fødevarestyrelsen, og tjenestestedet er IT-enheden, Stationsparken 31-33, 2600 Glostrup.

Tiltrædelsestidspunkt:

Der er brug for dig snarest muligt og gerne den 1. december 2026.
