jobs.title: Senior CI/CD Engineer
jobs.description:
We are looking for a highly-skilled Senior CI/CD Engineer based in Asia to make our builds faster, our pipelines more reliable, and our automated testing part of every change. You will focus on build performance for our C#/.NET and C++ software and on bringing tests and static analysis into CI. You will work closely with development, verification, our test architect and IT-DevOps teams in Europe and Asia.
Today, a full end-to-end pipeline runs around 200 jobs and over 10,000 automated tests and takes about 4 hours. Your main goal is to cut that time significantly (we aim for around 50% in your first year) while giving developers fast, reliable feedback on every merge request. This is a hands-on CI/CD role inside engineering, not an infrastructure DevOps role. You will spend most of your time optimising builds and pipelines, and a smaller share keeping them running.
Key Initiatives:

Reduce Pipeline Time:
Map the critical path, remove waiting between jobs, cut per-job overhead (clone, artifact download, restore) and cancel redundant pipelines automatically.
Job Strategy:
Decide what runs where and when: fast merge request checks, fuller runs on main and release branches, and complete nightly runs. Group short jobs, split long ones and parallelise long system test suites.
Tests in the Pipeline:
With the test architect, place each test type in the right pipeline tier, select tests by change where safe, quarantine flaky tests and move coverage runs to scheduled pipelines.
Release Pipelines:
Make release and cherry-pick pipelines fast and predictable so fixes reach customers quickly.

Key Responsibilities:

Build Performance:
Profile and optimise MSBuild-based builds for C#/.NET Framework 4.7 and C++: incremental and parallel builds, NuGet and dependency caching, and removal of bottlenecks.
Pipeline Design:
Design, standardise and maintain reusable GitLab CI pipeline templates (.gitlab-ci.yml, DAGs, multi-project pipelines) across C#, C++ and Python repositories.
Test & Verification Integration:
With the test architect, development and QA/verification leads, embed unit tests, static analysis (Coverity, SonarQube) and automated test bench runs into CI, with clear results reporting. Agree jointly with the test architect which suites run in each pipeline tier.
Pipeline Reliability & Metrics:
Investigate failures, remove flaky builds and tests, and track build time, failure rate and pipeline uptime on dashboards to show improvement.
Pipeline Operations:
Act as first line on the engineering side when pipelines or runners go down: diagnose, restart or re-run jobs, unblock developers, and hand infrastructure issues to IT-DevOps with a clear diagnosis.
Capacity Input:
Give IT-DevOps data-backed requirements for build runners and test environments, based on queue times and job durations.
Artifact & Release Automation:
Automate versioning, release packaging, artifact staging and package registry management.
Developer Workflow:
Advise teams on branching and merge strategies, merge request verification gates and fast feedback loops.

Scope

GitLab runner management, AWS/cloud infrastructure and GitLab platform administration are owned by the IT-DevOps team. This role works with them on requirements and issues but does not own that infrastructure. It is their engineering-side point of contact: first line when pipelines are down, and input on sizing what we need.

Required Qualifications & Skills:

Master's or Bachelor's Degree in Information Technology, Computer Engineering, Telecommunications, or relevant discipline.
At least 5+ years in CI/CD, build engineering or release automation for multi-repository C#/.NET and C++ codebases.
Deep hands-on experience with MSBuild and .NET Framework 4.x builds on Windows; experience with C++ builds (MSBuild/CMake).
CI/CD Platform:
Strong GitLab CI/CD skills: pipeline authoring, DAGs, multi-project pipelines, caching and artifact management.
Scripting:
Strong PowerShell and Python for pipeline logic, build orchestration and log analysis; our build also includes Python-based simulation.
Test Execution in CI:
Experience splitting, grouping and parallelising long-running test suites, and detecting and managing flaky tests.
Containers:
Working knowledge of Docker for build and test jobs.
Problem-Solving & Communication:
Able to root-cause complex build, link and test integration failures.
Fluent English for working across regions.

Preferred/ Good to Have:

Experience in semiconductor equipment, high-tech machine automation, or hardware/software integration environments.
Hands-on use of Coverity, SonarQube and test management tools (Xray, Jira).
Experience with build acceleration or distributed build tools.
Experience migrating old-style .csproj projects to SDK-style.

Solution Architecture for Agentic Managed Services

Define cost-control mechanisms including model routing, caching, batching, token governance, scaling policies, FinOps dashboards, and usage analytics.
Agentic Automation and Process Transformation
Design agentic patterns such as planning, routing, delegation, tool use, memory, reflection, approval workflows, and multi-agent collaboration for enterprise operations.

Embed AI governance controls for responsible AI, data privacy, access control, auditability, explainability, model risk, and regulatory compliance.

jobs.title: NETSUITE ARCHITECT
jobs.description:
JOB DESCRIPTION – NETSUITE ARCHITECT (FIXED TERM CONTRACT - 2 Years)

THE TEAM & THE JOB

The Enterprise Systems NetSuite team owns the support, development and strategic direction of YouGov's NetSuite ERP platform, the system underpinning the company's core finance processes. The team is being reshaped to combine operational analyst support with dedicated architectural capability under the Senior Finance Systems Implementation Manager.

As NetSuite Architect, you will be the expert-level professional providing technical leadership for the platform on a fixed term contract. You will own the overall technical vision and architecture, define the "how" and "what" of solutions on significant and unique issues, and act as the recognised subject matter expert advising senior stakeholders. You will translate the functional vision for the ERP into an architectural plan and guide its execution, maintaining a future-focused approach to scalability, maintainability and long-term platform evolution.

What You Will Be Doing – Key Responsibilities

Own the end-to-end technical vision and architecture for the NetSuite platform, translating business strategy into an architectural roadmap.
Design and architect end-to-end NetSuite solutions, including customisations, integrations and workflows, exercising considerable creativity, foresight and judgment.
Make high-impact technical decisions on integration patterns, customisation approaches and data models, evaluating trade-offs between business needs, intangibles and technical constraints.
Assess and document the existing customised NetSuite landscape (scripts, workflows, forms, integrations) to support future transitions and upgrades.
Architect integrations across multiple systems using SuiteTalk, RESTlets and middleware platforms.
Define and enforce NetSuite development standards, governance policies and best practices across the platform.
Lead complex, enterprise-wide NetSuite initiatives from requirements gathering through deployment and post-go-live support.
Conduct solution design reviews, code reviews and performance optimisation assessments, providing expert technical leadership and mentorship to the wider team.
Advise senior business and functional stakeholders, developing recommendations and persuading diverse audiences on platform decisions and module/third-party evaluation.
Produce comprehensive technical architecture documentation, data models and integration specifications so knowledge is retained beyond the contract term.
Work closely with the Senior Finance Systems Implementation Manager, the Senior NetSuite Analyst, Finance stakeholders and third-party providers, staying current with NetSuite platform updates and industry trends.

What You Need To Know (technical & Behavioural Skills/Competencies)

6–8+ years' hands-on NetSuite experience operating as an architect, with a proven track record of leading full implementation lifecycles as a technical leader.
Experience architecting solutions independently across multiple implementations or complex enterprise-wide projects, in more than one enterprise-sized organisation.
Deep technical expertise across the entire NetSuite platform, including expert knowledge of SuiteScript 2.x (Client, User Event, Scheduled, RESTlets, Map/Reduce) and custom development.
Extensive experience with SuiteFlow, SuiteTalk (SOAP/REST), SuiteAnalytics and SuiteBundler, and a deep understanding of NetSuite data architecture, saved searches and custom records.
Strong understanding of enterprise architecture patterns and experience with integration platforms (Boomi, Celigo, Workato, MuleSoft or similar).
Strong knowledge of accounting principles and ERP business processes (Order-to-Cash, Procure-to-Pay, Financial Close).
Conceptual thinking to work on significant and unique issues where analysis requires evaluation of intangibles, with independent judgment on methods, techniques and evaluation criteria (be accountable).
Ability to convey complex, non-routine information and persuade diverse senior stakeholders across multiple cultures, frequently advising others on complex matters (communicate clearly).
A collaborative approach to technical leadership, building capability in others rather than holding knowledge (trust each other), and staying current with platform and industry developments (be fast).
NetSuite certifications (Administrator, SuiteFoundation; SuiteCloud Developer II preferred) and ideally architect qualifications such as TOGAF or CSA.
Bachelor's degree in Computer Science, Information Systems or a related field, or equivalent experience.

Why join YouGov?

Join our global team to help us achieve our social mission: to make millions of people’s opinions heard for the benefit of our local, national, and international communities.

Understanding diversity of opinion requires diversity of background. Although our global panel of millions of people worldwide powers our research, our biggest asset is our people. If our research is to be truly representative of what the world thinks, we need people from all walks of life to be part of the team to bring their perspective to the work we do.

Life at YouGov

We are driven by a set of shared values. We are fast, fearless, and innovative. We work diligently to get it right. We are guided by accuracy, ethics, and proven methodologies. We respect and trust each other, bringing these values into everything that we do.

We strive to provide YouGovers with best-in-class benefits to support their physical, financial, and emotional wellbeing. We want our employees to have a sense of belonging and uniqueness in a supportive workplace, so they can bring their full selves to work.

Equal Opportunity Employer

As an Equal Opportunity Employer, qualified applicants will receive consideration for employment without regard to race, color, religion, sex (including pregnancy, gender identity or expression, and sexual orientation), parental status, national origin, marital status, age, disability, genetic information, HIV status, political affiliation, socioeconomic background, veteran status or any other characteristic protected by law or in line with our responsibilities as a fair and ethic employer. All employment decisions are made based on occupational qualifications, merit, and business need.

Data Privacy

jobs.description:
🚀 **Senior Software Engineer Arıyoruz!**

Ingenium olarak ölçeklenebilir yazılım sistemleri, yapay zekâ uygulamaları ve cloud tabanlı ürünler geliştiren ekibimize katılacak deneyimli bir **Senior Software Engineer** arıyoruz.

Bu pozisyonda yalnızca geliştirme yapmak değil; sistem mimarisi, teknik kararlar, code quality, deployment süreçleri ve junior geliştiricilerin teknik gelişiminde aktif rol almak beklenmektedir.

# Aradığımız Nitelikler #

• Bilgisayar Mühendisliği, Yazılım Mühendisliği veya ilgili bölümlerden **mezun olmak**
• Tercihen **5+ yıl profesyonel yazılım geliştirme deneyimi**
• Production ortamında çalışan, ölçeklenebilir uygulamalar geliştirme ve sürdürme deneyimi
• **Rust** ile profesyonel veya ileri seviyede geliştirme deneyimi
• Algorithms, data structures, concurrency ve software design principles konularında güçlü teknik temel
• **System Design, distributed systems ve scalable architecture** konularında deneyim
• REST API ve servis tabanlı backend mimarilerinin tasarımı ve geliştirilmesinde deneyim
• **SQL, PostgreSQL** ve ilişkisel veritabanları konusunda güçlü bilgi; query optimization ve database design deneyimi
• **Git** tabanlı profesyonel development workflow'larına hakimiyet
• **Docker** ve container tabanlı production ortamlarında ileri seviye deneyim
• **CI/CD pipeline'larının** tasarlanması, kurulması ve yönetilmesi konusunda deneyim
• **AWS** üzerinde production sistemleri geliştirme, deploy etme ve yönetme deneyimi
• Cloud architecture, scalability, availability, monitoring ve security prensiplerine hakimiyet
• **LLM tabanlı uygulamaların** tasarlanması ve production ortamına alınması konusunda deneyim
• LLM API'leri, prompt engineering, structured outputs ve tool/function calling konularında deneyim
• Debugging, profiling, logging ve production troubleshooting konusunda güçlü yetkinlik
• Clean Code, SOLID, testing ve maintainable software development prensiplerine hakimiyet
• Code review süreçlerini yönetebilecek ve teknik standartların korunmasına katkı sağlayabilecek deneyim
• Teknik dokümantasyon ve uluslararası kaynaklarla rahat çalışabilecek seviyede İngilizce

# Tercih Sebebi Olabilecek Yetkinlikler #

• Büyük ölçekli veya yüksek trafikli sistemlerde çalışma deneyimi
• Rust ile production seviyesinde backend/service geliştirmiş olmak
• **Microservices ve distributed systems** mimarileriyle çalışmış olmak
• **Kubernetes** ve container orchestration deneyimi
• AWS üzerinde **EC2, ECS/EKS, Lambda, S3, RDS, CloudFront, IAM, CloudWatch** gibi servislerle çalışma deneyimi
• Infrastructure as Code konusunda Terraform veya benzeri araçlarla deneyim
• Redis, message queues ve event-driven architectures konusunda deneyim
• **RAG, embeddings, vector databases, AI agents, tool calling ve agentic workflows** konusunda production deneyimi
• LLM sistemlerinde evaluation, observability, latency ve maliyet optimizasyonu konusunda deneyim
• Automated testing, integration testing ve end-to-end testing süreçlerinde deneyim
• Application security ve secure coding konusunda bilgi
• Monitoring ve observability araçlarıyla production sistemlerini takip etme deneyimi
• Teknik liderlik, mentoring ve junior/mid-level geliştiricilerin gelişimine katkı sağlama deneyimi

# Rol ve Sorumluluklar #

• Ölçeklenebilir ve sürdürülebilir yazılım mimarileri tasarlamak
• Production seviyesinde yüksek kaliteli yazılım geliştirmek
• Teknik kararların ve architecture süreçlerinin oluşturulmasına katkı sağlamak
• AWS altyapısı, deployment ve CI/CD süreçlerinin geliştirilmesine katkıda bulunmak
• AI ve LLM tabanlı ürünlerin geliştirilmesi ve production'a alınmasında aktif rol almak
• Code review yapmak ve engineering standartlarının korunmasını sağlamak
• Performance, reliability ve security problemlerini analiz ederek çözmek
• Junior ve mid-level geliştiricilere teknik destek ve mentoring sağlamak

# Ingenium'da Seni Neler Bekliyor? #

Ingenium'da yalnızca bir iş değil; çalışanlarımızın profesyonel gelişimini, sağlığını ve yaşam kalitesini destekleyen güçlü bir çalışma ortamı sunuyoruz.

• 🏢 **İTÜ ARI Teknokent bünyesinde çalışma imkânı** ve Türkiye'nin önde gelen teknoloji ve inovasyon ekosistemlerinden birinin parçası olma fırsatı

• 🍽️ **Yemek kartı**
• 🏋️ **MultiSport üyeliği** ile geniş spor ve aktivite ağına erişim
• 💻 Pozisyona uygun modern donanım ve teknolojik ekipman desteği
• 📚 Eğitim, teknik kaynak ve profesyonel gelişim desteği
• 🚀 Ar-Ge, yapay zekâ ve yeni nesil yazılım teknolojileri üzerinde çalışma fırsatı
• 🤖 LLM, cloud, Rust ve modern yazılım altyapılarıyla gerçek ürünler geliştirme deneyimi
• 📈 Sorumluluk alabileceğin, etki yaratabileceğin ve şirketle birlikte kariyerini geliştirebileceğin bir çalışma ortamı
• 💡 Yeni fikirlerin, teknik inisiyatiflerin ve yenilikçi yaklaşımların desteklendiği mühendislik odaklı kültür
• 🤝 Deneyimli ekip üyeleriyle bilgi paylaşımı ve sürekli gelişim imkânı
• 🌐 Gerçek kullanıcılarla buluşan, büyük ölçekli ürünlerin geliştirme süreçlerinde aktif rol alma fırsatı

🚀 **We’re Hiring: Senior Software Engineer**

Ingenium is looking for an experienced **Senior Software Engineer** to join our engineering team building scalable software systems, AI-powered applications, and cloud-native products.

This role goes beyond writing code. You will be expected to contribute to system architecture, technical decisions, engineering standards, production infrastructure, and the technical growth of other engineers.

jobs.description:
We are
invent.ai

invent.ai is a fast-growing company providing AI-Decisioning for Inventory, Merchandising and Pricing Optimization Solutions to retailers around the world. This is an exciting time at Invent, as we are growing our client base, our product portfolio, and our teams to revolutionize the supply chain planning industry.

We are a group of bright, kind, and goal-oriented people working together to make retail better. We take pride in what we do. As a provider of award-winning enterprise-AI SaaS solutions that serve a growing international business with customers across the U.S., Europe, the Middle East, and East Asia, we make a measurable and meaningful difference for our customers every day.

Headquartered in the United States and with offices around the world, our team of 350+ people consists of young engineers and data scientists from the top CS and engineering programs working remotely out of our Istanbul, Philadelphia, Amsterdam, and London offices.

For more information, visit www.invent.ai

About Role

We are seeking a Solution Architect
to join our Delivery organization and take on a strategic role that strengthens our project delivery capabilities. The role is critical for ensuring scalable, cost-efficient, and high-quality implementations of Invent.ai solutions. Solution Architects act as technical leaders across pre-, during, and post-delivery phases, helping increase project throughput, improve architectural rigor, and support broader operational excellence.

What You Will Do

Serve as the primary technical point of contact in delivery projects: design, review, and lead scalable solution implementations across client engagements.
Post-delivery, provide structured support to the Client Excellence team via dedicated Architect Task Clinics to troubleshoot, optimize, and scale client-facing solutions.
Understand business and data requirements and translate them into technical solution designs, data flows, integrations, and high-level architectures.
Participate in and facilitate customer-facing data workshops and design meetings, guiding discussions toward clear and actionable outcomes.
Engage with customers to understand and clarify their data requirements, existing data structures, business needs, and technical constraints.
Present and explain our data structures, data models, integration approaches, and platform capabilities, helping customers understand how their requirements can be addressed.
Identify gaps between customer requirements and existing data structures or capabilities, and collaboratively shape, refine, or adapt solutions to address them.
Translate agreed customer requirements into data structures, mappings, data flows, integration requirements, and solution designs.
Produce architecture diagrams and supporting technical documentation to clearly communicate proposed solutions.
Evaluate solution options and articulate technical trade-offs, risks, dependencies, and design considerations.
Apply established architecture principles, standards, patterns, and reference architectures.
Support architecture assessments and design decisions, and help ensure delivered solutions remain aligned with the agreed architecture and design.
Partner with the Center of Excellence to develop and maintain best practices and reusable assets that improve delivery efficiency and enable scalable knowledge transfer across teams.

Experience

Skill Set Required

L0 — Transactional

L1 — Copilot / Augmented
: Uses AI to draft e-mails / partial slides but not multi-step delivery workflows.

L2 — Agentic Development
: Delegates multi-step tasks to AI agents; automates status reports; triages runs with Claude + SQL; validates outputs before sending. Our standard target.

L3 — Spec-Driven
: Orchestrates an end-to-end implementation engine: discovery → config → runs → QA → comms via AI. Owns 2+ internal skills / plugins used by peers.

AI-First Requirements

jobs.title: Full Stack Software Developer
jobs.description:
New software product team - Automation Edge Applications

The role

At Everllence Automation Edge Applications, we are establishing a new software product team in Piraeus, Greece. You will work closely with colleagues in Denmark and engage with customers across Greece and the Mediterranean region.
The team's mission is to develop customer-facing applications that help vessel crews and shipping companies operate and optimize engine performance more efficiently.

As a Full Stack Software Developer
, you will play a key role in designing, developing, and maintaining applications that support vessel crews in operating, monitoring, and optimizing engine performance. You will work closely with UX researchers, data specialists, engine experts, and fellow developers to transform customer needs and operational insights into reliable, scalable, and user-friendly software solutions.
This is a unique opportunity to help shape a newly established product team while benefiting from the support, expertise, and stability of a global engineering organization.

What you will be doing

Design and build customer-facing applications that improve troubleshooting and help vessel crews operate engines effectively.
Develop end-to-end features using C# or Python on the backend and Node.js, React, and our QUILT application framework on the frontend.
Turn input from users, UX research, and engine specialists into well-defined technical solutions and iterative product releases.
Define maintainable application architectures, APIs, data flows, and reusable user interface components.
Design software for the realities of onboard environments, including intermittent connectivity, limited computing resources, and software that cannot always be updated immediately.
Build quality into products through automated testing, code reviews, secure development practices, and useful diagnostics.
Own features throughout their lifecycle, from technical design and implementation to deployment, monitoring, and troubleshooting in collaboration with colleagues across locations.
Collaborate closely with UX researchers, data scientists, domain experts, and fellow developers throughout the product development lifecycle.
Utilize AI-assisted development tools and emerging technologies where they create value while maintaining accountability for software quality, security, and reliability.

Who you are

You are a pragmatic software developer who enjoys turning complex operational requirements into simple, dependable solutions for end users.

Ideally, You Bring

Professional experience delivering full stack web applications and taking features from idea to production.
Strong skills in C#, Python, TypeScript, or similar technologies, with experience in modern backend development.
Experience working with Node.js and React or comparable frontend frameworks.
Experience designing APIs, integrating data sources, and working with version control and continuous integration practices.
Experience with containerization such as Docker.
A quality-focused approach that includes automated testing, maintainability, security, observability, and production support.
The ability to explain technical trade-offs and collaborate effectively with UX researchers, domain specialists, and fellow developers.
Experience within maritime, industrial, manufacturing, energy, edge-computing, or other operational environments is considered an advantage, but not required.
Proficiency in English language.

You are curious, constructive, and comfortable working in a newly established team where priorities may evolve as we learn from customers. You balance speed with sound engineering judgment and understand that software used aboard a vessel must be reliable, secure, and supportable.

Benefits & Learning Opportunities

Flexible working arrangements, including the possibility to work from home 2-3 days per week after the initial onboarding period of three months, subject to manager agreement and business requirements.
Attractive compensation package
Continuous training opportunities
Work in a challenging multinational environment
Opportunities for professional growth and advancement

Welcome to Everllence Greece and the Automation Edge Application Team

You will be joining our Automation Edge Applications team, consisting of 21 colleagues, including software developers, engineers, designers, and product managers. The team is responsible for designing and developing the digital products used by vessel crews when operating and optimizing our engines.
The team is primarily located in Denmark and works closely with an additional team of 12 colleagues based in India.
The Automation Edge Applications team is part of the Automation function within Everllence R&D, an organization of approximately 160 professionals responsible for the electronic control systems of our engines.
You will be based in our established hub in Piraeus, Greece, and become part of the local Software Engineering organization, where colleagues contribute to a variety of global software and digitalization initiatives across Everllence.
While your day-to-day work will be closely connected to the international Edge Applications team, you will also benefit from being part of a local engineering community and collaborating with professionals across the Piraeus site.

About The Team's Mission

The team is focused on creating customer value by combining user research, customer insights, data-driven analysis, and software development.
The goal is to engage directly with customers, both onboard vessels and in shore-based operations, and transform their needs into valuable digital products. These solutions may help improve troubleshooting, optimize engine performance in relation to other onboard systems, or provide actionable insights through data analytics for shipping companies.
While this role focuses on UX research and design, you will work as part of a multidisciplinary team where different competencies come together to deliver customer-centric solutions.

What you should know about us

Everllence, , enables it customers to achieve sustainable value creation in the transition towards a carbon neutral future. Addressing tomorrow's challenges within the marine, energy and industrial sectors, we improve efficiency and performance at a systematic level. Leading the way in advanced engineering for more than 250 years, we provide a unique portfolio of technologies. Headquartered in Germany, Everllence employs some 15,000 people at over 120 sites globally. Our after sales brand, Everllence PrimeServ offers a vast network of service centers to our customers all over the world.
EVERLLENCE Hellas has been active in the Greek market since 1966 and we operate in Piraeus, Perama and Limassol (Cyprus). Our main areas of expertise is: Νew Sales, Αfter Sales services (Spare Parts and Technical), Data Processing, Engineering Services, PrimeServ Academy.

That is important to us

We look for energetic and keen people, excited to join a dynamic international company.
Only completed applications submitted in English will be considered.

Je bent iemand die initiatief neemt, graag meedenkt over oplossingen, mogelijke oplossingen ziet in problemen en die actief in het gesprek brengt.

TypeScript en Angular

Microservices, High Availability, Loosely Coupled Architectures

BPMN of workflow engines zoals Camunda
Domain Driven Design
Ervaring met AI-ondersteunde developmenttools of AI-integraties in applicaties

Contract van onbepaalde duur.

je ontvangt een competitief salaris aangevuld met een uitgebreid pakket extralegale voordelen, zoals hospitalisatie- en tandzorgverzekering, groepsverzekering, ecocheques, gsm met abonnement, optieplan, extra verlofdagen (bank holidays), Benefits at Work, restaurant met versbereide maaltijden, keuze uit bedrijfswagen of andere (mobiliteits)oplossingen via het mobiliteitsbudget.

jobs.title: Cyber Security Engineer
Principal Cloud Architect
jobs.description:
Job Description

The Role

The Evolve programme is accelerating Euroclear’s adoption of public cloud by establishing secure, resilient and scalable foundations, architecture standards and reusable implementation patterns. It brings together architecture, engineering, security, operations and migration stakeholders to enable workloads to move to and operate effectively on Azure in line with Euroclear’s business, risk and regulatory requirements.

As Principal Cloud Architect, you will act as a senior architecture leader for cloud adoption. You will set architecture direction across a broad, cross-organisational scope; help mature the Cloud Solution Design Authority into an effective and sustainable decision-making body; steer cloud foundation priorities; govern architecture artefacts and reference implementations; and provide pragmatic guidance to workload teams.

The role combines strategic architecture leadership, hands-on delivery support and cross-functional decision-making. A key outcome is to expand Euroclear’s cloud presence responsibly by turning cloud strategy and principles into actionable standards, deployable patterns and sound workload decisions.

Key Responsibilities

Cloud Solution Design Authority

Mature the Cloud Solution Design Authority by clarifying its mandate, decision rights, intake process, governance, cadence, quality criteria and follow-up of architecture decisions.
Establish a sustainable operating rhythm that enables timely, traceable and risk-informed decisions.
Facilitate complex architecture discussions, document outcomes and ensure that decisions, conditions and actions have clear owners.
Improve the quality and consistency of architecture submissions by providing guidance, templates and early engagement.

Cloud Foundations and Roadmap

Refine, prioritise and maintain the cloud foundation roadmap across identity, connectivity, security, governance, management, operations and automation.
Balance migration demand, risk reduction, platform scalability, technical debt and delivery capacity when setting priorities.
Identify cross-platform dependencies and sequence foundation capabilities so that workload teams can adopt cloud safely and efficiently.
Advise programme and technology leadership on architecture choices, investment priorities and delivery trade-offs.

Architecture Direction and Artefacts

Develop, maintain and govern cloud architecture principles, standards, target-state designs, roadmaps and architecture decision records.
Translate enterprise strategy, regulatory expectations and delivery needs into clear architecture direction.
Ensure cloud architecture remains aligned with enterprise, security, data, resilience and technology standards.
Maintain traceability between strategic objectives, architecture decisions, implementation guidance and delivery outcomes.

Reference Implementations and Reusable Patterns

Prioritise reusable cloud patterns and reference implementations based on workload demand, risk reduction and strategic value.
Guide their delivery so that approved patterns are deployable, testable, automated and consumable by workload teams.
Translate architecture into infrastructure-as-code accelerators, policy-driven guardrails and reusable platform services.
Promote standardisation and governed self-service while limiting manual fulfilment and one-off solutions to justified exceptions.

Workload Assessment and Migration Guidance

Support migration teams and workload owners in assessing application architecture, dependencies, data, security, resilience, operability, compatibility and migration readiness.
Recommend appropriate migration or modernisation strategies based on business value, criticality, compliance, lifecycle impact and technical feasibility.
Help teams select the most appropriate service model, considering SaaS, PaaS, containers and IaaS without assuming that one model is universally optimal.
Identify architecture gaps and convert assessment findings into actionable remediation, sequencing and decision points.

Cloud Footprint and Regional Architecture

Shape the expansion of Euroclear’s cloud footprint, including new-region adoption, regional operating models and multi-region approaches.
Assess implications for foundations, connectivity, identity, security, data residency, resilience, operations, support and cost.
Define architecture guidance for workload placement and regional deployment.
Ensure exceptions to approved regions or patterns have documented rationale, risk assessment, ownership and approval.

Sustainability and Net-Zero Assessment

Assess the cloud implications of sustainability and Net-Zero-related decisions.
Evaluate architecture trade-offs involving region selection, service choices, resource efficiency, carbon considerations, cost, resilience and performance.
Promote efficient use of managed and cloud-native services where they provide measurable value and acceptable risk.
Ensure sustainability considerations are incorporated into architecture decisions and roadmaps without compromising security, regulation or service quality.

Architecture Assurance

Review solution designs and assess alignment with approved principles, standards, target architectures and reference patterns.
Identify material risks, gaps and deviations, and provide clear recommendations to delivery teams and decision-makers.
Ensure exceptions have an explicit rationale, accountable owner, remediation action and expiry or review date.
Track recurring deviations and use them to improve standards, patterns, platform capabilities and governance.

Stakeholder Alignment and Leadership

Work closely with Enterprise Architecture, Cloud Engineering, CISO, Production, Business Resilience, migration teams, programme leadership and workload owners.
Resolve architectural dependencies and accelerate decisions across organisational boundaries.
Influence senior business and IT stakeholders by making complex trade-offs clear and decision-ready.
Challenge constructively and drive outcomes without relying solely on formal authority.

Architecture Community and Knowledge Transfer

Coach and mentor architects and engineers working on cloud initiatives.
Strengthen the architecture community through knowledge sharing, reviews, reusable guidance and lessons learned.
Ensure cloud standards, patterns and decision processes are understood and applied consistently.
Promote pragmatic, collaborative and outcome-focused ways of working across architecture and delivery teams.

Candidate Profile

Required Experience

Extensive experience as a cloud architect, enterprise architect or principal solution architect in large-scale technology transformation.
Demonstrated experience leading architecture across complex, cross-organisational business and IT scopes.
Strong practical knowledge of Microsoft Azure, including landing zones, identity and access management, network topology, security, governance, policy, management, observability and platform automation.
Experience establishing or maturing design authorities, architecture review boards, decision processes and architecture assurance practices.
Proven ability to develop and govern principles, standards, target architectures, roadmaps, architecture decision records, reference patterns and implementation guidance.
Experience translating architecture into infrastructure-as-code accelerators, reference implementations, guardrails and consumable platform services.
Practical experience assessing workload architecture, dependencies, data, security, resilience, operability and compatibility, and recommending migration or modernisation strategies.
Experience designing or governing multi-region cloud environments, including region selection, connectivity, data residency, resilience, operational support and cost trade-offs.

Diversity & Miteinander

Vielfalt gehört bei uns zum Alltag. Unterschiedliche Identitäten, Perspektiven und Lebenswege bereichern unsere Zusammenarbeit und unser Miteinander. Deine Energie entfaltet sich dann am besten, wenn du selbst mitgestalten kannst. Wer Energie gibt, braucht auch Energie zurück. In unserer Betriebsküche gibt es täglich frische Auswahl - leistbar, ausgewogen und nah am Alltag. Obstkörbe und Getränke sorgen für kleine Pausen zwischendurch.

Gesundheit

Damit du deine Energie für Wiens Energie einbringen kannst, braucht es auch Raum für dich. Mit Angeboten rund um Bewegung, mentale Gesundheit, Prävention und Balance unterstützen wir dich dabei, gut durch den Alltag zu kommen und langfristig gesund zu bleiben.

Wir arbeiten miteinander abteilungs- und standortübergreifend. Im #TeamWienEnergie unterstützen wir uns, denken bereichsübergreifend und feiern auch gemeinsame Erfolge. Wir erreichen mehr, wenn wir verbunden bleiben.

Neue Ideen brauchen Raum und Menschen, die sie einbringen. In Kooperation mit Hochschulen, Start-ups und im Team entwickeln wir Lösungen, die Wien nachhaltig bewegen. Deine Energie zählt dabei genauso wie dein Blick über den Tellerrand.

Jobticket

Manchmal braucht das Leben mehr Raum und den geben wir, wo es möglich ist. Mit Angeboten wie heycare unterstützen wir dich auch ganz konkret im Alltag, wie etwa bei der Betreuung von Kindern, älteren Angehörigen oder Haustieren.

Lernen & Wachsen

Du wirst vom ersten Tag an gut begleitet. Ob Onboarding, Fachtrainings, Persönlichkeitsentwicklung oder individuelle Karrierepfade: Wir fördern dein Können und deine Energie auf dem Weg, der zu dir passt.

Mentoring & Wissensaustausch

Bei uns lernst du nicht nur in Trainings, sondern von und mit Kolleg*innen: durch strukturierte Mentoring-Programme (auch konzernweit), Erfahrungsaustausch und Formate, in denen Wissen geteilt und weitergegeben wird.

Sinnstiftende Arbeit

Unsere Arbeit hat Wirkung: heute und für kommende Generationen. Mit deiner Energie leistest du einen Beitrag zur klimafreundlichen Energiezukunft und zur Lebensqualität in unserer Stadt.

„Meine Energie für Wiens Energie“ bringt auf den Punkt, was uns verbindet, ganz gleich, in welcher Rolle du bei uns wirkst.

Vergünstigungen & Vorsorge

Als Teil unseres #TeamWienEnergie profitierst du von Angeboten, die deinen Alltag bereichern - von Sport und Kultur bis zu attraktiven Konditionen bei Partner*innenunternehmen in und rund um Wien. Mit betrieblicher Vorsorge denken wir auch an später. Weil es nicht nur um den Job geht, sondern auch darum, gut abgesichert zu sein.

With a team of around 280 highly qualified employees at our locations in Vienna, Graz, and Linz and a global team of 8,000 colleagues, we are constantly striving to develop and grow. Our customers trust in our solutions, which is why we are continuously looking for new talents.

As a (Senior) Fullstack Developer, you will take ownership of technical solutions from concept to production, actively contributing to architecture, technology choices, and implementation quality. Design, develop, and implement high-quality fullstack solutions for customer projects
Work directly with customers to understand business requirements and translate them into technical solutions
Develop scalable backend services and modern frontend applications
Ensure high standards for code quality, security, performance, and maintainability
Participate in customer workshops, agile ceremonies, and solution discussions
Stay up-to-date with emerging technologies and industry trends
Contribute to the design and implementation of cloud-native web solutions on hyperscaler platforms (e.g. Azure), including architecture decisions and best practices
Continuously evaluate and introduce new tools, frameworks, and practices

4+ years of experience as Fullstack Developer
Strong proficiency both in frontend (React and/or Angular) and backend technologies (Java and/or C#)
Experience with RESTful APIs and microservices as well as with databases and cloud services
Experience in the use of AI-assisted development tools and methodologies (e.g., GitHub Copilot, coding agents / agentic coding) to enhance development productivity and code quality, as well as to support documentation, testing, and problem-solving activities

Strong communication skills and a customer-oriented mindset
A curious mindset and willingness to learn and share knowledge
Very good German and English skills

We offer

We offer you an opportunity to create the future of a growing, fast-developing, and important sector.

Description

About Xe

Xe is a cross-border payments platform. We help SMEs and consumers in the US, UK, Canada, Australia, and New Zealand collect, convert, hold, and send money across markets. Each year, over 300 million people use Xe for currency information and over 350,000 use us to send money overseas.

Today, we're rebuilding the platform layer behind cross-border payments for corporate and consumer clients. We're small enough that your code ships fast and your decisions matter, and Euronet Worldwide (Nasdaq: EEFT) backs us so the problems stay real-scale.

About This Role

We're hiring a senior back-end engineer who owns real problems end-to-end and shapes how the team builds, from API design and data modeling through to service implementation, production reliability, and launch. You already use AI as part of how you think, build, test, and ship.

You'll write code that moves money in production, design and modernize the backend services the platform runs on, and lead delivery of new capability as Xe rebuilds its platform layer. You'll work in a small team with direct access to product, compliance, and operations, own architecture in your domain, lead design reviews, mentor mid-level engineers, and partner with architects and team leads on cross-domain decisions.

What You'll Do

Design and own backend services that move money and manage multi-currency balances across a range of domains, including onboarding, KYC and KYB, payment initiation, FX, settlement, and other supporting services.
Lead cross-functional delivery with product, compliance, and operations from problem framing through launch.
Lead the build of the partner integrations and settlement infrastructure your domain depends on.
Own production health for your domain, including reliability, observability, on-call, and incident response.

What We're Looking For

Must-have

6 to 10+ years building production backend services, end-to-end.
Strong backend proficiency in C# / .NET preferred; other OOP languages welcome (Java, Kotlin, Go, or equivalent).
SQL and relational database fundamentals.
Writing and maintaining tests.
Daily use of agentic coding tools (Copilot, Cursor, Claude Code, or equivalent) across the SDLC.
Production experience with AWS, including hands-on deployment, CI/CD pipelines and modern deployment practices, and native services such as SQS, DynamoDB, S3, ECS, and Lambda.
Strong system design and architecture experience, including service-oriented or microservices and event-driven patterns.
Payments, FX, or regulated-industry experience.
Track record of technical leadership: mentoring engineers, leading design reviews, and making architecture decisions in your domain.
Strong written and verbal communication.

Experience with ledgers, double-entry accounting, or other financial-data systems.
Experience hiring, interviewing, or onboarding engineers.
Experience leading modernization or platform migrations.
Experience with caching solutions like Memcached or Redis.
Experience using project management and documentation tools like Jira and Confluence.
Knowledge of API testing tools such as Postman or Bruno.
Writing automated tests alongside development with AI tools (Claude Code or equivalent).

Omada Identity is a leading cloud-based Identity Governance and Administration platform. We help enterprises ensure that the right people and the right non-human identities have the right access to the right resources, at the right time.
We work with security-conscious enterprises across regulated industries. Our customers rely on us to govern access for tens of thousands of identities across hybrid environments. We are recognized by industry analysts as a leader in the IGA space.

We own the data and reporting layer of the product: the Omada Data Warehouse (ODW), History Tracking, Report Generator, Access Navigator and our analytics dashboards. Our work gives customers visibility into who has access to what, how that access changed over time, and whether it complies with policy.
We are a distributed team of eight engineers across Spain and Poland. Our product runs in SaaS (Azure Kubernetes Service, multi-tenant), private cloud and on-premises deployments, so the work we do has to hold up in very different environments.

jobs.title: Artificial Intelligence Engineer
jobs.description:
Do you think like an engineer first, and a language specialist second?

We are looking for engineers who want to build t he next generation of cloud-native financial technology.

Our platforms run on .NET and Java, but we are not looking for C# or Java developers (or Python developers, or developers of any other language). We are looking for software engineers
, because what matters is that you can reason about distributed systems, become productive quickly in an unfamiliar codebase — including one written in a language you have not used before — and use AI as a real engineering partner rather than an autocomplete tool.

We build a cloud-native core banking platform
that safeguards billions of euros of real customers' money. The bar for reliability, scalability, and security is exceptionally high, and we are continuously reinventing how we build software. If you want to help shape the future of engineering rather than watch it happen, we'd love to talk to you.

Briefing

Ohpen launched the world's first cloud-native core banking platform. We don't just use technology - we build it, and we operate it in production for regulated financial institutions.

You'll join a cross-functional team with end-to-end ownership of a domain: design, build, deploy, operate, support. Not a ticket queue. Deployment is where the value gets delivered, so it isn't a step you hand to another team once the code is written. You'll be accountable for how your services behave in production, not only for how they look at code review.

You'd be working on a platform that has been live and evolving for more than a decade. A lot of the work is understanding, extending, and safely replacing systems that carry real business logic for real clients. The interesting problem here is not writing code quickly — that is now cheap. It is knowing what to change, what it will break, and how to prove it worked.

AI is a first-class tool in that work (expected, not just tolerated). You'll use it to build context on unfamiliar code, explore designs, generate and review implementations, and remove routine work. You stay in the driver's seat: you decide what to accept, what to challenge, and when the model is confidently wrong.

About You

You're a generalist by instinct.
You've worked in more than one language or platform, and you'd learn another if the job needed it. You don't introduce yourself as a C# or a Java developer.
You've run what you built.
Distributed, event-driven backend systems in production — headless, API-first, where the numbers had to be right and downtime had real consequences.
You think in systems.
Where the coupling sits, what a change is likely to break, how the pieces talk to each other. You will design clear boundaries around complex banking domains, keep API changes backward compatible, and choose simple designs by default. For workflows where reads, writes, and audit requirements differ, you’ll use separate models when the trade-off earns its cost.
You're comfortable in code you didn't write
. Working out how an existing system actually does, rather than what its documentation claims, is a skill you enjoy using.
You use AI deliberately.
You know how to give a model the context it needs, how to direct it on a large unfamiliar codebase, and judge whether what comes back is any good. You have opinions about where it helps and where it doesn't.
You own things in production.
Cloud, infrastructure as code, CI/CD, and observability are part of your job, not another team's. We run on AWS with Terraform, GitHub Actions, OpenTelemetry, EventBridge, SNS and SQS, but equivalent experience on any major cloud is just as welcome.
You make your reasoning clear.
You can challenge a colleague or client directly and respectfully, explaining the trade-off and proposing a better path.

Why us?

Cutting-edge technology in fintech
Highly qualified colleagues to learn from
A friendly, multicultural environment where you can learn, grow, and make an impact
Hybrid working setup with flexible hours
Work from Anywhere policy
Language classes and continuous learning and development

jobs.description:
Description

About Xe

Xe is a cross-border payments platform. We help SMEs and consumers in the US, UK, Canada, Australia, and New Zealand collect, convert, hold, and send money across markets. Each year, over 300 million people use Xe for currency information and over 350,000 use us to send money overseas.

Today, we're rebuilding the platform layer behind cross-border payments for corporate and consumer clients. We're small enough that your code ships fast and your decisions matter, and Euronet Worldwide (Nasdaq: EEFT) backs us so the problems stay real-scale.

About This Role

We're hiring a senior QA engineer who owns quality end-to-end and shapes how the team tests, from test design and automation infrastructure through to release gating and production observability. You already use AI as part of how you think, build, test, and ship.

You'll catch problems before code that moves money hits production, design the test automation other engineers depend on, and lead modernization of the test estate as new capability ships. You'll work in a small team with direct access to engineering, product, and compliance, own quality strategy for your domain, lead test architecture decisions, mentor mid-level QA engineers, and partner with architects and team leads on cross-domain quality decisions.

What You'll Do

Design and own integration test harnesses and contract tests for the flows that move money, across a range of domains and the partner APIs behind them.
Lead the design of the test automation that gates code into production, across onboarding, KYC and KYB, payment initiation, FX, settlement, and other supporting flows.
Set the balance of manual and automated testing for your domain: write test cases, run manual tests where they are the right tool, and lead automation in Playwright and equivalent frameworks.
Own CI/CD quality strategy for your domain (release-blocking signals, flaky-test triage, test infrastructure health), lead production incident investigation, and translate findings into automated tests and process improvements.
Lead design reviews of test architecture, set quality direction for your domain, and mentor mid-level QA engineers.
Use agentic coding tools and AI test tools (Copilot, Cursor, Claude Code, or equivalent; test generation, eval frameworks, or equivalent) daily, and lead the build of the test estate for new capability on the modern stack.

What We're Looking For

Must-have

6 to 10+ years building production test automation, end-to-end.
Strong test automation skills in JavaScript, TypeScript, Python, or C#, including test framework design, system design, and test architecture experience.
SQL and relational database fundamentals (for test data, validation, and debugging).
API testing (Postman, Bruno, or equivalent) and UI automation (Playwright, Cypress, or equivalent).
Functional and non-functional testing principles (reliability and security) and disciplined defect management, with hands-on performance, load, or resilience testing (k6, JMeter, or equivalent).
Comfortable generating test cases and running manual tests where they are the right tool, alongside building automated coverage.
Daily use of agentic coding tools (Copilot, Cursor, Claude Code, or equivalent) and AI test tools (test generation, eval frameworks, or equivalent) across the SDLC.
Production experience with AWS in a development or test context, and CI/CD pipeline ownership (GitHub Actions or equivalent), including building release gates.
Payments, FX, or regulated-industry experience.
Track record of QA technical leadership: setting test architecture, leading code reviews of test automation, and making quality decisions in your domain.
Strong written and verbal communication.

Nice-to-have

Experience with contract testing for partner integrations (Pact or equivalent).
Experience testing Windows client applications.
Mobile app test automation.
Experience leading modernization of test estates or quality programs.

Perks & Benefits

Annual performance-related rewards: performance-based annual bonus
Employee Stock Purchase Plan (ESPP): open to all employees
Car allowance: monthly car allowance (subject to Direction Level)
Meal vouchers: 8€ per working day
Preferential currency exchange rates: exclusive rates for employees
Money transfer discounts: special discounts on transfers
Annual salary review: performance-based process
Hybrid working model: 2 days per week WFH with flexible scheduling
Extended vacation allowance: 25-30 days annual leave
Extra bank holidays: additional company-recognised holidays
Birthday off: fully paid day off
Annual employee recognition events: HEROES awards & seniority recognitions
Annual social events: end-of-year celebration & regional/departmental gatherings
Seasonal celebrations: Halloween, New Year, Christmas, and other festivities
Volunteer days & CSR initiatives: Save the Children, environmental actions, food bank donations, and more
Employee wellness weeks: global and local wellbeing activities
Leadership training: internal and external learning opportunities
Cross-functional project opportunities: available based on skills and project needs
Internal & international mobility: relocation support and coaching for career development

XE offers a competitive salary and benefits package. The reasonable estimated pay for this role ranges from 55,000 EUR to 65,000 EUR. Actual compensation is based upon factors such as the candidate's skills, qualifications, and experience.

We want Xe to be a great place to work and to ensure that our communities are represented across our workforce. A vital part of this is ensuring we are a truly inclusive organization that encourages diversity in all respects.

We are committed to providing reasonable accommodations to qualified individuals with disabilities. If you need assistance or an accommodation due to a disability, you may contact us at recruitment@xe.com.

As the AI Solution Architect and Product Owner – Cost Value Engineering (CVE), you are the technical anchor of a newly launched, high-impact AI initiative within our global procurement and engineering function. Establish & Own Local CVE AI Platform: Build and govern the dedicated environment hosting our specialized AI applications and intelligent agents.
Architect Specialized Integration: Connect Central IT’s secure LLMs to localized engineering databases and low-code platforms, maximizing component reuse.
Govern AI Deployments: Act as the technical tollgate for all releases. Ensure solutions meet Central IT standards and validate business ROI before launch.
Guide Decentralized Teams: Mentor business-driven use case teams. Translate complex engineering problems into actionable, logical agile sprints.
Enable Citizen Developers: Architect the foundational frameworks allowing domain experts to securely build, test, and deploy their own AI solutions.
Design Product Backlog: Translate macro-business requirements into clear technical deliverables and manage the delivery pipeline.
Drive AI Roadmap: Prioritize rapid, high-impact Proof of Concepts (POCs) to secure immediate wins, basing execution on technical feasibility and accurate effort estimation.

What You Bring

Master’s degree in computer science, IT Systems Engineering, or a highly relevant technical experience.
5+ years of technical delivery experience, with a proven track record in software engineering, architecture, and driving agile AI/ML product lifecycles.
Strong Product Ownership credentials, specifically managing complex requirements pipelines, backlog refinement, and sprint executions.
Technical command of deploying modern AI frameworks (RAG, multi-agent architectures) within strict enterprise security boundaries.

If you have extensive experience in this field and you are looking for a development opportunity in a global organization, we would be interested in hearing from you.

Analyze and model the application landscape with regards to business aspects and IT aspects (Business Domains, Business Capabilities, Functional Architecture and Design, Technical Architecture and Design, Infrastructure Architecture) to identify areas for improvement
You will talk to the stakeholders in order to analyze and work out the business requirements’ essence, prepare the technical outlines for the epics, cut user stories and write product documentation in close dialog with respective experts on business and technical domains

You will work collaboratively on definition, specification and design of modular and integrated software products and design as well as defining automated tests for the product’s code
Demonstrate understanding and capacity to support and nurture your team on an ongoing basis
Evaluate and recommend appropriate technologies, frameworks, and tools to be used in the development process
Improve and advocate for AI acceleration within the team

What we would like you to bring

Profound architecture and design skills & In-depth knowledge of architectural methodologies and technologies
Experience in data heavy architectures & Strong analytical skills combined with structural thinking
Strong communication and presentation skills
Academic degree in IT / Computer Science, or equivalent work experience
Have several years of expertise being successful in the field as a full stack developer using Java, SpringBoot-RestAPI, Hibernate, Docker (basics), OpenShift, Jenkins, Git, Oracle, ReactJS, and SQL plus experience with front-end technologies such as Angular, JavaScript, TypeScript or NgRx
Experience using AI Coding Agents for SDLC processes, following best practices and setting up guardrails
Knowledge about Kafka, API Gateways, Micro service architecture, DevOps
Fluent written and spoken English

What's in it for you

You will have a direct influence on the future of logistics and IT. Your colleagues are experts who shape the IT industry in Portugal and worldwide. We want you to feel comfortable in your working surroundings. Therefore, we are offering you flexible working hours and mobile working arrangements. We value teamwork, continuous learning, and diversity. Kuehne+Nagel offers you a custom-made career – through individual planning and supervisors who support and advise you in every way. You get supported by many work-life balance offerings and supplementary health insurance.

Logistics shapes everyday life - from the goods we consume to the healthcare we rely on. At Kuehne+Nagel, your work goes beyond logistics; it enables both ordinary and special moments in the lives of people around the world.

As a global leader with a strong heritage and a vision to move the world forward, we offer a safe, stable environment where your career can make a real difference. Whether we help deliver life-saving medicines, develop sustainable transportation solutions or support our local communities, your career will contribute to more than you can imagine.

jobs.description:
OPSWAT, a global leader in IT, OT, and ICS critical infrastructure cybersecurity, delivers an end-to-end platform that gives public and private sector organizations and enterprises the critical advantage needed to protect their complex networks, secure their devices, and ensure compliance. Over the last 20 years our commitment to innovative technology has earned the trust of more than 1,700 organizations, governments, and institutions globally, solidifying our role in protecting the world’s critical infrastructure and securing our way of life.

The Product: MetaDefender MFT

MetaDefender MFT Enterprise is the next-generation evolution of OPSWAT's Managed File Transfer solution — a complete rearchitecture designed for scale, security, and the future. It is built to be:

A modern, scalable, and resilient platform capable of serving millions of users across enterprise and SaaS deployments.
A secure file exchange solution for both humans and systems, embedding OPSWAT's threat prevention technology — multiscanning, Deep CDR, and DLP — directly into every file flow.
A future-ready foundation that supports cloud-native SaaS delivery alongside traditional on-premise enterprise deployments.

You will be one of the engineers building MFT Enterprise from the ground up — setting architecture patterns, defining quality standards, and shipping a platform trusted by governments and critical infrastructure operators worldwide.

The Position

At OPSWAT’s Technology Development Centre in Veszprém, we are looking for talented AI Native
Senior .NET Engineer
to join our team working on one of our most strategic solutions: MetaDefender Secure Managed File Transfer (MFT)
. If you’re experienced in backend development, interested in cybersecurity, and excited to make real-world impact by protecting critical infrastructure, this is your opportunity!

In Veszprém, in the heart of a peaceful, friendly, historic city, we have created a modern, inspiring office environment that encourages collaboration, where friendly, direct relationships between colleagues and high-quality professional work are equally important. Using modern, innovative technologies, we work on products that truly contribute to making our world safer at one of the world's leading cybersecurity companies.

We support professional development through training, mentoring, and real opportunities for advancement. The Veszprém office offers the perfect balance of calm and professionalism – a modern environment, friendly people, and a strong team spirit.

If you want to work in a place where your knowledge is valued and you are treated as a person, then OPSWAT Veszprém is the place for you.

As an AI Native Senior .NET Engineer, you orchestrate a fleet of AI agents to architect, build, and deploy production-grade systems, and AI agents are a core part of your daily workflow. You build complex multi-service systems, create custom coding harnesses and test frameworks, and reverse-engineer existing systems entirely through AI workflows. You are measured by the speed of deployment and the robustness of what you ship, not the volume of your commits. You think in terms of “how do these pieces fit together as a system” and blend product, design, and analytical thinking into your delivery.

If you’re interested in working as an AI Native Senior .NET Engineer
at OPSWAT, please apply, and we will get in touch!

You Will Have the Opportunity to

Take ownership of features from concept to delivery: write precise specifications, work closely with teammates and stakeholders to refine requirements, and drive your work through to production with full accountability.
Work with AI as a first-class collaborator — your primary workflow involves orchestrating agents to create specs, generate code and tests, verify results, and perform reviews. Delegate well-scoped tasks to agents, then review, validate, and own every line that ships.
Participate in code reviews with a security-first lens, offering constructive feedback and holding the quality bar for both human-written and AI-generated code.
Create custom coding harnesses and test frameworks for structured, repeatable AI-assisted development — giving the team reliable scaffolding that agents can operate within safely and consistently.
Maintain and evolve the .NET Core codebase, continuously raising performance, scalability, and code quality as the product grows toward millions of users.
Author and keep current AI context files for every service you own — machine-readable architecture docs that encode coding standards, architectural constraints, and forbidden patterns so agents produce consistent, safe, on-pattern code across the team.
Help define and codify AI-native engineering practices for the MFT Enterprise team — establishing playbooks, context file standards, and review norms the broader engineering organization can adopt.

What We Are Looking For

AI-Native Fluency: Deep, hands-on experience integrating AI agents as core engineering tools, not add-ons — you approach every problem with an AI-native mindset. Must show real work (PRs, commit history, or portfolio) where agents drove backend velocity
Technical Excellence (.NET Core / C#): Strong proficiency in .NET / C# with a S.O.L.I.D understanding of programming principles, design patterns, and best practices. AI tools amplify strong fundamentals — they do not replace them.
Mission-Focused Delivery: 5+ years experience developing scalable solutions, including familiarity with relational/document databases and modern CI/CD systems for seamless integration and delivery.
Quality and Test Discipline: Focus on high-quality tested solutions — proficiency in unit testing with xUnit or equivalent. Uses AI agents to generate test scaffolding quickly, then validates that coverage is real and meaningful.
Growth Mindset: Passion for continuous learning. The AI coding ecosystem evolves rapidly — new models, agents, and tooling patterns ship constantly. This role requires staying current across the landscape and actively improving team workflows as the toolchain matures.

It Would Be Nice If You Had

Agent Discipline: Writes precise, unambiguous task specifications that agents can execute without re-prompting, and treats all AI-generated code as a junior engineer’s PR — reviewing for logic, security, edge-case handling, and architectural fit before anything ships.
Async programming (.NET): Knowledge of asynchronous .NET patterns — async/await, TPL — with experience validating AI-generated async code for thread-safety in high-throughput scenarios.
Cloud-native and containers: Hands-on with Docker, Kubernetes, and AWS/Azure/GCP — and experience using AI agents to script infrastructure and deployment automation tasks.
Security review of AI-generated code: Security-first instincts for reviewing AI-generated code: spotting injection risks, insecure defaults, missing input validation, and privilege escalation vectors in file-handling and authentication code.
AI context file authoring: Experience authoring AI context files (e.g., CLAUDE.md, .cursorrules, or equivalent) that encode architecture decisions and forbidden patterns for consistent, safe AI output across a team.
AI in CI/CD pipelines: Familiarity with running AI agents inside CI/CD pipelines — auto-fixing lint, generating missing tests, or running safe migrations as pipeline steps.
Personal projects: A home or personal project that demonstrates commitment to programming — including any AI-tooled projects that show how you work with agents.

Why You'll Love Working Here

Work on a greenfield next generation platform — architecture decisions you make now will shape a product serving millions of users.
Stable, growing international company background with an exceptional customer group across 50+ countries.
Modern technology environment with active investment in AI-native engineering practices.
Professional development through training, mentoring, and real opportunities for advancement.
Attractive compensation with regular performance assessments, and team activities.

jobs.description:
At Globant, we are working to make the world a better place, one step at a time. We enhance business development and enterprise solutions to prepare them for a digital future. With a diverse and talented team present in more than 30 countries, we are strategic partners to leading global companies in their business process transformation.

We are seeking a Forward Deployed Engineer (Full-Stack, AI-Native)
who shares our passion for innovation and high-velocity engineering. Operating embedded alongside product teams in an AI-agentic delivery workflow, you will bridge technical decision-making with hands-on full-stack development making key architectural choices, validating AI-generated code, and shipping resilient .NET, React, and integrated solutions directly to production.

Role Summary

This role owns end-to-end delivery on a highly transactional booking platform serving 8 markets in 2 languages. You take features from technical solutioning to production across the full stack: React/TypeScript frontends, the .NET services and BFF, and the booking, payments and loyalty integrations underneath.

You work embedded with the Product team inside an agentic delivery workflow. By the time a feature reaches you, requirements and designs have already been analysed against the current codebase by AI agents, and you get a mapped impact and a set of implementation options with pros and cons. Your job is to challenge that analysis, make the final technical decision, and implement it across the stack yourself.

The role is hands-on and autonomous. You're expected to get productive quickly in an existing codebase, decide within your scope without waiting to be unblocked, and escalate only the decisions that really need it. Agentic coding tools (Claude Code, Codex, Copilot) are the default way of working. What we value most is judgement about when to trust, verify or rewrite what they produce.

Core Responsibilities

End-to-end technical solutioning

Review agent-generated impact analysis and solution options for each feature, validate them against the real codebase, and make the final technical decision with clear reasoning.
Own the solution design across frontend, BFF, backend services and integrations, including the trade-offs on performance, risk and delivery time.
Work directly with Product, Design and client stakeholders to clarify requirements, flag technical constraints early, and shape scope.

Full-stack development

Build and ship features across React/TypeScript frontends and .NET services and BFF.
Own integration contracts for booking, payments and loyalty, including failure handling, idempotency and retry behaviour on transactions.
Work with CMS-driven content (Strapi) and across web and mobile client surfaces.

AI-native delivery

Use agentic coding tools as the default mode for implementation, refactoring, test generation and codebase exploration.
Keep context artifacts current (repo conventions, agent instruction files, prompts and scripts) so the whole team and the agents work from the same foundation.
Help define the team's rules for AI-assisted work: what agents do, what they don't, and what must be human-verified before merge.

Quality and production ownership

Review PRs, human- and AI-authored, watching for hallucinated APIs, deprecated calls, hidden complexity on hot paths, and tests that assert nothing.
Take part in RCA on production failures and turn findings into fixes, logging and guardrails.
Act as a technical counterpart to the Technical Director, Product and QA, making decisions within your scope rather than escalating by default.

Frontend: React
TypeScript
Flutter (mobile surface)
Backend: C# / .NET 8+
ASP.NET Core
REST APIs / BFF pattern
Redis

OpenAI Codex

agent instruction files

Must have

7+ years in software engineering, with strong production experience in both C#/.NET backend and React/TypeScript frontend, and still writing production code daily.
A track record of taking features end to end, from technical design to production, in an existing codebase.
Daily use of agentic coding tools on production code, with concrete examples of what changed in your delivery: scope, cycle time, test coverage, or refactors you wouldn't otherwise have attempted.

A strong code review practice, including a clear personal method for catching AI-generated defects.

Experience in fast-paced delivery with short cycles, feature flags and frequent releases.

new_jobs.title: Senior AI Software Engineer (m/w/d) - Jobbird.com
new_jobs.description:
Als führendes Unternehmen im Bereich Softwarelösungen für das Gesundheitswesen sind wir in 19 Ländern tätig und beschäftigen über 9.000 engagierte Mitarbeitende. Du wirst in einem dynamischen und innovativen Umfeld arbeiten, das voller Möglichkeiten steckt. Mit Deinem Einsatz und Deiner Leidenschaft hast Du die Gelegenheit, einen nachhaltigen Unterschied zu machen.

CGM Leverages AI:
Wir suchen Menschen, die die Kraft von KI im E-Health-Umfeld spüren, den Wandel mitgestalten wollen und mit neugieriger Leidenschaft erkennen, wie Technologie Gesundheit smarter, einfacher und besser machen kann.

Gemeinsam gestalten wir das Gesundheitssystem der Zukunft. Werde Teil unserer Mission und mache den Unterschied – für eine Welt, in der Wissen Leben rettet!

Dein Beitrag:

Du konzipierst, entwickelst und betreibst moderne Webanwendungen über unser SaaS-Portfolio hinweg (Praxis, Agentic AI, ifap, Therafox, Intermedix u. A.) und arbeitest souverän über Frontend, Backend und DevOps-Layer hinweg.
Du integrierst AI-native Features und agentische Experiences in unsere Produkte, nutzt LLMs, Retrieval, Tool-Use und strukturierte Workflows und schaffst so echten Mehrwert für Ärzt:innen, Praxisteams und Patient:innen.
Du designst, entwickelst und betreibst Cloud-native Services mit Fokus auf Zuverlässigkeit, Sicherheit und Developer Productivity und baust gemeinsam mit dem Team Shared Agents, Skills, Pipelines und Harnesses kontinuierlich aus.
Du arbeitest eng mit Product Management, UX, Architektur und Engineering zusammen, hebst die Engineering- und AI-Engineering-Qualität im Team aktiv an und prägst Best Practices für agentische Anwendungen.
Du bleibst nah an den Nutzerinnen und Nutzern, verstehst Healthcare-Workflows und bringst ein unternehmerisches, outcome-getriebenes Mindset in die Feature-Entwicklung ein.

Das bringst Du mit:

Mehrjährige Senior-Erfahrung im Full-Stack-Engineering moderner Webanwendungen mit tiefem Know-how in mindestens einem Frontend-Stack (React oder Angular) und einem Backend-Stack (Java/Spring Boot oder Python), idealerweise mit End-to-End-Verantwortung im Produktkontext.
Abgeschlossenes Hochschulstudium (Master oder Promotion) in Informatik, Software Engineering oder einem vergleichbaren technischen Studiengang mit überdurchschnittlichen Leistungen.
Fundierte Praxis mit unseren Kerntechnologien wie React/Angular, Java Spring Boot, Python, C#, Kafka, Terraform sowie Cloud-/DevOps-Umgebungen (Kubernetes, Helm, ArgoCD); Erfahrung mit LLM-Tools wie Azure OpenAI, Anthropic SDK oder MCP ist ein starkes Plus.
Nachweislich effektiver Einsatz von AI im Software-Engineering, idealerweise inklusive Claude Code oder vergleichbaren agentischen Coding-Tools (Agents, Skills, Workflows) sowie Erfahrung im Design von AI-Pipelines, Harnesses und Context Engineering.
Verhandlungssicheres Deutsch und fließendes Englisch in Wort und Schrift, ausgeprägte Problemlösungsstärke, Innovationsfreude, hohe Proaktivität, sehr gute Zusammenarbeit mit Product Management und ein klares Alignment mit unserem Healthcare-Purpose und einem unternehmerischen Mindset.

Das kannst Du von uns erwarten:

Mobile Work: Arbeite flexibel an zwei Tagen pro Woche mobil und an 3 Tagen vor Ort.
Attraktive Standorte: An unseren Standorten erwarten Dich neben voll ausgestatteten Arbeitsplätzen auch regelmäßige Events wie Sommerfeste und Weihnachtsfeiern.
Entwicklung: Unsere Inhouse-Academy und unser Portfolio aus externen Kooperationspartnern unterstützen Dich in Deiner Weiterentwicklung.
Gesundheit: Gesundheit ist für uns ein hohes Gut. In der hauseigenen Kantine gibt es jeden Tag eine Auswahl an leckeren und gesunden Gerichten und in unserem voll ausgestatteten Fitnessstudio heißen wir Dich in wöchentlichen Kursen gerne willkommen.
Mehr geht immer: Der Kindergarten auf unserem CGM-Campus in Koblenz unterstützt unsere Mitarbeitenden dabei, ihren Arbeitsalltag noch flexibler zu gestalten. Wir halten außerdem Corporate Benefits, die Möglichkeit eines Jobrads, BAV u. V. M. Für Dich bereit.

Vielfalt ist Teil von CGM!
Wir freuen uns unabhängig von Behinderung, Geschlecht, Nationalität, ethnischer und sozialer Herkunft, Religion, Alter sowie sexueller Orientierung und Identität auf Deine Bewerbung.

Überzeugt?
Bewirb Dich jetzt online mit Deinen aussagekräftigen Bewerbungsunterlagen (inkl. Deiner Zeugnisse, Gehaltsvorstellung und nächstmöglichem Eintrittstermin).
